Diyuturunumiyu

Deuteronomy

Igpewun-a

Introduction

Ka baseen te Diyuturunumiyu, impaay-ayaran megsinsinundula ne me guhuren ni Muwisis diye te me kabuhalan ni Israil, diye te inged te Muwab, ka inged ne insanggelan dan puun te naluhey ne peggipanew ran diye te disirtu, wey te timpu ne mahaan e sikandan egseled wey eg-ugpe diye te Kanaan.

The document of Diyuturunumiyu, carefully follows the stories by Muwisis there to the descendants of Israil, there in the place of Muwab, the place where they stopped from their long traveling there to the desert, and at the time when they would_ soon _enter and live there in Kanaan.

Ne seini ka duma ne impurtanti ne nahuhud te seini ne baseen: 1/ Nahuhud kayi ka pegpasuman-suman ni Muwisis te me kabuhalan ni Israil meyitenged te neneyitabu te nanlihad ne hep-at ne pulu (40) ne leg-un, wey ka peghangyu din te me kabuhalan ni Israil te pegsuman-suman ke immenu sikandan te eg-inahak te Magbebaye diye te disirtu. Ne nahuhud man-e kayi ka peghangyu ni Muwisis kandan ne eg-ikul wey egmatinumanen te Manama. 2/ Nahuhud man-e kayi ka pegguhud ni Muwisis te Sapulu (10) ne Suhu wey ka pegpasabut din te An-anayan ne Suhu, wey ka pegpanengneng din te me kabuhalan ni Israil ne keilangan ne iyan dan de iya egpamakayen ka Magbebaye ne Manama. Nalagkes nahuhud kayi ka lein-lein ne balaud ne egpeikulan te me kabuhalan ni Israil diye te Kanaan. 3/ Nahuhud man-e kayi ka pegpasuman-suman ni Muwisis te me kabuhalan ni Israil te igpasabut te kasabutan te Manama diye te kandan, wey ka pegbagget din kandan te pegtuman te sika ne kasabutan. 4/ Nahuhud man-e kayi ka peg-alam ki Huswi isip igliwan te pangulu te keet-etawan te Manama wey ka peg-ulahing ni Muwisis te peggale-gale te pegkamatinumanen te Manama te me saad din, wey ka pegpanalangin te me kabuhalan te Israil. Nahuhud man-e kayi ka pegpatey ni Muwisis diye te Muwab, talipag te Hurdan dapit te igsile.

And these (are) some of the important (things) storied by this document: 1/ It's storied here (about) Muwisis getting_ the descendants of Israil _to_remember concerning what_happened in the past forty (40) years, and his requesting the descendants of Israil to_remember how Lord accompanied them in their traveling there to the desert. And it's storied here the requesting by Muwisis to_them that they follow/imitate and be_faithful to God (MS Manama). 2/ It's also storied here (about) the storying by Muwisis of the Ten (10) Commands and his explaining of the First Command, and his informing the descendants of Israil that it's_necessary that who they serve (is) indeed the Lord God. Included storied here (are) the various laws that the descendants of Israil are_to_follow there in Kanaan. 3/ It's also storied here (about) the reminding by Muwisis to the descendants of Israil concerning explaining the explanation about the agreement of God with them, and his encouraging them about obeying that agreement. 4/ It's also storied here (about) the choosing of Huswi as replacement leader of the people of God and the singing by Muwisis in happiness about the faithfulness of God to his promises, and the blessing of the descendants of Israil. The death of Muwisis there in Muwab is_ also _storied here, on the opposite_bank of the Hurdan facing east.

Ka mabantug ne uluwan te seini ne baseen iyan ka pegluwas wey pegpanalangin te Manama te keet-etawan ne in-alam din wey inggeyinawaan. Purisu eleg iya ne egsumsumanen te me kabuhalan ni Israil ne eggeyinawaan wey egtahuren ka Manama eyew egpakaangken sikandan te umul, wey kene egkaawaan te panalangin.

The honored theme of this document is the saving and blessing by God of the people that were_chosen and loved by_him. Therefore (it's) correct indeed for the descendants of Israil to_think that they (should) love and respect God so_that they can_receive life, and not have_ blessing _removed_from (them).

Ka amana ne impurtanti ne me birsikulu kayi iyan ka 6:4-6 wey sika ne me birsikulu ka ingkahi ni Hisus ne labew te langun ne suhu ne miggenendue: Geyinawei niyu ka Manama niyu te intiru ne pusung, gimukud, wey keseg niyu.

The very important verses here (are) 6:4-6 and those verses (are what) Jesus said (is) the very prominent of all commands: Love(pl) your(pl) God with your(pl) entire heart, soul, and strength.

Ka igpewun-a te me lalag ni Muwisis

The first words of Muwisis

11 Seini ka insulat ne me guhuren ni Muwisis diye te me kabuhalan ni Israil taheed te diye pad sikandan te disirtu, diye te talipag te Weyig ne Hurdan dapit te igsile. Te seeye ne timpu, diye sikandan te Bangalug te Hurdan, marani te Sup, elat-elat te Paran wey te me lungsud te Tupil, Laban, Hasirut, wey Disahab. 2 Ne puun te Bubungan ne Sinay peendiye te Kadis-Barniya, me sapulu wey sabeka (11) ne aldew ka peggipanew ne diye egbaye te me bubungan te inged ne Idum.[fn] 3 Te an-anayan ne aldew te igkasapulu wey sabeka (11) ne bulan te igkeep-at ne pulu (40) ne leg-un puun te peg-awe te me kabuhalan ni Israil te Ihiptu, impangguhuran e sikandan ni Muwisis te langun ne igpahuhud te Magbebaye diye te kandan. 4 [xr]Ingguhud seini ni Muwisis te natalu rin e si Sihun ka Amurihanen ne Hari ne migmandu te Hisbun, wey si Ug ne matig-Basan ne Hari ne migmandu te Astarut wey Idrii. 5 Impangguhuran ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil meyitenged te balaud te Manama te diye pad sikandan te inged te Muwab ne talipag te Hurdan dapit te igsile.

11 These (are) the written stories by Muwisis to the descendants of Israil while they were still in the place where no_(one) lives, there on the far_bank of the River Jordan facing east. At that time, they were there at the Jordan Gulley, near Sup, between Paran and the towns of Tupil, Laban, Hasirut, and Disahab. 2 And from Mount Sinay going_towards Kadis-Barniya, the traveling (is) eleven (11) days going through the mountains of the place of Idum.[fn] 3 On the first day of the eleventh (11) month of the fortieth (40) year from the exiting of the descendants of Israil from Ihiptu, they were storied by Muwisis (about) all that the Lord commanded_to_be_storied to them. 4 [xr]This was_storied by Muwisis when he had defeated Sihun the Amurihanon king who ruled Hisbun, and Ug the king from_Basan who ruled Astarut and Idrii. 5 The descendants of Israil were storied by Muwisis concerning the law of God while they were still there at the land of Muwab on_the_far_bank of the Hurdan facing east.

Ka peg-awe te me kabuhalan ni Israil puun te Sinay

The leaving/removing of the descendants of Israil from Sinay

6 Ne ingkahiyan ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Te diye ki pad te Bubungan ne Sinay, migkahi ka Magbebaye ne Manama ta, ‘Naluhey kew e ka mig-uugpe te seini ne bubungan. 7 Purisu awe kew e kayi. Pangendiye kew e te me bubungan te me Amurihanen, wey te nakalingut ne me inged ne iyan ka napu te Hurdan, me bubungan, me kapatahan dapit te iglineb, me napu te inged te Nigib, wey diye te me inged ne ilis te Dahat ne Miditiranyu. Pabulus kew diye te Kanaan, wey Libanun, taman diye te dakel ne Weyig ne Iyupratis. 8 Pammineg kew, igbehey kud kuntee kaniyu ka tane ne eggendiyaan niyu. Hipanew kew e wey angkena niyud ka Inged ne Insaad ku te me kaap-apuan niyu ne ensi Abraham, Isaak, wey si Hakub, wey te langun ne kabuhalan dan.’ ”

6 And the descendants of Israil were_told by Muwisis, “When we(incl) were still at that Mount Sinay, our(incl) Lord who is our(incl) God said, ‘You(pl) have already lived here a_long_time at this mountain. 7 Therefore leave(pl) here. Go_there(pl) to the mountains of the Amurihanons, and to the surrounding places that (are) the plain of Hurdan, mountains, plain(pl) there on the west, plains of the place of Nigib, and there at the places on the edge of the Miditiranyu Sea. Continue(pl) to Kanaan, and Libanun, until the large River Iyupratis. 8 Listen(pl), I will_give you(pl) now/today the land that_ you(pl) _are_going_to. Go(pl) and receive(pl) the Place that_ I _Promised to your(pl) ancestors Abraham, Isaak, and Hakub, and to all their descendants.’ ”

Ka peg-alam ni Muwisis te me pangulu

The choosing of leaders by Muwisis

(Iks 18:13‑27)

(Exo 18:13‑27)

9 Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Taheed te diye ki pad te Bubungan ne Sinay, migkahi a kaniyu te, ‘Kene ku egkeyimu ka pegpangulu kaniyu ke sikeddiey re sabeka. 10 Imbuhal kew te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, wey egpekeiling kew e kasulug te me bituen diye te langit. 11 Ne egbuhalen kew pad iya man-e perem te Magbebaye ne Manama te kaap-apuan niyu te sabeka ne libu (1,000) ne lupi, wey egmatubungen sumale te insaad din kaniyu. 12 Piru egmenuwen ku naa te eggusey ka masumpit ne igmekeg-apul niyu, wey ka me prublima niyu ke sikeddiey re sabeka. 13 Purisu alam kew te me etew ne matagseb, masinabuten, wey talahuren puun te me kabuhalan niyu, eyew eggimuwen ku ne me pangulu niyu.’ 14 Ne migkahi kew keddi te, ‘Meupiya sika ne planu nu.’ 15 Purisu impeumew ku ka me pangulu te me kabuhalan niyu ne me matagseb, masinabuten, wey talahuren, wey inteil ku sikandan eyew egkeyimu ne me talewukum niyu wey me upisyal. Ka duma kandan me pangulu te tigsenge-libu (1,000) ne me etew, te tigmahatus (100), te tiglalimma ne pulu (50), wey te tigsapulu (10). 16 Ne impanpanayan ku sikandan te migkahi, ‘Pammineha niyu ka igmekeg-apul te me etew niyu, wey keilangan ne matareng ka peggukum niyu te minsan hentew—me kabuhalan ma ni Israil wey se lapu. 17 Ne keilangan ne ware eglapihan niyu te peggukum niyu. Pammineha niyu ka daruwa, egkaayu-ayu ma wey se meyaman. Ne kene kew kaaldek te minsan hentew su egpuun ma te Manama ka peggukum niyu. Ne emun ke due dakel ne prublima, ipeyinguma niyu kayi te keddi su sikeddiey e ka eggusey due.’ 18 Te seeye ne timpu, impanpanayan ku sikaniyu te langun ne keilangan ne eggimuwen niyu.”

9 And the descendants of Israil were_told again by Muwisis, “When we(incl) were still there at Mount Sinay, I told you(pl), ‘I can't do the leading of you(pl) if I'm just one. 10 You(pl) have_been_made_many by the Lord your(pl) God, and you(pl) are_like the count of stars there in the sky/heaven. 11 And hopefully you(pl) indeed will_be_made_many by the Lord God of your(pl) ancestors by one thousand (1,000) times, and will_be_prospered according to what_ he _promised you(pl). 12 But how can I resolve your(pl) extreme arguing_with_each_other, and your(pl) problems if I'm just one. 13 Therefore choose(pl) people that (are) wise, understanding, and respected from your(pl) descendants, in_order_that I make (them) your(pl) leaders.’ 14 And you(pl) said to_me, ‘That plan of yours(sg) (is) good.’ 15 Therefore I sent_for the leaders of your(pl) descendants that (are) wise, understanding, and respected, and I set_ them _aside to become your(pl) judges and officials. Some of them (are) leaders of one thousands (1,000) people, of one hundreds (100), of fiftys (50), and of tens (10). 16 And I warned them saying, ‘Listen(pl) to your(pl) people arguing_with_each_other, and it's_necessary that your(pl) judging (is) righteous to whoever—descendants of Israil or foreigners. 17 And it's_necessary that you(pl) have_no favored (one) in your(pl) judging. Listen(pl) to the two, poor or rich. And don't(pl) be_afraid of anyone because your(pl) judging is from God. And if there's a big problem, bring_it(pl) here to me because I (will be) the (one) to_resolve it.’ 18 At that time, I warned/instructed you(pl) (about) all that you(pl) need to_do.”

Ka me talagsilib

The spies

(Num 13:1‑33)

(Num 13:1‑33)

19 Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Ne puun te Bubungan ne Sinay, migpangipanew kid e man-e peendiye te disirtu ne nakita niyu mismu, peendiye te me bubungan te me Amurihanen. Te pegginguma ta diye te Kadis-Barniya, 20 ingkahiyan ku sikaniyu, ‘Nekeuma kid kayi te me bubungan te me Amurihanen, ka igbehey kanta te Magbebaye ne Manama ta. 21 Pammineg kew, imbehey e te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu ka tane ne eggendiyaan niyu. Hipanew kew e wey angkena niyud seeye sumale te insaad te Manama te me kaap-apuan niyu. Purisu kene kew iya kaaldek wey kene kew kaawei te kabagget.’ 22 Ne migparani kew langun keddi wey migkahi, ‘Te kene ki pad egmangendiye, eggun-a ki pad egsuhu te me etew eyew egsilib te seeye ne tane eyew egkahuhuran ki nikandan ke mamenu ka me lungsud ne eggingumaan ta, wey hendei ki egbaye ka eggendiye.’ 23 Ne insuman-suman ku ne meupiya seeye ne planu. Purisu mig-alam a te sapulu wey daruwa (12) ne etew—tigsabeka puun te tagse tribu niyu. 24 Ne migpanakereg e sikandan diye te me bubungan wey migpangingume e diye te bangalug ne egngaranan te Iskul, wey migmanisilib e sikandan diye. 25 Te migmanguli e sikandan, migpanguyan sikandan te me prutas puun diye, wey impangguhuran kid nikandan ne amana ne meupiya ka tane ne igbehey kanta te Magbebaye ne Manama ta.

19 And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to again by Muwisis, “And from Mount Sinay, we(incl) traveled again towards the desert that you(pl) yourselves saw, towards the mountains of the Amurihanons. When we(incl) arrived there at Kadis-Barniya, 20 I told you(pl), ‘We(incl) have_arrived here at the mountains of the Amurihanons, the (one that) will_be_given to us(incl) by the Lord who is our(incl) God. 21 Listen(pl), the Lord who is your(pl) God has_given the land that_ you(pl) _are_going_to. Travel(pl) and receive(pl) that according to what_was_promised by God of your(pl) ancestors. Therefore don't(pl) be_afraid and don't(pl) lose excitement.’ 22 And you(pl) approached me and said, ‘Before we(incl) go_there, we(incl) will_first command people in_order to_spy on that land in_order_that we(incl) be_storied by_them what_ the towns _(are)_like that_ we(incl) _will_be_arriving_at, and where we(incl) (should)_go_through to_get_there.’ 23 And I thought/considered that that plan (was) good. Therefore I chose twelve (12) people—one_each from each of your(pl) tribes. 24 And they ascended(pl) there to the mountains and arrived(pl) there at valley named Iskul, and they spied(pl) there. 25 When they returned_home(pl), they brought(pl) fruits from there, and we(incl) were_storied by_them that the land that will_be_given to us(incl) by the Lord who is our(incl) God (is) very good.

26 [xr]“Piru insupak niyu ka suhu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, su ware kew neupii ne eggendiye. 27 Nangugpe kew re te me balungbalung niyu wey migmanagsahukul kew ka migkahi, ‘Nalangetan kanta ka Magbebaye purisu impalihawang ki nikandin puun te Ihiptu eyew igbehey ki diye te me Amurihanen eyew egpangimatayan ki nikandan. 28 Egmenuwen te naa te egmangendiye? Ingginalatan ki te me etew ne insuhu ta ne egpasisiliben te seeye ne tane. Migkahi sikandan, “Me mallangkew wey mannekal pad kanta ka me etew diye. Ne mallig-en pad iya man-e ka me siyudad dan ne inlingutan te me malig-en, matikang, wey makepal ne alad ne batu ne nekeuma diye te aw-awangan. Ne timul pad, nenakita ney pad iya man-e diye ka me eleggasi.” ’[fn]

26 [xr]“But you(pl) disobeyed the command of the Lord who is your(pl) God, because you(pl) didn't want to_go_there. 27 You(pl) just lived(pl) in your(pl) tents and grumbled(pl) saying, ‘The Lord is_angry at_us(incl) therefore we(incl) were_made_ by_him _to_exit from Ihiptu so_that (we) would_be_captured(pl) and killed(pl) by the Amurihanons so that they will_kill us(incl). 28 How should_ we(incl) _go_there? We(incl) were_caused_to_fear by the people that we(incl) commanded to spy on that land. They said, “The people there (are) tall(pl) and stronger than us(incl). And their cities that are encircled with strong, tall, and thick stone fences that reach the atmosphere (are) indeed also strong. And added still, we(excl) saw(pl) also indeed giants.” ’[fn]

29 “Ne ingkahiyan ku sikaniyu te, ‘Kene kew kaaldek kandan, 30 su ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu ka egpangulu kaniyu wey sikandin ka egpakig-ehet para kaniyu, iling te nakita ta ne inggimu rin diye te Ihiptu. 31 [xr]Ne diye te disirtu, nakita niyu ke immenu kew te egduma te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, iling te amey ne migbaba te anak din, taman te nekeuma kew kayi te seini ne inged.’ 32 [xr]Piru minsan inlalag kud langun sika kaniyu, ware kew red iya man-e migpalintutuu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, 33 minsan ke sikandin ka miggun-a te hipanawan niyu eyew egpanulu te egbayaan niyu wey te egkekampuwan niyu. Migpeiling sikandin te sungkaleg ne hapuy ne egkalegleg ke marusilem, wey migpeiling te sungkaleg ne gapun ke maaldew.

29 “And I said to_you(pl), ‘Don't(pl) be_afraid of_them, 30 because your(incl) God (will be) the (one who) will_lead you(pl) and he (will be) the (one) to_fight for you(pl), like (what) we(incl) saw he did there in Ihiptu. 31 [xr]And there in the desert, you(pl) saw how you(pl) were_accompanied by the Lord your(pl) God, like a father who piggy-backs his child, until you(pl) arrived here in this place.’ 32 [xr]But even_though I told all that to_you(pl), you(pl) indeed again didn't believe the Lord your(pl) God, 33 even though he preceded in your(pl) journey in_order_to teach where_ you(pl) _should_pass_through and where_ you(pl) _should_camp. Ka pegparusa te me kabuhalan ni Israil

The punishing of the descendants of Israil

(Num 14:20‑45)

(Num 14:20‑45)

34 [xr]“Ne narineg te Magbebaye ka pegsagsahukul niyu, wey nabelu sikandin kaniyu, wey migpahunlibet te migkahi, 35 ‘Ware minsan sabeka te seini se mareet ne kabuhalan ne egpakakita te meupiya ne Inged ne Insaad ku te me kaap-apuan dan, 36 angin e mule ki Kalib ne anak ni Hipuni su egpakakita mule sikandin kayi. Igbehey ku mule kandin wey te me kabuhalan din ka tane ne innendiyaan din su mapahetpet ma mule ka pegtuman din keddi.’ 37 Ne tenged kaniyu, nabelu degma keddi ka Magbebaye, wey ingkahiyan a nikandin, ‘Kene ka degma egpekeendiye te inged te Kanaan. 38 Piru egtuhutan ku mule ka talagbulig nu ne si Huswi ne anak ni Nun te pegpangulu te me kabuhalan ni Israil eyew te peg-angken te Kanaan. Purisu baggeta nu sikandin ne egpakannekal.’

34 [xr]“And the Lord heard your(pl) grumbling, and he was_angry at_you(pl), and swore saying, 35 ‘Not even one of these bad/evil descendants will_see the good Place that_ I _Promised to their ancestors, 36 except on_the_contrary Kalib the child of Hipuni because he can_see it. I will_give on_the_contrary him and his descendants the land that_ he _is_going_to because his obeying me is energetic on_the_contrary.’ 37 And due_to you(pl), Lord was_angry also at_me, and I was_told by_him, ‘You(sg) also won't be_able_to_go to the place of Kanaan. 38 But I will_allow on_the_contrary your(sg) helper Huswi the child of Nun for leading the descendants of Israil in_order for accepting Kanaan. 41 “Ne migtabak kew keddi ne migkahi, ‘Nakasupak key te Magbebaye ne Manama. Piru kuntee, egpakiggira key mule te me kuntere ney sumale te insuhu kanami te Magbebaye ne Manama ney.’ Ne in-andam niyud ka me panganiban niyu eyew egpakiggira su migsuman-suman kew ne malemu re ne egkatalu ka keet-etawan ne nangugpe diye te me bubungan.

41 “And you(pl) answered me saying, ‘We(excl) have_ not _obeyed the Lord God. But now/today, on_the_contrary we(excl) will_fight(pl) our(excl) enemies according_to what_ we(excl) _were_commanded by our(excl) Lord God.’ And you(pl) prepared your(pl) weapons in_order for fighting because you(pl) thought that the people who live(pl) there in the mountains could_ just easily _be_defeated.

42 “Ne ingkahiyan a te Magbebaye, ‘Kene nu sikandan peendiyaa ka eggira su egkatalu iya sikandan te me kuntere dan su kene ku ma sikandan egdumaan.’ 43 Purisu inlalahan ku sikaniyu piru ware kew migpammineg. Insupak niyu ka suhu te Magbebaye tenged te pegkaambuhen niyu su nasi kew ma nangipanew ka egpakiggira diye te me bubungan. 44 Piru insukulan kew te me Amurihanen ne nangugpe diye te me bubungan wey egmekeiling sikandan te me patiyukan ka migmanlupug kaniyu puun te Siir taman te Hurma. 45 Ne nanlibed kew e diye te me kampu niyu diye te Kadis-Barniya, wey migsinehew kew diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ka egpabulig piru ware kew nikandin pammineha. 46 Purisu migpalunggehaat ki diye te Kadis-Barniya te naluhey ne timpu.”

We(incl) didn't pass_through(pl) the path of Araba from Ilat and Isuyun-Gibir, because we(incl) just passed_by(pl) the desert going_towards Muwab. 9 [xr]And we(incl) were_warned by Lord saying, ‘Don't(pl) warring the Muwabihanons the descendants of Lut, because I won't give to_you(pl) whatever portion of their land because I gave Ar there them as their own land.’ ”

23 “Purisu te seeye ne timpu, migpangananey a te Magbebaye te migkahi, 24 ‘He Magbebaye, impapitew nud kuntee te suluhuanen nu ka karesen nu, su warad lein ne manama due te langit wey kayi te tane ne egpekeyimu te kein-inuwan ne inggimu nu. 25 Purisu ke egkaayun ubag ne tuhuti a ubag nikeykew ne eglapas te Hurdan eyew egpakakite e pad ubag te meupiya ne tane diye te talipag te Hurdan, wey te me mateles ne bubungan wey te Libanun.’

29 “Purisu migpalunggaat ki re diye te napu ne egkatalipag te lungsud te Bit-Piyur.”

41 Ne ingkahiyan ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Tumana niyu ka langun ne balaud wey me suhu ne impanulu ku kaniyu, eyew egpekeendiye kew wey egpekeugpe te inged te Kanaan; ka inged ne insaad te Magbebaye ne Manama te me kaap-apuan ta. 2 [xr]Kene niyud timuli te minsan nekey wey ke eg-awaan niyu naa ka suhu te Magbebaye ne Manama ta. Impangimatayan din ka langun ne migsimba ki Baal. 4 Piru sikaniyu mule se migmatinumanen te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, neuyag kew pad mule taman kuntee.

5 “I taught you(pl) the laws and commands that_were_given to_me by the Lord my God that_ I _worship, in_order that you(pl) obey this there in the land that you(pl) are_going_to and receiving. 6 Obey(pl) this energetically because by_means_of this, you(pl) can_show your(pl) wisdom and understanding to other nations. 9 “Guard(pl) that you(pl) don't forget all that you(pl) have_seen(pl) that was_done by God. Guard(pl) this all as_long_as you(pl) still have life. 10 You(pl) remember the time you(pl) stood(pl) there in_front of your(pl) Lord there in Sinay (when) you're(pl) told, ‘You(sg) cause_ the descendants of Israil _to_gather here in_front of me because I want to speak to them, so_that they'll learn to respect me until they still have life, and so_that they can_teach their children also.’

11 [xr]“Ne migparani wey migmanasindeg kew diye te pabunsuranan te Bubungan ne Sinay taheed te nabukusan seini te makepal ne gapun wey migkanlabkanlab ne hendue te nekeuma ka legleg diye te langit. 12 Ne migpakiglalag kaniyu ka Magbebaye puun te taliware te hapuy. 15 Ne ingkahiyan ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Te timpu ne migpakiglalag kaniyu ka Magbebaye puun te taliware te hapuy diye te Bubungan ne Sinay, ware niyu sikandin nakita. Kene kew kaluhey diye su egkammatey kew iya langun. 27 [xr]Ne egmegsusuwayen kew te Magbebaye diye te duma ne me nasud wey pila-pila naan de kaniyu ka egkeuyag. 28 Ne diye, egsimba kew e te me diyus-diyus ne inggimu re te etew puun te kayu wey batu ne kene egpakakita, kene egpakarineg, kene egpakakeen wey ke egpakaarek naa. 29-30 [xr]Taheed te diye kew wey egpakasalerep kew te langun ne keyirapan, ke egpakasuman-suman kew e ne eglibed te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, wey egtumanen niyud sikandin, wey emun ke eg-ampu kew e te mapahetpet, egtabaken kew nikandin, 31 su hiimenawen ka Manama niyu. Ka me aputanan ne siyudad

The cities that (are) fleeing_places

41 [xr]Te nekeimpus e si Muwisis ka migpakiglalag te me kabuhalan ni Israil, in-alam din e ka tatelu ne siyudad diye te talipag te Hurdan dapit te igsile, 42 eyew eggimuwen ne aputanan te etew ne egpakapatey te senge-etew ne ware tuyui, wey kene ne kuntere din. Egkaayun sikandin ne eg-aput te minsan hendei te seini ne me aputanan ne siyudad eyew kene sikandin egkamenu. 43 Ne seini ka me siyudad: ka Bisir ne diye te ampew te bubungan ne mapatag, para te me sakup te me kabuhalan ni Rubin, ka Ramut te inged te Gilyad para te me sakup te me kabuhalan ni Gad, wey ka Gulan te inged te Basan, para te me sakup te me kabuhalan ni Manasis.

41 [xr]When Muwisis finished speaking_with the descendants of Israil, he chose three cities there in the opposite_bank of the Hurdan in the east, 42 in_order to_become a fleeing_place for people that kill a (LIT one) person without intending, and not his/her enemy. It's_possible that he/she flee to whichever of these cities that (are) fleeing_places so_that he/she won't be harmed. 43 And these (are) the towns: the Bisir that's there above the mountain that's flat, for the members of the descendants on Rubin, Ramut in the place of Gilyad for the members of the descendants of Gad, and Gulan in the place of Basan, for the members of the descendants of Manasis.

Ka pegbehey te balaud

The giving of (the) law

44 Ne seini ka me balaud te Manama ne ingkahi ni Muwisis te me kabuhalan ni Israil. 45-46 Te seeye ne timpu, nakalihawang e ka me kabuhalan ni Israil puun te Ihiptu, wey diyad nangekampu te talipag te Hurdan dapit te igsile ne marani te lungsud te Bit-Piyur. Ne diye ibehey ni Muwisis kandan ka me balaud wey me suhu. Ka seeye ne ingkampuwan dan, inged dengan ni Sihun, ka matig-Hisbun ne Hari te me Amurihanen ne natalu ni Muwisis. 47 Naahew ni Muwisis wey te me kabuhalan ni Israil ka tane ni Sihun wey ka inged ni Ug, ka matig-Basan ne Hari te me Amurihanen. Sikandan ka daruwa ne Hari te me Amurihanen diye te talipag te Hurdan dapit te igsile. 48 Ka tane dan ne nenaahew te me kabuhalan ni Israil, nakapuun de iya te Aruwir ne dibdibabew te Weyig ne Arnun wey nakapabulus diye te Bubungan ne Siryun, ne ingngaranan degma te Hirmun, 49 lagkes ka intiru ne napu ne diye te talipag te Hurdan dapit te igsile, taman te Namatey ne Dahat ne diye te lenlen te Bubungan ne Pisga.

44 And these were the laws of God that Muwisis told the descendants of Israil. 45-46 At that time, the descendants of Israil exited from Ihiptu, and camped there on the opposite_bank of the Hurdan in the east near to the town of Bit-Piyur. And there Muwisis gave/will_give them the laws and commands. Those (places) where_ they _camped, (is/was) land before of Sihun, the king of the Amurihanons from_Hisbun that were_defeated by Muwisis. 47 Muwisis and the descendants of Israil snatched place of Sihun and the place of Ug, the king of the Amurihanons from_Basan. They (were) the two kings of the Amurihanons there on the opposite_bank Hurdan there on the east. 48 Their land were_snatched by the descendants of Israil, just indeed from Aruwir above the Arnun River and continued there at Mount Siryun, also named Hirmun, 49 including the entire plain there on the opposite_bank of the Hurdan on the east, until the Dead Sea there at the mountain_base of Mount Pisga.

Ka Sapulu ne Balaud

The Ten Law(s)

(Iks 20:1‑17)

(Exo 20:1‑17)

51 Ne impeumew ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil wey ingkahiyan din sikandan, “Me kabuhalan ni Israil, pammineg kew te me balaud wey me suhu ne igpangguhud ku kaniyu kuntee ne aldew. Iskuyleyi niyu seini wey tumana niyu te mapahetpet. 2 Miggimu ka Magbebaye ne Manama ta te kasabutan duma kanta diye te Bubungan ne Sinay. 3 Inggimu rin seini ne kasabutan kene ne para re te me kaap-apuan ta, ke kene, para degma kanta langun te seini kuntee ne aldew. 4 Migpakiglalag kaniyu ka Manama, puun te taliware te hapuy diye te Bubungan ne Sinay. 5 Te seeye ne aldew, migsasindeg a diye te taliware niyu wey te Magbebaye eyew te pegpasabut kaniyu te egmanlalahen din, su nenaaldek kew ma te hapuy wey ware kew nanakereg diye te bubungan. Ne migkahi ka Magbebaye:

And the Lord said:

6 “Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu ne mig-angey kaniyu puun te inged te Ihiptu, wey ka migpaawe kaniyu te neneuripen.

6 “I (am) the Lord your(pl) God the (one who) bring_ you(pl) _back from the place of Ihiptu, and the (one who) sent_ you(pl) _away from slavery(pl).

7 “Kene kew simba te duma ne manama, su sikeddi de iya simbaa niyu.

7 “Do not(pl) worship other god, but rather just worship(pl) me.

8 [xr]“Kene kew himu te larawan te minsan nekey ne diye te langit, diye te tane, wey diye te weyig[fn] eyew egsimbeen niyu. 9 [xr]Kene kew panimbuel wey ke egsimba naa rue, su sikeddi se Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, talikuren a ne Manama; igkeupii ku ne sikeddi de ka egsimbeen. Iglagkes ku te egparusa ka me anak tenged te sale te me amey ran, peendiye te apu dan te mata, tenged su eg-apul sikandan keddiey. 10 Piru igpakita ku ka geyinawa ku ne kene egkabalbalawan diye te libu-libu ne kabuhalan ne miggeyinawa keddi wey migtuman te me suhu ku.

8 [xr]“Do not(pl) make of image of whatever that's there in the heaven, there on earth, and there in water[fn] in_order for you(pl) to worship. 9 [xr]Do not(pl) kneel_down or worship that, because I the Lord your(pl) God, (am) a jealous God; I desire that only me is worshiped. I will_include to punish the children due to the sin of their fathers, down to their great_great_grandchild (LIT grandeyes), because they disobey me. 10 But I will_show my unchangeable love to a thousands of descendant(s) who love me and obey my commands.

11 “Kene niyu gamita ka ngaran te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu te mareet ne tuyu. Su egdusaan ku iya seeye se eggamit te ngaran ku te mareet ne tuyu.

12 [xr]“Himuwa niyu ka igpeyimu ku kaniyu te Aldew te Peggimeley, wey iteil niyu seini ne aldew para keddi te Magbebaye ne Manama[fn] niyu sumale te insuhu ku kaniyu. 13 Trabahu kew te hen-em ne aldew, wey himuwa niyu ka langun ne eggimuwen niyu, 14 piru ka igkapitu ne aldew, Aldew sika te Peggimeley, wey iteil niyu para te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. Kene kew trabahu te minsan nekey, sikaniyu langun se taltalaanak, minsan ka me suluhuanen niyu ne lukes wey malitan, me baka, me asnu, wey duma pad ne me ayam niyu. Ne iling ded degma ka me mahaliyug niyu ne miglapu due te kaniyu. Te seini ne paahi, egpekeyimeley ubag degma ka me uripen niyu iling kaniyu. 15 Sumsumana niyu ne me uripen kew degma dengan diye te Ihiptu, wey sikeddi ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu ka migpalihawang kaniyu pinaahi te karesen wey geem ku. Purisu sikeddi se Magbebaye niyu, migsuhu a kaniyu ne keilangan ne eggimuwen niyu ka langun ne igpeyimu ku kaniyu te Aldew te Peggimeley.

12 [xr]“Do(pl) what_ I _asked_ you(pl) _to_do on the Day of Resting, and arrange_for(pl) this day for me Lord your(pl) God[fn] according to what_ I _commanded you(pl). 13 You(pl) (should) work for six days, and do all you(pl) wanted to do, 14 but the seventh day, that is the Day of Resting, set (it) for the Lord your(pl) God. Do not(pl) work any (work), you(pl) (as a) family, even your(pl) servants (whether) men or women, cows, donkeys, and other domestic_animals of_yours(pl). And your(sg) foreign_visitors that live with you(pl) (should do) just like (that) also. By this means, your(pl) slaves will_be_able_to_rest also [embarrassedly] like you(pl). 15 Note(pl) that you(pl) (were) slaves before there in Ihiptu, and I am Lord your(pl) God the (one who) brought_ you(pl) _out by_means of my strength and power. Therefore I your(pl) Lord, commanded you(pl) that it's_necessary that you(pl) do all that I have_commanded you(pl) on the Day of Resting.

16 [xra][xrb]“Tahura niyu ka amey wey iney niyu sumale te insuhu ku kaniyu, eyew egmalayat ka umul niyu wey egmeupiya ka peg-ugpe niyu diye te tane ne igbehey kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu.

16 [xra][xrb]“Respect(pl) your(pl) father and mother according to what_ I _commanded you(pl), so_that your(pl) life will_lengthen and your(pl) living will_be_good there in the land that I your(pl) God will_give you(pl).

17 “Kene kew himatey.

17 “Don't(pl) kill/murder(pl).

18 “Kene kew panlibug.

18 “Don't(pl) commit_adultery.

Ka pegkaaldek te me etew

(Iks 20:18‑21)

(Exo 20:18‑21)

23 “Te pegkarineg niyu te laheng ne egpuun te taliware te makepal ne gapun taheed te migkanlabkanlab ka bubungan, migparani e keddi ka langun ne pangulu te me kabuhalan niyu wey ka me igdatu niyu, 24 wey migkahi sikandan, ‘Impapitew te Magbebaye ne Manama ta ka geem wey katelesan din, wey narineg ney ka laheng din puun te taliware te hapuy. Ne nakanengneng key e kuntee ne kene bes egpatey ka etew ke egpakiglalag ka Manama kandin. 25 Piru egkammatey key mule pinaahi te sika ne hapuy ke egpakarineg key pad man-e te laheng te Magbebaye ne Manama ta. 26 Ware etew ne kene egpatey ke egpakarineg te laheng te manekal ne Manama ne egpakiglalag kandin puun te taliware te hapuy. 27 Sikeykew re ubag Muwisis ka egparani diye te Manama ta eyew egpammineg te iglalag din. Ne guhuri key re te langun ne iglalag din su egpamminehen ney wey egtumanen ney seini.’

23 “Upon your(pl) hearing the voice from the middle of thick cloud while the mountain blazed_with_fire, all the leaders of your(pl) descendants and your(pl) elders approached me, 24 and they said, ‘The Lord our(incl) God showed his power and beauty, and we(excl) heard his voice from the middle of the fire. And we(excl) know now/today that the person who is_spoken_with by God doesn't [surprise] die. 25 But we(excl) will_die(pl) by_means of that fire if we(excl) hear again the voice of the Lord our(incl) God. 26 No person doesn't die if (he/she) heard the voice of the strong/living God that speaks_with him/her from the middle of fire. 27 Just you(sg) Muwisis [embarrassedly/please] (be) the (one) to_approach our(incl) God in_order to_listen to what_ he _says. And just story(sg) us(excl) all that_ he _says because we(excl) will_listen_to and will_obey it.’

28 “Ne narineg te Manama ka ingkahi niyu keddi, wey ingkahiyan a nikandin, ‘Narineg ku ka ingkahi ran keykew, wey eleg iya ka ingkahi ran. 29 Meupiya iya perem ke layun sikandan egsuman-suman ne egtahud keddi, wey egtuman te me suhu ku eyew egmatubung sikandan wey ka me kabuhalan dan, te ware egtamanan. 30 Hendiye ke naan e wey peulia nud sikandan diye te me balungbalung dan. 31 Piru palunggaat ka mule kayi duma keddiey eyew iglalag ku keykew ka langun ne balaud wey me suhu ne keilangan ne igpanulu nu te me kabuhalan ni Israil eyew egtumanen dan diye te tane ne igbehey ku kandan.’ ”

28 “And God heard what_ you(pl) _said to_me, and I was_spoken_to by_him, ‘I've heard what_ they _said to_you(sg), and what_ they _said (is) correct indeed. 29 It would_be good if they always think to fear me, and obey my commands so_that they and their descendants would_prosper, without ending. 30 Go_there(sg) and send(sg)_ them _home to their tents. 31 But you(sg) remain here with me so_that I (can) tell you(sg) all the laws and commands that it's_necessary that you(sg) teach to the descendants of Israil so_that they (can) obey (them) there in the land that I will_give to_them.’ ”

32 Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Purisu tumana niyud iya te mapahetpet ka me balaud te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu; kene kew en iya supak minsan sabeka te me balaud din. 33 Tumana niyu seini langun eyew egmeupiya ka peg-ugpe niyu wey egmalayat pad ka umul niyu diye te tane ne eg-angkenen niyu.”

Ka suhu ne labew te langun

The command which is great(est) of all

61 Ne migpabulus-bulus si Muwisis ka migkahi diye te me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Seini ka me balaud wey suhu ne ingkahi keddi te Magbebaye ne Manama ta ne igpepanulu kaniyu, eyew egtumanen niyu diye te tane ne eggendiyaan wey eg-angkenen niyu. 2 Sikaniyu wey ka me anak niyu wey ka me apu niyu, keilangan ne egtahud te Manama, wey egtuman te langun ne balaud din ne ingkahi ku kaniyu, eyew egmalayat ka umul niyu diye te seeye ne tane. 3 Purisu pammineg kew me kabuhalan ni Israil—tumana niyud iya te mapahetpet ka me suhu din, eyew egmeupiya ka peg-ugpe niyu, wey egkeyimu kew ne mabantug ne nasud diye te meupiya ne tane wey dakel se eg-uma,[fn] su sika ka insaad te Manama diye te me kaap-apuan niyu.

61 And Muwisis continued speaking to the descendants of Israil, “These (are) the laws and customs that were_told to_me by the Lord our(incl) God that were_taught to_you(pl), so_that you(pl) will_obey (them) there in the land that you(pl) are_going_to and will_receive. 2 You(pl) and your(pl) children and your(pl) grandchildren, it's_necessary to_respect God, and obey all his laws that I told you(pl), so_that your(pl) live(s) will_be_long there in that land. 3 Therefore listen(pl) descendants of Israil—obey(pl) his commands energetically indeed, so_that your(pl) living becomes_good, and you(pl) will_become a respected nation there in good land and (have) large harvests,[fn] because that's what_ God _promised to your(pl) descendants.

4 [xr]“Pammineg kew me kabuhalan ni Israil: ka Magbebaye de iya ka Manama ta. 5 [xr]Geyinawei niyu ka Manama niyu te mapahetpet wey ipapitew niyu te langun ne eggimuwen niyu ne inggeyinawaan niyu sikandin. 6 [xr]Kene niyu kalingawi seini se me suhu ne ingkahi ku kaniyu kuntee. 7 Ipanulu niyu layun seini diye te me anak niyu. Ne malalahey kew meyitenged kayi ke egpaminpinnuu kew diye te me baley niyu, ke egpangipanew kew, ke egpangibat kew, wey ke eggimata kew te maselem. 8 Isulat niyu seini wey ibagkes niyu te bakelawan niyu wey ilelangkus niyu eyew egkasuman-suman niyu seini. 9 Isulat niyu seini diye te sungkaleg te gumawan te me baley niyu, wey diye te me gumawan te me alad te me lungsud niyu.”

4 [xr]“Listen(pl) descendants of Israil: just Lord indeed (is) our(incl) God. 5 [xr]Love(pl) your(pl) God energetically and show to all that you(pl) will_do that you(pl) loved him. 6 [xr]Don't(pl) forget these commands that I told you(pl) now/today. 7 Teach(pl) this always to your(pl) children. And talk_together concerning this if/when you(pl) sit(pl) there in your(pl) houses, if/when you(pl) travel(pl), if/when you(pl) lie_down(pl), and if/when you(pl) get_up in the morning. 8 Write(pl) this and tie it to your(pl) arm(s) and use_it_as_headband so_that you(pl) will_think of it. 9 Write(pl) them on the post of the doorway of your(pl) houses, and there on the doorways of the fences of your(pl) cities.”

Ka me pegpaney-paney te pegkamasinupaken

The warnings about disobedience

10 [xra][xrb][xrc]Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Migsaad ka Manama niyu diye te me kaap-apuan niyu ne ensi Abraham, si Isaak, wey si Hakub, ne igbehey rin kaniyu ka tane ne eg-uyanan din kaniyu. Ka seini ne tane, due malluag wey matubung ne me siyudad ne kene ne sikaniyu ka migpasasindeg. 11 Ne ka me baley diye, neelin ne nenapenu te mateles ne me kasangkapan ne kene ne sikaniyu ka migpanahu. Ne due me belun diye ne kene ne sikaniyu ka migkekali, wey due me ulibuwan wey me parasan ne kene ne sikaniyu ka migpamula. Ke eg-uyanen kew e te Manama diye te seeye ne tane, egpakakeen kew te minsan nekey ne igkeibeg niyu. 12 Piru kene niyu re iya kalingawi ka Manama ne migpalihawang kaniyu puun te pegkeuripen diye te Ihiptu. 13 [xr]Tahura niyu ka Manama niyu, wey sikandin de pamakaya niyu, wey kahi kew te egdusaan kew nikandin ke kene niyu eggimuwen ka insaad niyu. 14 Kene kew simba te lein ne me manama ne insimba te duma ne nasud ne nakalingut kaniyu, 15 su egkabelu ka Manama ne migduma kaniyu ke egsimba kew te lein ne me manama. Emun eggimuwen niyu sika, egkaneem-neem niyu ka langet te Manama, wey egguleen kew nikandin kayi te kalibutan.

10 [xra][xrb][xrc]And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to again by Muwisis, “Your(pl) God promised to your(pl) ancestors Abraham, Isaak, and Hakub, that he would_give you(pl) the land that he would_bring_ you(pl) _to. This land, has wide and prosperous cities that you(pl) didn't build. 11 And the houses there, are_all full of beautiful furniture/utensils that you(pl) didn't put (there). And there_are wells there that you(pl) didn't dig, and olive_groves that you(pl) didn't plant. If/When you(pl) are_brought by God there to that land, you(pl) will_be_able_to_eat whatever you(pl) desire. 12 But don't(pl) forget the God that brought_ you(pl) _out from your(pl) enslavement there in Ihiptu. 13 [xr]Respect(pl) your(pl) God, and just serve(pl) him, and say that he will punish you(pl) if you(pl) don't do what_you(pl)_promised. 14 Don't(pl) worship other gods that are_worshiped by other nations that surround you(pl), 15 because the God that accompanies you(pl) will_get_angry if you(pl) worship other gods. If you(pl) do that, you(pl) will_experience the anger of God, and you(pl) will_be_exterminated by_him here from the world.

16 [xra][xrb]“Kene niyu el-elehi ka Manama niyu iling te inggimu niyu diye te Masa. 17 Tumana niyud iya te mapahetpet ka me balaud ne insuhu kaniyu te Manama niyu. 18 Himuwa niyu ka matareng diye te tangkaan din eyew egmeupiya ka peg-ugpe niyu wey egkaangken niyu ka meupiya ne Inged ne Insaad din te me kaap-apuan niyu. 19 Egtuhutan din ne egkaddelrel niyu ka me kuntere niyu sumale te ingkahi rin.

16 [xra][xrb]“Don't(pl) test your(pl) God like you(pl) did there at Masa. 17 Obey(pl) energetically indeed what_was_commanded to_you(pl) by your(pl) God. 18 Do(pl) (what is) righteous/sensible there in front of him so_that your(pl) living will_become_good and you(pl) will_receive the good Place that he Promised to your(pl) ancestors. 19 He permitted that you(pl) can_drive_out your(pl) enemies according_to what_ he _said.

20 “Te egginguma ne me timpu, emun eg-inse ka me anak niyu te, ‘Mania te insuhu ki te Magbebaye ne Manama ta te pegtuman te seini ne me balaud wey me suhu?’ 21 Ne kahii niyu sikandan te, ‘Neneuripen key dengan te Hari diye te Ihiptu, piru impalihawang key te Manama pinaahi te dakel ne geem din. 22 Nakakita key mismu te masulug ne kein-inuwan wey makaalat-halat ne pegdereet te Manama te me Ihiptuhanen wey te Hari dan wey te intiru ne pamilya rin. 23 Ne impalihawang key nikandin puun te Ihiptu eyew eg-uyanen key kayi te seini ne Inged ne Insaad din te me kaap-apuan ta ne igbehey rin kanta. 24 Migsuhu ka Magbebaye ne Manama ta ne keilangan ne egtumanen ney ka langun ne balaud din, wey egtahuren ney sikandin ne Manama ney, eyew egmatubung key wey egmalayat pad ka umul ney iling te seinid iya kuntee. 25 Ne emun egtumanen ta te mapahetpet ka langun ne suhu te Magbebaye ne Manama ta, egkeyimu ki ne matareng diye te tangkaan din.’ ”

20 “In future (LIT arriving) times, if your(pl) children ask, ‘Why were_ we(incl) _commanded by the Lord our(incl) God in obeying these laws and commands?’ 21 And say to them, ‘We(excl) were_enslaved long_ago by the king there in Ihiptu, but we(excl) were_brought_out by God by_means_of his great power. 22 We(excl) ourselves saw the great/many(pl) wonders and terrifying destruction by God of the Ihiptuhanons and of their king and of his entire family. 23 And we(excl) were_brought_out of Ihiptu by_him so_that we(excl) can_be_brought here to this Place that he Promised to our(incl) ancestors that he would_give to_us(incl). 24 The Lord our(incl) God commanded that it's_necessary that we(excl) obey all his laws, and we(excl) respect/honor our(excl) God, so_that we(excl) prosper and our(excl) lives become_long like indeed now/today. 25 And if we(incl) energetically obey all the commands of our(incl) God, we(incl) will_become righteous there in front of him.’ ”

Ka pegpaneypaney te me kabuhalan ni Israil

The warnings of the descendants of Israil

(Iks 34:11‑16)

(Exo 34:11‑16)

71 [xr]Ne ingkahiyan ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Ke eg-uyanen kew e te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu diye te tane ne eg-angkenen niyu, egpandelrelen din ka pitu ne nasud ne masmasulug wey me madmaresen pad kaniyu, ne iyan ka me Hitihanen, me Girgasihanen, me Amurihanen, me Kanaanen, me Pirisihanen, me Hibihanen, wey me Hibusihanen. 2 Ne emun igbehey e sikandan te Manama due te kaniyu, wey egkatalu niyud sikandan, kene kew naa himu te kasabutan duma kandan, ke kene, pangimatayi niyu sikandan langun te ware pegkeyid-u. 3 Ne kene kew pangasawa kandan, wey kene niyu tuhuti ne egpangasawa ka me anak niyu te me anak dan, 4 su sikandan ka egpuunan ne egmanginniyug e te Manama ka me anak niyu, wey iyan dan e egsimbeen ka lein ne me manama. Ne emun egkeyitabu sika, egkaneem-neem niyu ka langet te Manama, wey sahuhune ne egguleen kew nikandin. 5 [xr]Purisu seini himuwa niyu: panlundusa niyu ka me altar dan ne tutunganan te igpanubad, panlupeta niyu ka immeg-untud-untud dan ne me batu ne inhalad dan ki Baal, pamelera niyu ka me sungkaleg dan ne larawan ni Asira, wey panilabi niyu ka impangulit dan ne me larawan. 6 [xr]Himuwa niyu sika su keet-etawan kew ma te Manama niyu. Te langun ne etew te intiru ne kalibutan, sikaniyu ka in-alam te Manama eyew egkeyimu ne keet-etawan din.

71 [xr]And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to by Muwisis, “When you(pl) are_brought to the land that you(pl) will_receive, he will_drive_away(pl) the seven nations that are more_numerous and stronger than you(pl), which_(are) the Hitihanons, the Girgasihanons, the Amurihanons, the Kanaanons, the Pirisihanons, the Hibihanons, and the Hibusihanons. 2 And when they are_given to_you(pl) by God, and they are_defeated by_you(pl), don't(pl) make an agreement with them, but rather, kill(pl) them all without sympathy. 3 And don't(pl) marry them, and don't permit(pl) that your(pl) children marry their children, 4 because they (are) the reason that your(pl) children will_turn_away_from(pl) God, and they will_worship other gods. And if that happens, you(pl) will_experience the anger of God, and suddenly you'll be exterminated by_him. 5 [xr]Therefore do(pl) this: demolish(pl) their altars that are burning_places for sacrifices, crumble(pl) their stacked_up(pl) stones that they dedicated to Baal, knock_down(pl) their poles that's image of Asira, and burn(pl) their graven images. 6 [xr]Do(pl) that because you(pl) (are) the people of your(pl) God. Of all the people of the entire world, you(pl) (are) the (ones who) were_chosen by God in_order to_become his people.

7 “In-alam kew wey inggeyinawaan te Manama kene ne tenged te masmasulug kew du te duma ne keet-etawan, su ka malehet, sikaniyu iya ka subla ne deisek te langun. 8 Piru in-alam kew te Manama su inggeyinawaan kew ma nikandin—intuman din iya ka insaad din te me kaap-apuan niyu. Sikan naa ka impalihawang kew nikandin pinaahi te dakel ne geem din puun te peg-uripen kaniyu te Hari te Ihiptu. 9 [xr]Purisu sumsumana niyu paay-ayari ne malehet iya ne Manama ka insimba niyu. Egkasalihan sikandin ne Manama, wey egtumanen din ka me saad din wey ka geyinawa rin ne kene egkabalbalawan diye te masulug ne kabuhalan ne eggeyinawa kandin wey egtuman te me suhu din. 10 Piru eglegparan wey egdereetan din seeye se eg-inniyug kandin. 11 Purisu tumana niyud iya te mapahetpet ka langun ne balaud wey me suhu ne ingkahi ku kaniyu kuntee.”

7 “You(pl) were_chosen and loved_by God not due because you(pl) (are) many, because the truth (is), indeed you(pl) (are) the most few/small of all. 8 But you(pl) were_chosen by God because you(pl) were_loved by_him—he indeed obeyed his promise to your(pl) ancestors. So then you(pl) indeed were_brought_out by_him by_means_of his great power from your(pl) enslavement by the king of Ihiptu. 9 [xr]Therefore remember(pl) carefully that it's the true/correct God that you(pl) worship. He is a trustworthy God, and he fulfills his promises and his unchangeable love to the many descendants that love him and obey his commands. 10 But he will_punish and destroy those who turn_away from him. 11 Therefore obey(pl) energetically all the laws and commands that I told you(pl) now/today.”

Ka me panalangin te pegkamatinumanen

The blessings for obedience

(Diy 28:1‑14)

(Deu 28:1‑14)

12 [xr]Ne migpabulus-bulus si Muwisis ka migkahi te me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Emun egtumanen niyu te mapahetpet ka langun ne suhu, egtumanen te Manama ka kasabutan din kaniyu wey ka geyinawa ne kene egkabalbalawan ne insaad din te me kaap-apuan niyu. 13 Eggeyinawaan kew nikandin, egpanalanginan, wey egpamasuluhen ka me kabuhalan niyu. Egpanalanginan din degma ka me anak niyu wey ka me kamet niyu eyew due egkakeen niyu, binu, wey lana te ulibu. Ne egpanalanginan din degma ka me ayam niyu—me baka, me karniru, wey me kambing niyu diye te Inged ne Insaad din te me kaap-apuan niyu ne igbehey kaniyu. 14 Egpanalanginan kew nikandin labew te langun ne keet-etawan. Ne ware minsan sabeka kaniyu ne kene egpakaanak, lukes ma wey se malitan. Ne iling ded degma ka me ayam niyu. 15 Ne igpariyu kew te Manama puun te langun ne dalu, wey kene kew nikandin egpasalerepen te mangune-kune ne me karereetan ne iling te nakita niyu diye te Ihiptu. Piru egpasalerepen din mule te iling dutu ka langun ne kuntere niyu. 16 Ne keilangan ne egpangimatayan niyu sikandan wey kene niyu keyid-uwi ka langun ne etew ne igbehey kaniyu te Manama. Pakaddiyu kew iya due su igkalindit iya sika te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. 26 Kene kew panguyan diye te me baley niyu te minsan hendei te sika ne me diyus-diyus, eyew kene kew egdereetan te Manama. Pariyui niyu wey ikeepes niyu seini su indilus e seini te Manama.”

Ka meupiya ne tane ne eg-angkenen

The good land that will_be_received

81 Ne migpabulus-bulus si Muwisis ka migkahi te me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Tumana niyu te mapahetpet ka langun ne suhu ne ingkahi ku kaniyu kuntee, eyew egmalayat pad ka umul niyu, egmasulug ka me kabuhalan, wey egpakaangken te Inged ne Insaad te Magbebaye ne Manama diye te me kaap-apuan niyu ne igbehey kaniyu. 2 Sumsumana niyu ne indumaan kew te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu te hipanawan niyu te hep-at ne pulu (40) ne leg-un diye te disirtu. Inggimu rin seeye eyew egsalig kew kandin, wey eyew te peg-eleg-eleg kaniyu wey pegnengneng ke nekey ka igkeupii niyu, ke egtumanen niyu naa ka me suhu din wey ke kene. 3 [xr]Inlised-lised kew nikandin pinaahi te pegpahutas kaniyu, wey nataman, imbehayan kew e man-e te mana ne egkeenen niyu—pegkeen ne ware niyu re due naherami wey te me kaap-apuan niyu. Inggimu seeye te Manama eyew te pegpanulu kaniyu ne kene ne iyan de igkeuyag te etew ka pegkeen, ke kene, te tagse lalag degma te Manama. 4 Ne te hep-at ne pulu (40) ne leg-un ne hipanawan niyu, warad iya naggisi ka me kumbale niyu, wey ware degma nanlebag ka me paa niyu. 5 Ne sumsumana niyu ne egdisiplineen kew te Manama niyu iling te amey ne egdisiplina te me anak din. 6 Purisu tumana niyu ka me suhu te Manama; ikula niyu ka me panulu din wey tahura niyu sikandin, 7 su eg-uyanen kew nikandin diye te meupiya ne tane ne masulug se me beuhan wey me sebseb diye te me bangalug wey me bubungan; 8 tane ne masulug se trigu, sibada, paras, iggira, granada, ulibu, wey teneb. 9 Kene kew egkaawaan te egkakeen, wey te minsan nekey ne diye te seeye ne tane. Ne egpakakuwa kew te me putew diye ne iling de te egmanlaglag kew te me batu, wey egmakakekali kew degma te masulug ne burunsi diye te me bubungan. 10 Egpakakeen kew te minsan nekey ne igkeupii niyu, wey egdayanen niyu ka Manama tenged te pegbehey rin kaniyu te meupiya ne tane.”

11 [xr]Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Kene niyu kalingawi ka Manama niyu, wey tumana niyu ka me balaud wey me suhu din ne ingkahi ku kaniyu kuntee. 12 Ne emun egkakeen niyud ka langun ne igkeupii niyu te egkeen, egpakabebaley kew e, 13 egmasulug e ka me ayam niyu, me bulawan niyu, wey ka langun ne karatuan niyu, 14 kene kew peggasal. Kene kew kalingew ne me uripen kew dengan diye te Ihiptu, piru ka Manama re ka migpalihawang kaniyu, 15 wey migduma kaniyu diye te luluahi wey makaliyas-liyas ne disirtu ne due egmanggilu ne me uled wey me tapilak. Ware weyig diye ne inged, piru migpalepew sikandin te weyig ne egkeinum niyu puun te sumalem ne batu. 16 Sikandin ka migbehey kaniyu te mana ne egkakeen niyu—pegkeen ne ware de due naherami te me kaap-apuan niyu. Inggimu seeye te Manama eyew egsalig kew kandin, wey eyew te peg-eleg-eleg kaniyu, wey te katamanan, egbehayan kew nikandin te meupiya ne peg-ugpe. 17 Ne kene kew suman-suman te naangken niyu sika ne me karatuan pinaahi te kanekal wey katuenan niyu. 18 Sumsumana niyu ka Manama niyu su sikandin ka migbehey kaniyu te katuenan eyew egkaangken niyu ka karatuan. Inggimu seeye te Manama eyew te pegtuman te insaad din diye te me kaap-apuan niyu. 19 Piru egpanpanayan ku sikaniyu te mapahetpet ne emun eglingawan niyu ka Manama niyu, wey iyan niyud egsimbeen ka lein ne me manama, egpangimatayan kew iya te Manama. 20 Ke kene niyu egtumanen ka Manama, egpandereetan kew red degma nikandin iling te me nasud ne egdereetan din ke egpalinggumaan kew e.

91 “Pammineg kew me kabuhalan ni Israil! Egmanlapas kew e kuntee te Hurdan eyew te pegdelrel te me nasud ne derakel wey me madmaresen pad kaniyu. Impandelrel sikandan te Magbebaye ne Manama tenged te maddeet ne hinimuwan dan. 5 Kene ne tenged su matareng kew ne egkaangken niyu ka me nasud dan, ke kene, egpandelrelen sikandan te Magbebaye ne Manama tenged te maddeet ne hinimuwan dan, wey eyew degma te pegtuman te insaad din diye te me kaap-apuan niyu ne ensi Abraham, Isaak, wey si Hakub. 6 Purisu keilangan ne egsumsumanen niyu ne ware ibehey kaniyu te Manama seini se meupiya ne tane eyew egkaangken niyu tenged su me matareng kew, su ka malehet memakehal se me ulu niyu.”

7 Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Sumsumana niyu ne diye te disirtu, inhanggat niyu ka langet te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. Migmasinupaken kew kandin puun pad te peglihawang niyu te Ihiptu taman kuntee. 8 Ne minsan te diye ki pad te Bubungan ne Sinay, inhanggat niyu ka langet te Magbebaye ne Manama, purisu egpangimatayan kew e perem nikandin. 9 [xr]Neyitabu seeye te diya a te bubungan eyew egdawat te kasabutan ne ingkulit te Magbebaye ne Manama diye te malumpayag ne batu. Mig-uugpa a diye taman te hep-at ne pulu (40) ne aldew wey hep-at ne pulu (40) ne marusilem. Ne wara a migkeen wey mig-inum te seeye ne me timpu. 10 Ne imbehey e keddi te Magbebaye ne Manama ka daruwa ne malumpayag ne batu ne ingkulitan din te langun ne suhu ne inlalag din kaniyu puun te taliware te hapuy diye te Bubungan ne Sinay taheed te nanlibulung kew diye. 11 Ka daruwa ne malumpayag ne batu ne ingkulitan te Magbebaye ne Manama te kasabutan din, imbehey rin keddi peglihad te hep-at ne pulu (40) ne aldew wey hep-at ne pulu (40) ne marusilem.

You(pl) were_rebellious to_him from your(pl) exiting of Ihiptu until now/today. 8 And even when we(incl) (were) still there at Mount Sinay, you(pl) invited the anger of the Lord God, therefore you(pl) should have_been_killed by_him. 9 [xr]This happened when I (was) there at/on the mountain in_order to_receive the agreement that were_engraved by the Lord God on the stone tablets. But on_the_contrary I will_make you(sg) the ancestor of a nation that's stronger than them.’

15 “Ne taheed te nalegleg pad ka bubungan, mig-enew wey migtupang ad ne mig-uyan te daruwa ne malumpayag ne batu ne ingkulitan te kasabutan. 16 Ne nakita ku sikaniyu ne migsupak kew te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. Migpangimu kew te burunsi ne diyus-diyus ne nati te baka—inlemlemuwan niyu re inniyuhi ka me suhu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. 17 Ne imbantulang ku ka daruwa ne malumpayag ne batu diye te tangkaan niyu, wey nenapese e seini. 18 Ne miglangkeb ad e man-e diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama taman te hep-at ne pulu (40) ne aldew wey hep-at ne pulu (40) ne marusilem. (Exo 34:1‑10)

Ka suhu te pegtahud wey pegtuman te Manama

The command for respecting and obeying God

12 “Ne kuntee me kabuhalan ni Israil, ka imbuyu de kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, iyan ka egtahuren niyu sikandin wey egtumanen niyu ka langun ne igpeyimu rin, eggeyinawaan niyu sikandin, wey egpamakayen niyu te mapahetpet. 13 Tumana niyu ka langun ne balaud din ne ingkahi ku kaniyu para te keupianan niyu. 14 Kandin te Magbebaye ne Manama ka langun! Ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu ka kamuney te aw-awangan, te titikangi ne langit, te kalibutan, wey te langun-langun de iya ne tahu kayi. 15 Piru in-alam te Magbebaye ne Manama ka me kaap-apuan niyu wey inggeyinawaan din sikandan labew te langun ne etew. Ne in-alam kew degma nikandin se me kabuhalan dan labew te langun ne nasud, wey taman kuntee, me keet-etawan kew iya nikandin. 16 Purisu puun kuntee, paruma-ruma kew e te Magbebaye ne Manama, wey kene niyud pakehala ka me ulu niyu. 17 [xr]Maresen amana ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu labew te me manama wey te me talagmandu. Mabantug sikandin wey maresen wey eleg ne egtahuren; ware eglapihan din te peggukum din, wey kene sikandin egdawat te bayad ne igbunbun te mareet. 18 Eggimuwen din ka eleg ne peggukum para te me ilu wey te me balu. Kene kew engked kandin, wey kahi kew te egdusaan kew nikandin ke kene niyu eggimuwen ka insaad niyu. 21 Deyraya niyu sikandin su sikandin de ka Manama ne miggimu te me kein-inuwan wey makaliyas-liyas ne me himu para kaniyu ne sikaniyu mismu ka nakakita. 22 [xra][xrb]Te timpu ne nangendiye dengan te Ihiptu ka me kaap-apuan niyu, pitu ne pulu (70) de sikandan langun, piru kuntee, impamasulug kew e te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu iling kasulug te me bituen diye te langit.”

He (is) honored and powerful and correct to_be_respected; no_(one) can_match his judging, and he doesn't accept payment that covers evil. 18 He does the correct judging for orphans and widows. Ka karesen te Manama

The greatness of God

111 Ne ingkahiyan ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Geyinawei niyu ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, wey tumana niyu ka langun ne insuhu din kaniyu. 2 Kene niyu kalingawi ka natuenan niyu meyitenged te Magbebaye ne Manama pinaahi te nenabbaybayaan niyu duma kandin. Sikaniyu mismu ka nakapamalehet kayi; kene ne ka me anak niyu. Ware sikandan nakakita te pegkatalahuren wey pegkamaresen te Magbebaye ne Manama, 3 [xr]wey te me kein-inuwan ne inggimu rin diye te Hari te Ihiptu wey te intiru ne nasud din. 4 [xr]Ware man-e sikandan nakakita te inggimu te Manama diye te me sundalu te Ihiptu duma te me kudde wey te me karwahi ran; ke immenu sikandan te Magbebaye ne Manama te eglened te timpu ne impanlupug kew nikandan. Impangimatayan sikandan te Magbebaye ne Manama. 5 Nakita niyu degma ka inggimu rin kaniyu diye te disirtu, taman te nekeuma kew kayi te Muwab. 6 [xr]Sumsumana niyu ka inggimu rin engki Datan wey ki Abiram ne me anak ni Iliyab te tribu ni Rubin. Impabekabeka rin ka tane wey impaameluk din sikandan ne mannekal re due duma te me pamilya ran, me balungbalung, me suluhuanen, wey me ayam dan. 7 Sikaniyu mismu ka nakakita te peggamit te Magbebaye ne Manama te dakel ne geem din te peggimu te seini se langun ne kein-inuwan.”

111 And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to by Muwisis, “Love(pl) the Lord your(pl) God, and obey(pl) all that_ he _commanded you(pl). 2 Don't(pl) forget your(pl) knowledge concerning the Lord God by_means_of what_ you(pl) yourselves _went_through(pl) along_with him. You(pl) yourselves (are) the (ones who) witnessed this; not your(pl) children. They didn't see the honor and strength of the Lord God, 3 [xr]and the wonder that_ he _did there to the king of Ihiptu and to his entire nation. 4 [xr]They didn't see also what_ God _did there to the soldiers of Ihiptu along_with horses and their chariots; how the Lord God drowned them at the time when you(pl) were_chased by_them. They were_killed by the Lord God. 5 You(pl) also saw what_ he _did to_you(pl) there at the desert, until you(pl) arrived here at Muwab. 6 [xr]Remember(pl) what_ he _did to Datan and to Abiram the children of Iliyab of the descendants of Rubin. He made_ the ground _split_open and he caused_ them _to_be_swallowed_whole when still living/strong along_with their families, tents, servants, and their domestic_animals. 7 You(pl) yourselves saw the using by the Lord God of his big power in doing all these wonders.”

8 Ne migkahi e man-e si Muwisis, “Purisu tumana niyu ka langun ne suhu ne ingkahi ku kaniyu kuntee eyew egmanekal kew ka eggipanew wey eg-angken te tane diye te talipag te Hurdan. 9 Ke egtuman kew, egmalayat ka umul niyu wey egmatubung kew diye te meupiya ne tane wey dakel se eg-uma[fn] ne insaad te Magbebaye ne Manama diye te me kaap-apuan niyu wey te me kabuhalan dan. 10 Ka tane ne eggendiyaan niyu eyew eg-angkenen, kene ne iling te tane diye te Ihiptu ne impuunan niyu, ne emun egpamula kew, keilangan pad ne egpamisbisan. 11 Piru ka tane ne eg-angkenen niyu, due me bubungan wey me bangalug ne layun de eg-urani; 12 tane seini ne intanggu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, wey intetamengan din seini te langun ne timpu.
