Ka inged ne egsimbaan

The place to worship

121 “Ne seini ka me balaud wey me suhu ne keilangan ne egtumanen niyu diye te tane ne igbehey kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama, ka Manama te me kaap-apuan niyu, eyew egkaangken niyud te ware egtamanan. 2 Emun egkaahew niyud ka tane dan, keilangan ne egpangguhusen niyu egpatamtamani ka me simbaan dan te me manama ran—ka diye te me bubungan, me labuntud, wey ka diye te egdalungan te me kayu. 3 [xr]Panlundusa niyu ka me altar ne tutunganan dan te igpanubad, panlupeta niyu ka immeg-untud-untud dan ne me batu, panilabi niyu ka me sungkaleg ne larawam ni Asira, wey pamesaa niyu ka impangulit dan ne me larawan te me manama ran, eyew kenad egkasimba ka seeye ne me diyus-diyus diye te seeye ne me inged.

121 “And these (are) the laws and commands that it's_necessary that you(pl) obey there in the land that the Lord God will_give you(pl), the God of your(pl) ancestors, so_that you(pl) can_receive (it) without ending. 2 When you(pl) can_snatch their land already, it's_necessary that you(pl) demolish utterly their worship_places for their gods—the (ones) there on mountains, hills, and there in the shade of trees. 3 [xr]Dismantle(pl) the altars that are their burning_places for sacrifices, crumble(pl) their stones place_on_each_other, burn(pl) the poles that's images of Asira, and break(pl) their graven images of their gods, so_that those false_gods there in those places can_be_worshiped no_longer.

4 “Kene niyu simbaa ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu iling te pegsimba ran te me manama ran. 5 Eg-alam ka Magbebaye ne Manama te sabeka ne inged puun te inged te sabeka te me kabuhalan niyu, eyew diye kew eglibulung langun ka egsimba kandin. 6 Ne diye niyu panguyana ka langun ne igmanubad niyu ne egtutungen, wey ka me duma ne ighalad niyu, me igkasapulu, me dasag, ka igsaad niyu ne ighalad diye te Magbebaye, wey ka me panganey te me ayam niyu. 7 Ne sikaniyu wey ka me pamilya niyu, egmangeen kew te ngalap te immanubad diye te inged ne egsimbaan niyu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu duma te kahale, tenged te pegpalampus din kaniyu te langun ne inggimu niyu.

4 “Don't(pl) worship the Lord your(pl) God like their worshiping of their gods. 5 The Lord God will_choose one place from the place of one of your(pl) descendants, so_that you(pl) all will_gather there to_worship him. 6 And there bring(pl) all your(pl) sacrifices to_be_burned, and your(pl) other offering, tenths, gifts, your(pl) promised offerings to the Lord, and the eldest_children of your(pl) domestic_animals. 7 And you(pl) and your(pl) families, eat(pl) the meat of the sacrifices there at the place where the Lord God will_be_worshiped by_you(pl) along_with joy, due to his causing_ you(pl) _to_succeed all that_ you(pl) _do.

8 “Kene niyud ipabulus-bulus ke nekey ka inggimu niyu kuntee ne iyan ka pegtuman te igkeupii niyu, 9 su ware kew pad nekeuma diye te tane ne eg-ugpaan niyu ne ware samuk ne igbehey kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama. 10 Ke egpakalapas kew e te Weyig ne Hurdan, wey egpekeugpe kew e te tane ne igbehey kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama, eg-ugpe kew e diye ne malinawen, su kene ma egtuhutan te Magbebaye ne Manama ne egsamuken kew te langun ne kuntere niyu ne nakalingut kaniyu. 11 Eg-alam ka Magbebaye ne Manama te sabeka ne inged eyew diye niyu sikandin egsimbaa. Ne diye niyu panguyana ka igsuhu ku kaniyu: ka igmanubad niyu ne egtutungen, ka igmanghalad niyu, ka igkasapulu niyu, ka igmandasag niyu, wey ka langun ne insaad niyu ne ighalad diye te Magbebaye. 12 Ne gale-gale kew diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu duma te me anak niyu ne me lukes wey me malitan, me suluhuanen niyu ne me lukes wey me malitan, lagkes ka me Libita ne nangugpe diye te me lungsud niyu—sumsumana niyu ne ware ubag mule baad te me Libita. 13 Ne kene kew panubad te egtutungen diye te minsan hendei ne inged ne igkeupii niyu, 14 ke kene, diye de iya te inged ne eg-alamen te Magbebaye ne Manama puun te sabeka te me kabuhalan niyu. Ne diye niyu himuwa ka langun ne insuhu ku kaniyu.

8 “Don't(pl) (then) continue whatever you(pl) do now that's obeying your(pl) desire, 9 because you(pl) haven't get arrived there at the land that you(pl) will_live without trouble that the Lord God will_give you(pl). 10 When you(pl) cross the River Hurdan, and you(pl) live in the land that the Lord God will_give to_you(pl), live(pl) there peacefully, because the Lord God won't permit that you(pl) are_disturbed by all your(pl) enemies that are_surrounding you(pl). 11 The Lord God will_choose one place so_that you(pl) worship him there. And take(pl) there what_ I _commanded you(pl): your(pl) sacrifices to_be_burned, your(pl) offerings, your(pl) tenths, your(pl) gifts, and all your(pl) promised offerings there to the Lord. 12 And be_joyful(pl) there in front of the Lord your(pl) God along_with your(pl) male and female children, your(pl) male and female servants, including the Libitas that live(pl) there in your(pl) towns—remember(pl) that there's_no portion [embarrassedly] for the Libitas. 13 And don't sacrifice by_burning there in whatever place that you(pl) desire, 14 but rather, just there in the place that will_be_chosen by the Lord God from one of your(pl) descendants. And there do(pl) all that_ I _have_commanded you(pl).

15 “Piru egkaayun ded mule ne eglape kew wey egkeen te me ayam niyu minsan hendei. Egpakakeen kew taman te igkeupii niyu, iling te egmangekeen kew te ngalap te usa, sumale te igbehey kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. Egkaayun man-e ne egkeen ka langun ne etew; in-isip ma ne malindit wey se malinis. 16 [xr]Piru kene kew keen te langesa; ulei niyu re seini diye te tane iling te weyig. 17 Ne kene egkaayun ne egkeenen niyu diye te me ugpaan niyu ka me halad niyu ne egkakeen, binu, wey ke mentika naa, panganey te me ayam niyu, wey ka insaad niyu ne ighalad, duma ne ighalad niyu, wey ka memeupiya ne igmandasag niyu; 18 diye niyu re seini keena te inged ne egsimbaan te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, diye te inged ne eg-alamen din, duma te me anak niyu ne me lukes wey me malitan, me suluhuanen niyu ne me lukes wey me malitan, wey te me Libita ne nangugpe diye te me lungsud niyu. Gale-gale kew diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu tenged te langun ne inggimu niyu. 19 Ne keilangan ne kene niyu egbalaharen ka me Libita taheed te egmangugpe kew diye te tane niyu.

15 “But on_the_contrary it's_possible that you(pl) butcher and eat your(pl) domestic_animals anywhere. You(pl) can_eat until your(pl) desire, like you(pl) eat(pl) deer meat, according_to what_ the Lord your(pl) God _will_give you(pl). It's_ also _possible for all people to_eat; whether considered dirty or clean. 16 [xr]But don't(pl) eat blood; just pour(pl) (it) there on the ground like water. 17 And it's_ not _possible that you(pl) eat your(pl) food offerings, wine, and cooking_oil, eldest of your(pl) domestic_animals, your(pl) promised sacrifices, along_with your(pl) offerings, and your(pl) very_good gifts there in your(pl) living_places; 18 just eat them there at the place where the Lord your(pl) God will_be_worshiped by_you(pl), there in the place that_ he _will_choose, along_with your(pl) male and female children, your(pl) male and female servants, and the Libitas that live(pl) there in your(pl) towns. Be_happy(pl) there in front of the Lord your(pl) God due_to all that_ you(pl) _do. 19 And it's_necessary that you(pl) don't ignore the Libitas while you(pl) live(pl) there in your(pl) land.

20 “Ne egpamaluahen e te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu ka tane niyu sumale te insaad din, wey egkakeen niyu ka langun ne ngalap ne igkeibeg niyu. 21 Ne emun mariyu te me ugpaan niyu ka inged ne eg-alamen te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu eyew egsimbaan niyu kandin, egkaayun ne diye kew re te me ugpaan niyu eglape te baka niyu wey ke karniru naa ne igbehey kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ne sumale te insuhu ku kaniyu, egkaayun ne egkeen kew te me ayam taman te igkeupii niyu, 22 iling te egmangekeen kew te ngalap te usa. Egkaayun ne egkeen ka langun; in-isip ma ne malindit wey se malinis. 23 [xr]Piru kene kew keen te langesa su langesa ma ka egpuunan te umul; kene niyu ilagkes te egkeen duma te sapu ka umul. 24 Ke kene, ulei niyu re seini diye te tane iling te weyig. 25 Kene kew en iya keen te langesa eyew egmeupiya ka peg-ugpe niyu wey te me kabuhalan niyu, su meupiya diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ka kene egkeen te langesa. 26 Piru keilangan iya ne eg-uyanen niyu diye te inged ne eg-alamen te Magbebaye ne Manama ka igmanubad wey me dasag ne insaad niyu para kandin. 27 Tutunga niyu diye te altar te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu ka langun ne egtutungen ne igpanubad. Ne ka langesa te duma ne igpanubad niyu, ulei niyu diye te altar, piru keena niyu mule ka sapu. 28 Tumana niyud iya ka langun ne suhu ne ingkahi ku kaniyu, eyew egmeupiya ka peg-ugpe niyu wey te me kabuhalan niyu te ware egtamanan, su meupiya wey eleg diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ka pegtuman te langun ne suhu.”

20 “And the Lord your(pl) God will_widen your(pl) land according to what_ he _promised, and you(pl) will_be_able_to_eat all the meat/fish that you(pl) desire. 21 And if the place that_will_be_chosen by the Lord your(pl) God so_that you(pl) worship him (there) (is) far from your(pl) living_places, it's_possible that you(pl) just butcher your(pl) cow or sheep that you(pl) will_give to the Lord God there at your(pl) living_places. And according_to what_ I _commanded you(pl), it's_possible that you(pl) eat domestic_animals as_far_as your(pl) desire, 22 like that you(pl) eat(pl) meat of deer. And it's_possible that all will_eat; whether (they are) considered dirty or clean. 23 [xr]But don't(pl) eat blood because blood is the source of life; don't include eating the life along_with the flesh. 24 But rather, just pour(pl) (it) there on the ground like water. 25 Don't(pl) eat blood so_that your(pl) living and (that) of your(pl) descendants is_good, because not eating blood (is) good there in front of the Lord. 26 But it's_necessary indeed that you(pl) bring the sacrifices and your(pl) promised gifts to the place that_ the Lord God _will_choose. 27 Burn(pl) all the burnt sacrifices there on the altar of the Lord your(pl) God. And the blood from other of your(pl) sacrifices, pour(pl) (it) there on the altar, but on_the_contrary eat(pl) the flesh. 28 Obey(pl) all the commands that_ I _told you(pl), so_that your(pl) living will_be_good and (that) of your(pl) descendants without ending, because obeying all commands (is) good and correct there in front of the Lord God.”

Ka me pegpaney-paney meyitenged te me diyus-diyus

The warnings concerning false_gods

29 Ne migpabulus-bulus si Muwisis ka migkahi te me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Emun egguleen e te Magbebaye ne Manama ka me nasud ne egpangendiyaan niyu, wey egkaddelrel niyud ka me mahinged diye wey sikaniyud ka egpangugpe te tane dan, 30 bantey kew ne kene kew egkasaligkat pinaahi te peg-ikul niyu te pegsimba ran. Kene kew panginginse ke immenu ran te egsimba ka me manama ran eyew eg-ilingen niyu degma ka pegsimba niyu. 31 Kene niyu simbaa ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu iling te pegsimba ran te me manama ran, su ka paahi te pegsimba ran, inggimu ran ka langun ne igkeepes te Magbebaye. Ne impanutung dan pad iya man-e ka me anak dan isip egtutungen ne igpanubad diye te me manama ran.

29 And Muwisis continued speaking to the descendants of Israil, “When the Lord God wipes_out the nations that_ you(pl) _are_going_to(pl), and you(pl) have_driven_out the local_inhabitants there and you(pl) (are) the (ones) living(pl) in their land, 30 watch_out(pl) that you(pl) don't stumble by_means_of your(pl) imitating of their worshiping. Don't(pl) ask(pl) how they worship their gods so_that you(pl) also imitate their worshiping. 31 Don't(pl) worship the Lord your(pl) God like their worshiping of their gods, because the means of their worshiping, they do all that the Lord is_against. And indeed they burn(pl) their children as a burnt sacrifice there to their gods.

32 [xr]“Tumana niyud iya te mapahetpet ka langun ne suhu ne ingkahi ku kaniyu. Kene niyud seini timuli wey ke egsalinan naa.

32 [xr]“Energetically obey(pl) all the commands that_ I _have_told you(pl). Don't(pl) add or subtract to/from these.

Ka paney-paney meyitenged te ubat ne prupita

The warning concerning (a) lie prophet

131 “Ne emun due prupita wey ke talagpasabut naa te taheinep ne egkahi te egpapitew sikandin te me kein-inuwan 2 eyew te peg-inniyat kaniyu ne egsimba wey egpamakey te me manama ne ware niyu simbaa dengan, wey minsan pad egkamalehet ka igkahi rin, 3 kene kew linga-linga kandin. In-el-elehan kew re te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu eyew te pegnengneng ke inggeyinawaan niyu naan iya sikandin te mapahetpet. 4 Iyan niyu re pamakaya wey tahura ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. Pammineha niyu sikandin wey tumana niyu ka me suhu din. Sikandin de simbaa niyu wey kene kew engked kandin. 5 Piru keilangan ne eggimatayan ka prupita wey ke talagpasabut naa te taheinep, su sikandin ka egpakapanulu kaniyu ne egsukul kew wey egsupaken niyu ka suhu te Manama wey eyew egpakasuwey kew te igkeupii rin te migpalihawang kaniyu puun te Ihiptu, wey mig-angey kaniyu puun te pegkeuripen. Purisu keilangan ne eg-aween ka mareet ne himu due te kaniyu.

131 “And if there's a prophet or interpreter of dream(s) that says he/she can_show wonders 2 in_order for attracting you(pl) to_worshiping or serving gods that you(pl) didn't worship before, and even if what_ he/she _says comes_true, 3 don't pay_attention to_him/her. You(pl) are_ just _being_tested by the Lord your(pl) God in_order for knowing if indeed he is_loved by_you(pl) energetically. 4 Just serve and respect the Lord your(pl) God. Listen(pl) to him and obey(pl) his commands. Just worship(pl) him and don't(pl) leave him. 5 But it's_necessary that the prophet or (the) interpreter of dream(s) be_killed, because he/she (is) the (one who) can_teach you(pl) that you(pl) rebel and you(pl) disobey the command(s) of the God (and so_that you(pl) could_depart from (what) he wants) that brought_ you(pl) _out from Ihiptu, (and took_ you(pl) _out from slavery.) Therefore it's_necessary that the bad actions will_be_removed from you(pl).

6 “Ne panunggilingan ke egtipuwen kew te heles de te suled niyu, te anak niyu ne lukes wey ke malitan naa, ke asawa niyu wey ke amana niyu naa ne alukuy, eyew egsimba kew te me manama ne ware niyu neileyi wey te me kaap-apuan niyu, 7 ke egbaggeten kew nikandin ne egsimba te me manama te me etew ne nangugpe diye te marani niyu wey te minsan hendei, 8 kene kew pammineg wey ke egparuma-ruma naa kandin; kene niyu sikandin ikeyid-u wey kene niyu pangabangi. 9 Keilangan ne eggimatayan sikandin wey sikaniyu ka hun-a ne egbatu kandin. Ne egkataman, ka me etew degma. 10 Bebatuwa niyu sikandin taman te egpatey, su sikandin ka egpuunan ne egpakapariyu kew te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu ne iyan migpalihawang kaniyu puun te pegkeuripen diye te Ihiptu. 11 Ne emun egpakanengneng ka duma ne me kabuhalan ni Israil meyitenged te neyitabu te sika ne prupita wey ke talagpasabut te taheinep, egkaaldek e sikandan, wey warad eggimu te iling due ne himu.

6 “And for_example if you(pl) are_convinced just secretly by your(pl) sibling/cousin/mate, or your(pl) male or female children, or your(pl) spouse or your(pl) very close friend, in_order to_worship gods that you(pl) and your(pl) ancestors don't know, 7 if you(pl) are_encouraged by_him/her to_worship gods of the people who live(pl) near you(pl) or wherever, 8 don't(pl) listen or comply_with him/her; don't(pl) pity him/her and don't(pl) help (him/her). 9 It's_necessary that he/she be_killed and you(pl) (are) the first to_stone him/her. And then, the people also. 10 Stone(pl) him/her until (he/she) dies, because he/she is the reason that you(pl) will_distance from the Lord who is your(pl) God who brought_ you(pl) _out from your(pl) enslavement there in Ihiptu. 11 And if/when the other descendants of Israil find_out concerning what_happened to that prophet or interpreter of dream(s), they will_be_afraid, and will_ no_longer _do like that act.

12 “Ne emun due egkarinehan niyu diye te sabeka te me lungsud ne igbehey kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, 13 ne due me etew ne maddeet se hinimuwan ne iyan egpuunan ne egpakasale ka me mahinged diye pinaahi te pegsimba te me manama ne ware niyu neileyi, 14 keilangan ne egnengnengan niyu seini ke malehet naa wey ke kene. Ne emun egkapamalehetan niyu seini ne malehet, 15 keilangan ne eggimatayan niyu ka langun ne mahinged te sika ne lungsud, lagkes ka me ayam dan. 16 Ne libulunga niyu diye te taliware te plasa ka langun ne karatuan te seeye ne lungsud, wey panilabi niyu seini wey ka intiru ne lungsud, isip igpanubad ne egtutungen para te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. Ne kenad iya egkabalbalawan ka seeye ne lungsud. 17 Ne kene kew same te minsan nekey ne keilangan ne egsilaban, eyew kene egkabelu kaniyu ka Magbebaye ne Manama, wey egkeyimenawan sikandin kaniyu wey egpamasuluhen kew nikandin sumale te insaad din te me kaap-apuan niyu. 18 Eggimuwen sika te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu ke egtumanen niyu ka langun ne suhu din ne ingkahi ku kaniyu kuntee, wey eggimuwen niyu ka matareng diye te tangkaan din.”

12 “And if you(pl) hear there in one town that will_be_given to_you(pl) by the Lord who is your(pl) God, 13 that there_are people with evil actions that (are) the reason that the local_inhabitants there are_sinning by_means of worshiping gods that you(pl) don't know/recognize, 14 it's_necessary that you(pl) find_out if this is correct or not. And if you(pl) find_ this _proven correct, 15 it's_necessary that you(pl) kill(pl) all the local_inhabitants of that town, including their domestic_animals. 16 And gather(pl) there in the middle of the plaza all the wealth of that town, and burn(pl) it and the entire town, as a sacrifice that's burnt for the Lord who is your(pl) God. And that town indeed (must) no_longer be replaced. 17 And don't keep_a_remainder(pl) of whatever that it's_necessary be_burned, so_that the Lord God isn't angry at_you(pl), and he pities you(pl) and you(pl) are_made_numerous by_him according to what_ he _promised to your(pl) ancestors. 18 The Lord your(pl) God will_do that if you(pl) obey all his commands that I told you(pl) now/today, and you(pl) do (what is) righteous/sensible there in front of him.”

Ka ingkene ne eggimuwen ke eglungku

The banned actions if/when mourning

141 [xr]Ne ingkahiyan ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Tenged su me anak kew ma te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, kene niyu pamalpali-i ka me lawa niyu wey ke egtabuluhan niyu naa ka ampew-ampew te me buked niyu ke eglungku kew te minatey, 2 [xr]su me keet-etawan kew ma ne inlein te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. Te langun ne keet-etawan te intiru ne kalibutan, sikaniyu ka in-alam te Magbebaye ne Manama eyew egkeyimu ne keet-etawan din mismu.”

141 [xr]And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to by Muwisis, “Because you(pl) (are) the children of the Lord who is your(pl) God, don't(pl) repeatedly_wound your(pl) bodies or cut_ your(pl) _hair on the very_top of your(pl) forehead if you(pl) are_mourning for the dead, 2 [xr]because you(pl) (are) the people that have_been_separated by the Lord your(pl) God. Of all the peoples of the entire world, you(pl) (are) the (ones) chosen by the Lord God to become his own people.”

Ka malindit wey malinis ne mananap

The dirty and clean animals

3 Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Ne kene kew keen te minsan nekey ne mananap ne in-isip ne malindit. 4 Seini re ka me mananap ne egkaayun ne egkeenen niyu: me baka, karniru, kambing, 5 usa, leew ne kambing, leew ne karniru, wey duma pad ne klasi te karniru. 6 Egkaayun kew ne egkeen te minsan nekey ne mananap ne naperi se sulu, wey egsepe ke egkeen. 7 Piru kene kew keen te mananap ne ware naperi se sulu minsan egsepe eg-abey ke egkeen, iling te kamil, rabit, wey ambew—isipa niyu sika ne malindit ne mananap. 8 Kene kew man-e keen te babuy minsan naperi ka sulu ran, su kene ma sikandan egsepe ke egkeen, purisu malindit sikandan. Kene kew en iya keen te sika ne mananap minsan egsamsam de te namatey ne lawa ran.

3 And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to again by Muwisis, “And don't(pl) eat whatever animal is_considered dirty. 4 Just these (are) the animals that it's_possible that you(pl) eat: cows, sheep, goats, 5 deer, wild goats, wild sheep, and other classes of sheep. 6 It's_possible for you(pl) to_eat whatever animal that the nail/hoof is_divided, and (that) chews if eating. 7 But don't(pl) eat animals without a divided nail/hoof even if (it) chews when eating, like camel, rabbit, rat/mouse—consider that (to be) a dirty animal. 8 Also don't(pl) eat pig even_if their nail/hoof is_divided, because they don't chew if eating, therefore they (are) dirty. Don't(pl) indeed eat that animal or_even touch their dead body(s).

9 “Egkaayun kew ne egkeen te langun ne klasi te isda ne due piyapis wey me engil, 10 piru kene kew keen te isda ne ware piyapis wey me engil su eg-isipen seini ne malindit.

9 “It's_possible that you(pl) eat all classes of fish that have fin(s) and scales, 10 but don't(pl) eat fish without fin(s) and scales because they are_considered dirty.

11 “Egkaayun ne egkeen kew te me bayaku ne malinis, 12 piru kene kew keen te agila, banug, uwak, 13 kabugkul, kaliyawa, 14 langun ne klasi te uwak, 15 ekang, ustrits, 16 deisek wey dakel ne ekang, wey maangkag ne ekang, 17 me bayaku ne egdagmang te isda, 18 kabeg, wey kalapenit. 19 Ne kene kew degma keen te langun ne uled-uled ne due pakpak ne in-isip ne malindit. 20 Piru egkaayun kew ne egkeen te me uled-uled ne due pakpak ne in-isip ne malinis.

11 “It's_possible that you(pl) eat clean birds, 12 but don't(pl) eat eagle, hawk, crow, 13 kite, hornbill, 14 all classes of crow, 15 owl, ostrich, 16 small and large owl, and white owl, 17 birds that swoop_down_on fish, 18 flying_fox, and fruit_bat. 19 And also don't(pl) eat all insects that have wing(s) which (are) considered also dirty for you(pl). 20 But it's_possible (for) you(pl) to_eat insects that have wing(s) that are_considered clean.

21 [xr]“Ne kene kew degma keen te mananap ne migpatey re due te kandin; egkaayun ne igbehey niyu seini te me lapu wey ke igbelegye niyu naa kandan. Piru sikaniyu mule, kene kew iya keen kayi su me keet-etawan kew ma ne in-alam te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu.

21 [xr]“And also don't(pl) eat animal(s) that just died by itself; it's_possible that you(pl) give this to foreigners or (for) you(pl) to_sell (it) to_them. But you(pl) on_the_contrary, don't(pl) eat it because you(pl) (are) the people that were_chosen by the Lord your(pl) God.

“Ne kene niyu hilutua ka nati ne karniru wey ke kambing naa pinaahi te gatas te iney.

“And don't(pl) cook a sheep or goat lamb/kid by_means of the milk of the mother.

22 [xr]“Ne keilangan ne egteil kew te igkasapulu ne baad puun te langun ne eg-uma te me kamet niyu eyew ighalad niyu tagse leg-un. 23 Ne uyana niyu diye te inged ne eg-alamen te Magbebaye ne Manama ka igkasapulu ne baad puun te me trigu niyu, binu, lana, wey ka me panganey te me ayam niyu. Ne diye niyu seini keena te inged ne egsimbaan niyu te Magbebaye ne Manama; himuwa niyu sika eyew egkateu kew ne egtahud layun te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. 24 Ne emun mariyu te me ugpaan niyu ka sika inged, wey egkaliseran kew ne egpanguyan te me igkasapulu puun te me panalangin ne igbehey kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama, 25 egkaayun ne igbelegye niyu seini wey ka halin naan de uyana niyu diye te inged ne eg-alamen te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. 26 Ne ibeli niyu ka seleppi te minsan nekey ne igkeupii niyu: baka, karniru, binu, wey te minsan nekey ne igkeupii niyu. 22 [xr]“And it's_necessary that you(pl) prepare a tenth portion from all the harvest of your(pl) fields in_order for you(pl) to_offer each year. 23 And bring(pl) the tenth portion from your(pl) wheats, wine, oil, and the eldest of your(pl) domestic_animals to the place chosen by the Lord God. 27 “Ne kene niyu balahara ka me Libita ne nangugpe diye te me lungsud niyu su ware ma ubag mule baad dan ne tane isip egkapanunud dan ne karatuan ne inggaat iling kaniyu. 28 Ne te katammanan te tagse igkatelu ne leg-un, libulunga niyu ka langun ne igkasapulu puun te langun ne egkahaani niyu te sika ne leg-un, wey panguyana niyu seini diye te me tinesanan ne diye te me lungsud niyu. 29 Ne ipamehey niyu seini te me Libita su ware ma ubag mule tane dan ne egkapanunud, wey diye te me lapu, me ilu, wey me balu ne nangugpe te me lungsud niyu eyew egpakakeen ubag degma sikandan wey egkengabulung. (Lib 25:1‑7)

(Lev 25:1‑7)

151 Ne ingkahiyan ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Te katammanan te tagse igkapitu ne leg-un, keilangan ne eglingawan niyud e ka langun ne utang te seeye se migpangutang kaniyu te seleppi. 2 Ne seini ka eggimuwen niyu: kene niyud peulii ka insambayan te duma niyu ne me kabuhalan ni Israil su migginguma man e ka timpu ne inteil te Magbebaye ne Manama ne kenad e egsukuten ka me utang. 3 Piru egkaayun mule ne egpeulien niyu ka me lapu te nasambayan dan ne seleppi, piru kene niyud mule sukuti ka me duma niyu ne me kabuhalan ni Israil.

151 And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to by Muwisis, “At the end of each seventh year, it's_necessary that you(pl) forget already all the debts of those who've borrowed money from you(pl). 2 And this (is what) you(pl) will_do: don't(pl) cause_to_be_repaid what_the (things)_borrowed of your(pl) companion who (are) the descendants of Israil because the time has_come that the Lord God prepared not to foreclose debts. 3 But on_the_contrary it's_possible that you(pl) cause_the_foreigners to repay their borrowed money, but don't(pl) on_the_contrary foreclose on your(pl) companion descendants of Israil.

4 “Ware egkaayu-ayu kaniyu su egpanalanginan kew ma te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, diye te tane ne igbehey rin kaniyu, 5 ke egtumanen niyu te mapahetpet ka langun ne suhu din ne ingkahi ku kaniyu kuntee ne aldew. 6 Egpanalanginan kew iya te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu sumale te insaad din kaniyu; egpasambey kew te seleppi diye te duma ne nasud, piru kene kew mule egpanambey kandan. Egmanduan niyu ka masulug ne nasud, piru ware sabeka ne egpakamandu kaniyu.

4 “There (are/will_be) no poor among you(pl) because you(pl) will_be_blessed by the Lord God, there in the land that he will_give to_you(pl), 5 if you(pl) energetically obey all his commands that I told you(pl) this day. 6 You(pl) indeed will_be_blessed by the Lord who is your(pl) God according_to what_ he _promised you(pl); you(pl) will_lend(pl) money to other nations, but on_the_contrary you(pl) won't borrow(pl) from_them. You(pl) will_rule many nations, but not one will_be_able_to_rule you(pl).

7 [xr]“Ne emun due duma niyu ne me kabuhalan ni Israil ne egkaayu-ayu diye te sabeka te me lungsud diye te tane ne igbehey kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, kene kew ubag balibad ne egbulig kandan. 8 Ke kene, pamehayi niyu sikandan wey pasambaya niyu te egkeilanganen dan. 9 Ne kene kew suman-suman ne kene kew e egpasambey te duma niyu ne me kabuhalan ni Israil ne egkengaayu-ayu ke mahaan e ka igkapitu ne leg-un, ka leg-un ne kenad e egsukuten ka me utang, su emun egpangananey te Magbebaye ne Manama ka egkaayu-ayu tenged kaniyu, eg-isipen kew ne nakasale. 10 Behayi niyu sikandan ne egpuun te pusung niyu, wey kene kew sagsahukul, eyew egpanalanginan te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu ka langun ne eggimuwen niyu. 11 [xr]Due layun egkaayu-ayu wey egkengaware-ware diye te nasud niyu, purisu, migsuhu a kaniyu ne egbulihan niyu sikandan.”

7 [xr]“And if there's an descendant of Israil companion of yours(pl) that's poor there in one of the towns there in the land that the Lord who is your(pl) God will_give you(pl), don't [embarrassedly] disagree with helping them. 8 But rather, distribute(pl) to_them and loan(pl) (them) what_ they _need. 9 And don't(pl) think that you(pl) won't lend to your(pl) companion that's descendants of Israil who are_poor if the seventh year is_close, the year of not foreclosing debts, because if the poor make_requests to the Lord God due to_you(pl), you(pl) will_be_considered to_have_sinned. 10 Give(pl) to_them from your(pl) heart(s), and don't grumble, so_that all that_ you(pl) _do will_be_blessed by the Lord who is your(pl) God. 11 [xr]There will always poor and (one/ones) without_anything there in your(pl) nation, therefore, I commanded you(pl) that you(pl) help them.”

(Exo 21:1‑11)

The eldest cow(s) and sheep

19 [xr]Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Ilein niyu para te Magbebaye ne Manama ka langun ne panganey te me baka wey karniru niyu. Ne egkaayun man-e ne egkeen kayi ka langun ne etew—in-isip ma ne malindit wey se malinis, iling te egmangekeen kew te ngalap te usa. 23 [xr]Piru kene kew keen te langesa kayi; ulei niyu re seini diye te tane iling te weyig.”

Ka sahakeen te Peglihad te Panalihan

The feast of the Passing_by of the Angel

(Iks 12:1‑20)

(Exo 12:1‑20)

161 [xr]Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Sahakeen kew te Peglihad te Panalihan te bulan te Abib,[fn] isip pegdayan te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, su sika ne bulan ka pegpalihawang kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama puun te Ihiptu te timpu te marusilem. 2 Ne lape kew te karniru wey ke baka naa te timpu te pegsahakeen niyu te Peglihad te Panalihan. Seled te pitu ne aldew keen kew te paan ne ware patulin iling te inggimu niyu te timpu ne miggaan-gaan kew mig-awe te Ihiptu. Seini ka egpasuman-suman kaniyu te intiru ne umul niyu, te aldew ne iyan ka peg-awe niyu te Ihiptu. 4 Keilangan ne ware egkakita ne patulin diye te me baley niyu te intiru ne nasud te pitu ne aldew, wey keilangan ne kene niyu egpasimahan ka ngalap ne inlape niyu te pegkamarusilem te an-anayan ne aldew.

161 [xr]And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to by Muwisis, “Feast(pl) for the Passing_by of the Angel in the month of Abib,[fn] as praising the Lord your(pl) God, because that's the month of your(pl) being_brought_out by the Lord God from Ihiptu at night time. 2 And butcher(pl) a sheep or cow at the time that you(pl) feast the Passing_by of the Angel. Eat(pl) bread without rising_agent within seven days like (what) you(pl) did in the time when you(pl) hurriedly left Ihiptu. This (is what) reminds you(pl) of your(pl) entire life, the day that's when you(pl) left Ihiptu. 4 It's_necessary that no yeast be_seen there in your(pl) houses in the entire nation for seven days, and it's_necessary that you(pl) don't cause_to_remain_until_morning the meat that you(pl) butchered on the night of the first day.

5 “Ne kene niyu lapaa diye te minsan hendei ne me lungsud ne igbehey kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama, ka eglapeen te Sahakeen te Peglihad te Panalihan, 6 ke kene, diye de iya te inged ne eg-alamen te Magbebaye ne Manama eyew egsimbaan niyu kandin. Lapaa niyu seini ke eglineb e ka aldew iling te timpu te pegligkat niyu te Ihiptu. 7 Ne hilutua niyu wey keena niyu seini diye te inged ne eg-alamen te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. 5 “And don't(pl) butcher what_will_be_butchered for the Feast of the Passing_by of the Angel, there in wherever town that will_be_given to_you(pl) by the Lord God, 6 but rather, just there indeed in the place chosen by the Lord God in_order that he be_worshiped by_you(pl). Butcher(pl) this when the sun sets like the time of your(pl) leaving Ihiptu. 7 And cook(pl) and eat(pl) it there in the place chosen by the Lord your(pl) God. And return(pl) again there to your(pl) tents in_the_morning. 8 It's_necessary that for six days, you(pl) just eat bread without rising_agent. And on the seventh day, gather(pl) in_order for worshiping the Lord God, and don't(pl) work on that day.”

13 [xr]Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Sahakeen kew diye te me leeb taman te pitu ne aldew, te katammanan te tinggaani pegkeimpus niyu te egdiriek te trigu wey pegkekeles te behas te paras. 14 Ne gale-gale kew ka egsahakeen duma te me anak niyu ne me lukes wey me malitan, me suluhuanen niyu ne lukes wey me malitan, lagkes ka me Libita, me lapu, me ilu, wey me balu ne nangugpe diye te me lungsud niyu. 15 Gale-gale kew te seini ne Sahakeen isip pegdayan te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu diye te inged ne eg-alamen din, tenged te pegpanalangin din kaniyu te dakel ne uma, wey te pegpalampus din te langun ne himu niyu, eyew egkahale kew langun.

18 Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Alam kew te me talewukum wey me upisyal puun te tagse tribu niyu diye te me lungsud ne igbehey kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama. 21 [xr]“Ne kene kew pes-ek te sungkaleg ne palinneu te malitan ne manama ne si Asira diye te dangdang te altar ne eggimuwen niyu para te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, 22 [xr]wey kene kew pasasindeg te sungkaleg ne batu eyew egsimbeen, su ingkabelu sika te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu.”

21 [xr]“And don't(pl) put_in a post that's a sign of the female god Asira there lined_up with the altar that you(pl) will_make for the Lord your(pl) God, 22 [xr]and don't found(pl) a stone column in_order to_worship, because that makes_ the Lord your(pl) God _angry.”

Ka kene ne eleg ne igpanubad

171 Ne ingkahiyan ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Kene kew panubad te baka wey ke karniru naa ne tahapeil diye te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu su igkalindit din sika.

171 And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to by Muwisis, “Don't(pl) sacrifice a cow or a sheep that (has) defect there to the Lord who is your(pl) God because that's dirty to him.

2 “Ne emun diye te sabeka te me lungsud ne igbehey kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, due egkanengnengan niyu ne kabuhalan ni Israil, lukes wey ke malitan naa ne miggimu te mareet pinaahi te pegsupak din te balaud, 3 [xr]ne iyan ka pegpamakey wey pegsimba rin te lein ne me manama, aldew, bulan, me bituen—me himu ne ingkene te Magbebaye ne Manama— 4 keilangan ne egsusiyen niyu seini eg-ay-ayari. Ne emun malehet iya ne neyitabu seini se mareet ne himu diye te Israil, 5 uyana niyu diye te gumawan te lungsud ka etew ne miggimu kayi, wey bebatuwa niyu sikandin taman te egpatey. 6 [xr]Piru emun sabeka re ka talagpamalehet, kene sikandin egkaayun ne eggimatayan. Piru emun egkapamalehetan ne nakasale sikandin pinaahi te daruwa wey ke tatelu naa ne talagpamalehet, egkaayun sikandin ne eggimatayan. 7 [xr]Ne ka me talagpamalehet ka hun-a ne egbatu kandin, wey human pad degma ka me etew. Te sika ne paahi, egkaawe ka mareet ne himu due te kaniyu.

2 “And if there in one town that the Lord who is your(pl) God will_give you(pl), it becomes_known by_you(pl) that there's an descendant of Israil, male or female that's done evil by_means of his/her disobeying the law, 3 [xr]which (is) his/her serving or worshiping a different god, sun, moon, stars—acts which are_prohibited by the Lord God— 4 it's_necessary that this is_investigated carefully by_you(pl). And if it's true indeed that this evil act happened there in Israil, 5 bring(pl) the person who did this there to the doorway of the town, and stone(pl) him/her until (he/she) dies. 6 [xr]But if only one (is a) witness, it's_ not _possible that (he/she) be_killed. But if it's_proven that he/she sinned by_means of two or three witnesses, it's_possible that (he/she) be_killed. 7 [xr]And the witnesses (will be) the first to_stone him/her, and after that the people also. By that means, evil action(s) will_be_removed there from you(pl).

8 “Ne emun due kasu ne malised ne eggusayen te talewukum diye te sabeka ne lungsud, iling panunggilingan te kasu te peggimatey wey ke pegpeehetey wey ke pegpanlusud naa, uyana niyu seini ne kasu diye te inged ne eg-alamen te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. 9 Ne parani kew te me talagpanubad ne me Libita, wey diye te talewukum ne migpamakey te sika te timpu, wey egguhuran kew nikandan ke nekey ka igpekewukum dan. 10 Ne keilangan ne egdawaten niyu ke nekey ka igguhud dan kaniyu diye te inged ne eg-alamen te Magbebaye ne Manama, wey tumana niyu ka langun ne iglalag dan kaniyu. 11 Himuwa niyu te eleg ka langun ne igpanulu dan kaniyu ne igpeikul te balaud. Kene niyu supaka ke nekey ka iglalag dan kaniyu. 12 Ne ka minsan hentew ne kene egtuman te talagpanubad wey ke talewukum naa ne iyan migpamakey te sika ne timpu diye te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, keilangan ne eggimatayan; keilangan ne eg-aween niyu ka mareet ne himu puun te Israil. 13 Ne emun egpakanengneng ka duma ne me kabuhalan ni Israil meyitenged te seini, kenad e sikandan eg-abey egsupak.”

8 “And if there_is a case to_be_resolved by the judge there in one town, like for_example a case of killing or opposing_each_other or attacking, bring(pl) this case there to the place chosen by the Lord your(pl) God. 9 And approach(pl) the Libita sacrificers, and the judges who served at that time, and you(pl) will_be_storied(pl) by them what they will_be_judging. 10 And it's_necessary that you(pl) accept whatever they story you(pl) there in the place that's chosen by the Lord God, and obey everything that they tell you(pl). 11 Do(pl) correctly all that they teach you(pl) that (you) should_follow/imitate in the law. Don't(pl) disobey whatever they tell you(pl). 12 And who ever doesn't obey the sacrificer(s) or the judge (who is) serving the Lord who is your(pl) God at that time, it's_necessary that (he/she) be_killed; it's_necessary that you(pl) remove the evil action(s) from Israil. 13 And if the other descendants of Israil find_out about this, they will_ no_longer _repeat disobeying.”

Ka me pegpaney-paney te peg-alam te Hari

The warnings about choosing a king

14 [xr]Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Emun ke egpekeuma kew e diye te tane ne igbehey kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, wey egkaangken niyud seeye ne tane wey egpakasuman-suman kew ne eg-alam te Hari iling te me nasud ne nakalingut kaniyu, 15 keilangan ne ka eg-alamen niyu ne etew eyew eggimuwen ne Hari, sikan de se eg-alamen te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. Ne keilangan ne duma niyu re sikandin ne kabuhalan ni Israil—kene kew alam te lapu eyew iyan egmandu kaniyu. 16 [xr]Ne keilangan ne kene din egmasuluhen ka me kudde din, wey kene din egsuhuen ka me kabuhalan ni Israil ne eglibed diye te Ihiptu eyew egbebeli te me kudde, su ingkahiyan kew ma te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu te kene kew e egpaliberen diye. 17 [xra][xrb]Ne keilangan ne kene din egmasuluhen ka asawa rin, su kema ke eg-inniyug sikandin te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ne keilangan degma ne kene sikandin eglilimud te masulug ne seleppi wey bulawan.

14 [xr]And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to again by Muwisis, “When you(pl) arrived there in the land that will_be_given to_you(pl) by the Lord your(pl) God, and you(pl) accept/receive that land and you(pl) think_about choosing a king like the nations that surround you(pl), 15 it's_necessary that the person you(pl) will_choose in_order to_become king, (is) just the (one) chosen by the Lord who is your(pl) God. And it's_necessary that he/she (is) just an descendant of Israil companion of yours(pl)—don't(pl) choose a foreigner to rule you(pl). 16 [xr]And it's_necessary that he/she doesn't accumulate_many horses (for) him/herself, and he/she doesn't command the descendants of Israil to return there to Ihiptu in_order to_buy horses, because you(pl) were_told by the Lord your(pl) God that you(pl) were_ not _to_return there. 17 [xra][xrb]And it's_necessary that he/she doesn't accumulate_many spouse(s) (for) him/herself, because what if he/she turns_from the Lord God. And it's_necessary also_that he/she doesn't collect_together much money and gold.

18 “Ne emun egpinnuu e sikandin te trunu rin isip Hari, keilangan ne due kupiya rin te balaud wey me panulu te Manama, ne insulat puun te malehet ne kupiya ne impiyal diye te me talagpanubad ne Libita. 19 Ne keilangan ne eg-uy-uyanen din seini, wey layun din egbasaa te intiru ne umul rin, eyew egkateu sikandin ne egtahud te Magbebaye ne Manama rin, wey eg-ikulen din eg-ay-ayari ka langun ne inlalag te balaud. 20 Ne pinaahi degma te pegbasa rin layun te balaud, kene sikandin egpakasuman-suman ne labew sikandin te me karumaan din ne me kabuhalan ni Israil. Ne kene din man-e egkasupak ka Magbebaye ne Manama, wey eghari sikandin wey ka me kabuhalan din te Israil te egkaluhey.”

18 “And when he/she sits on his/her throne as king, it's_necessary that he has a copy of the law and teachings of God, that's written from the correct copy that's entrusted there to the Libita sacrificers. 19 And it's_necessary that he/she carry_ this _around, and he/she always reads (it) for his/her entire life, so_that he/she knows to_respect the Lord his/her God, and he/she carefully obeys all that's_said by the law. 20 And by_means of his/her always reading the law, he/she won't be_able_to_think that he/she is_above his/her companions descendants of Israil. And he/she also won't disobey the Lord God, and he/she and his/her descendants will_king over Israil for_a_long_time.”

Ka egkarawat te me talagpanubad

What_will_be_received by the sacrificers

181 Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Ka me talagpanubad ne me Libita wey ka duma ne sakup te me kabuhalan ni Libi, kene egbaaran te tane isip egkapanunud ne karatuan ne inggaat, iling te duma ne me kabuhalan ni Israil. Iyan dan de egkarawat ka me baad te egtutungen ne igpanubad niyu diye te Magbebaye ne Manama, wey ka duma pad ne ighalad niyu kandin; 2 [xr]ware ubag mule egkapanunud dan iling kaniyu te suled dan ne me kabuhalan ni Israil, su sumale te ingkahi kandan te Manama, iyan dan himu ka egpamakey isip me talagpanubad.

181 And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to again by Muwisis, “The Libita sacrificers and the other members of the descendants of Libi, won't be given_a_portion of land as an inheritance of wealth that's to remain, like the other descendants of Israil. What_ they _will_ just _receive (is) the portions of your(pl) burned sacrifices to the Lord God, and your(pl) other offerings to_him; 2 [xr]there's_no [embarrassedly] inheritance for_them like you(pl) their descendants of Israil siblings/cousins, because according to what_was_told to_them by God, (what will be) their work (is) serving as sacrificers.

3 “Ne puun te igpanubad niyu ne me baka wey me karniru, seini ka me baad ne para te me talagpanubad ne me Libita: ka pamanayen, ka bake, wey ka getek. 4 Ne ibehey niyu degma kandan ka an-anayan ne baad te me trigu niyu, iyam ne binu, lana te ulibu, wey ka bulbul te me karniru niyu, 5 su puun te langun ne tribu te Israil, ka me Libita ka in-alam te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu eyew egpamakey kandin isip me talagpanubad te ware egtamanan.

3 “And from your(pl) sacrifices of cows and sheep(pl), these (are) the portions for the Libita sacrificers: the shoulder, the jaw, and the stomach. 4 And also give(pl) them the first portion of your(pl) wheats, new wine, olive oil, and the hair/wool of your(pl) sheep(pl), 5 because from all the tribes of Israil, the Libitas (are) the (ones) chosen by your(pl) Lord who is your(pl) God in_order to serve him as sacrificers without ending.

6 “Ne ka minsan hentew ne Libita ne mig-ugpe diye te minsan hendei ne me lungsud te Israil, egkaayun degma ne eggendiye te inged ne eg-alamen te Manama, 7 wey egkaayun sikandin ne egpamakey te Manama rin, iling te duma rin ne me Libita ne migpamakey degma diye te tangkaan te Manama. 8 Ne egpakarawat degma sikandin te baad puun te me halad, minsan due egkarawat din ne seleppi puun te halin te karatuan te me pamilya rin.”

6 “And who ever Libita that lives there in what ever of the towns of Israil, it's_possible also to_go_there to the place chosen by God, 7 and it's_possible (that) he serve his God, like his companion Libitas that serve also there in front of God. 8 And he can_ also _receive portion(s) from offerings, even if there_is (some) money that_ he _receives from the sale of wealth from his family.”

Ka me pegpaney-paney te me himu ne igkeepes te Manama

The warnings about actions that are disliked by God

9 Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Emun egpekeuma kew e diye te tane ne igbehey kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, kene kew ikul te maddeet ne hinimuwan te me mahinged diye; 10 [xra][xrb]kene kew tutung te me anak niyu diye te altar, lukes ma wey se malitan isip igpanubad. Kene kew degma panagne, kene kew panlambus, kene kew panlumay, kene kew pahehane, 11 wey kene kew parani te me mammulingan 12 su egkalindit ka Magbebaye ne Manama te langun ne eggimu te sika ne me himu. Sika ka egpuunan ne egpandelrelen te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu ka keet-etawan te sika ne nasud ke egpalinggumaan kew e. 13 [xr]Keilangan ne ware igkarew-ey kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu.”

9 And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to again by Muwisis, “When you(pl) arrive there at the land that_ the Lord who is your(pl) God _will_give you(pl), don't follow/imitate the evil actions of the local_inhabitants there; 10 [xra][xrb]don't(pl) burn your(pl) children there on an altar, male or female as a sacrifice. Also don't(pl) predict, don't(pl) make_curses, don't(pl) make_love_potions, don't(pl) do magic, 11 and don't(pl) approach sorcerers/magicians 12 because the Lord feels_dirty at all who do those acts. That's the reason that your(pl) Lord who is your(pl) God will_drive_away(pl) the people of that nation when you(pl) arrive. 13 [xr]It's_necessary that there's_nothing for you(pl) to_be_scolded_for by your(pl) Lord who is your(pl) God.”

Ka saad te Manama ne egpeuyan te prupita

The promise of God to send a prophet

14 Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Ka keet-etawan ne egpandelrelen niyu, migparani te me manenagne wey te egmahehane. Piru kene egkeupian ka Manama niyu ne eggimuwen niyu sika. 15 [xr]Egpeuyan ka Manama niyu te prupita ne egpuun ded kaniyu, iling keddi, wey keilangan ne egtahuren niyu sikandin. 16 Sika ka imbuyu niyu diye te Manama niyu te timpu ne nanlibulung kew diye te Bubungan ne Sinay. Migkahi kew te, ‘Kene key e ubag parineha te laheng nu Manama ney wey ke egpapitawen key naa nikeykew te egkanlabkanlab ne hapuy nu su kema ke egkammatey key.’ 17 Purisu ingkahiyan a te Manama, ‘Eleg iya ka ingkahi ran. 18 Egpeuyan a te prupita iling keykew wey karumaan dan ded, eyew egpepangguhuren ku sikandin te langun ne iglalag ku kandan. 19 [xr]Ne egparusaan ku ka minsan hentew ne kene egpammineg te me lalag ku ne igguhud te prupita pinaahi te ngaran ku. 20 Piru ke egpangguhud ka prupita pinaahi te ngaran ku te ware ku ipahuhud kandin, wey ke egpangguhud naa sikandin pinaahi te ngaran te lein ne manama, ka sika ne prupita keilangan ne eggimatayan.’

14 And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to again by Muwisis, “The people that you(pl) will_drive_away(pl), approach fortune-tellers/sorcerers and magicians. But your(pl) God doesn't like you(pl) to_do that. 15 [xr]Your(pl) God will_send a prophet from you(pl) yourselves, like me, and it's_necessary that you(pl) respect him/her. 16 That (is) what_ you(pl) _requested from your(pl) God at the time that you(pl) were_gathered(pl) there at Mount Sinay. You(pl) said, ‘Don't(pl) [embarrassedly/please] let_ us(excl) _hear your(sg) voice God or show yourself to_us(excl) as blazing fire because what if we(excl) die.’ 17 Therefore I was_told by God, ‘What_ they _said (is) correct indeed. 18 I will_send a prophet like you(sg) and a relative of theirs, so_that I can_get_ him _to_story all that I will_tell them. 19 [xr]And I will_punish whoever doesn't listen to my words that are_storied by the prophet by_means of my name. 20 But if the prophet stories in my name about what_ I haven't _told_ him _to_say, or stories by_means of the name of a different god, it's_necessary that that prophet be_killed.’

21 “Ne emun eg-inse kew te, ‘Egmenuwen ney naa te egnengneng ne ka inlalag te prupita, kene egpuun te Manama?’ 22 Egkanengnengan niyu seini, su ke nekey ka igguhud te prupita pinaahi te ngaran te Manama, piru kene egkatuman, ka sika ne lalag kene naa egpuun te Manama; migpangguhud sikandin te kandin de ne katenged, purisu kene kew kaaldek kandin.”

21 “And if you(pl) ask, ‘How will_ we(excl) _know that what_ the prophet _said, wasn't from God?’ 22 Be_aware(pl) of this, because whatever is_storied_about by the prophet by_means of the name of God, but doesn't come_true, that word didn't come from God; he storied by just his authority, therefore don't(pl) be_afraid of him.”

Ka me aputanan ne siyudad

The city that's a fleeing_place

(Num 35:9‑28; Huswi 20:1‑9)

(Num 35:9‑28; Joshua 20:1‑9)

191 [xr]Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Ke egpangimatayan e te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu ka me mahinged diye te tane ne igbehey rin kaniyu, wey egkaddelrel niyud sikandan, wey egmangugpe kew e te me siyudad wey me baley ran, 2 baara niyu te tatelu ne distritu ka tane ne igbehey kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. 3 Ne teil kew te tigsabeka ne siyudad puun te tagse distritu eyew eggimuwen ne aputanan. Ne pangay-ayari niyu ka me kelesadda peendiye te sika ne me siyudad, 4 eyew ka minsan hentew ne egpakapatey te duma rin te ware din tuyui, wey ware din dumuti, egkaayun ne eg-aput te sabeka te seini ne me siyudad ne aputanan, eyew ware minsan hentew ne egpekeyilabet kandin. 5 Ne panunggilingan ke due daruwa ne etew ne migparumeey diye te puwalas eyew egpameled te kayu; taheed te migpepetpet ka sabeka, napesuk ka wasey rin wey nasuhat mule ka duma rin wey migpatey e, egkaayun sikandin ne eg-aput te sabeka te seini ne me siyudad ne aputanan, eyew ware minsan hentew ne egpekeyilabet kandin. 6 Piru ke sabeka re ka siyudad ne aputanan, wey mariyu seini te etew ne nakapatey, wey egkalupug sikandin te egkeupian ne egsuli kandin tenged te langet, egkapatey iya sikandin. Ne kene ma perem ne eleg ne eggimatayan sikandin su ware din ma tuyui te eggimatey ka duma rin wey ke indumutan din naa. 7 Sikan naa ka insuhu ku sikaniyu ne egteil te tatelu ne aputanan ne me siyudad.

191 [xr]And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to again by Muwisis, “When the Lord who is your(pl) God kills the local_inhabitants there in the land that he will_give you(pl), and he's driven_ them _out, and you(pl) live(pl) in their cities and houses, 2 divide_up(pl) into three districts the land that the Lord your(pl) God will_give you(pl). 3 And arrange(pl) one_each city from each district in_order to_become a fleeing_place. And tidy_up(pl) the roads going_there to that cities, 4 so_that who ever (accidentally)_kills his/her companion without intending_to, and he/she doesn't hate (him/her), it's_possible to_flee to one of these cities that's a fleeing_place, so_that no (one) can_affect him/her. 5 And for_example of there's two people who are_accompanying_each_other there in_order to_fell tree(s); while one chops, his axe pulls_apart and his/her companion is_hit and dies, it's_possible that he/she flees to one of these cities that's a fleeing_place, so_that no_(one) can_affect him/her. 6 But if there (was) just one city that's a fleeing_place, and it's distant from the person who (accidentally)_killed, and he/she is_chased by the (one who) wants to_avenge him/her due to anger, he/she indeed will_die. And it's not right that he/she be_killed because he/she had_no intention to_kill his/her companion or hated (him/her). 7 That's why I commanded you(pl) to arrange for three cities that's a fleeing_place.

8 “Ne emun egmaluahen e te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu ka tane niyu sumale te insaad din te me kaap-apuan niyu, wey egkaangken niyud ka intiru ne Inged ne Insaad din kandan, 9 timul kew teil te lein ne tatelu ne siyudad. Igbehey rin iya kaniyu ka intiru ne tane ke egtumanen niyu ka langun ne suhu ne ingkahi ku kaniyu kuntee, ne eggeyinawaan niyu ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, wey eg-ikulen niyu ka langun ne igpeyimu rin. 10 Himuwa niyu seini eyew ware egkapatey ne etew ne ware sale diye te tane niyu, wey eyew kene kew eg-isipen ne nakasale puun te kamatayen te etew ne ware sale.

8 “And when the Lord who is your(pl) God widens your(pl) land according to what he promised to your(pl) ancestors, and you(pl) have_received the entire Place(s) that he Promised them, 9 add(pl) arranging a different three cities. He will_give to_you(pl) the entire land if you(pl) obey all the commands that I have_told you(pl) now/today, and you(pl) love the Lord your(pl) God, and you(pl) follow/imitate all that he has_asked_to_be_done. 10 Do(pl) this so_that there's_no person who dies that's without sin there in your(pl) land, and so_that you(pl) won't be_considered as having_sinned (from) the death of a person that had_no sin.

11 “Piru ke indumutan te sabeka ne etew ka duma rin, wey in-atangan din seini wey inggimatayan din, wey mig-aput sikandin te sabeka te seini ne me aputanan ne me siyudad, 12 keilangan ne igpaangey sikandin te me igdatu te siyudad din, wey egpeyimatayan te seeye se egkeupian ne egsuli kandin. 13 Kene kew keyid-u kandin. Keilangan ne eglinisan niyu ka Israil te sale ne iyan ka peggimatey te etew ne ware sale, eyew egmeupiya ka peg-ugpe niyu.

11 “But if one person hates his companion, and he/she lies_in_wait_for him/her and he/she kills_(him/her), and he/she flees to one of these cities that's a fleeing_place, 12 it's_necessary that he/she is_fetched by the elders of his/her city, and put_to_death by those who want to revenge him/her. 13 Don't(pl) have_sympathy for_him/her. It's_necessary that you(pl) clean Israil from the sin that's the killing of people without sin, so_that your(pl) living will_be_good.

Ka me daan ne palinneu te eletanan

The old sign of a boundary

14 [xr]“Ne kene niyu halina ka palinneu te eletanan te tane te duma niyu ne impes-ek te hun-a pad ne me kabuhalan diye te inged ne igbehey kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu.”

14 [xr]“And don't(pl) move the sign of a boundary of the land of your(pl) companion that was_put_in by earlier descendants there in the place that the Lord your(pl) God will_give you(pl).”

Ka meyitenged te me talagpamalehet

Concerning witnesses

15 [xr]Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Kene kew hukum ne nakasale ka sabeka ne etew tenged de te sabeka ne talagpamalehet; keilangan iya ne daruwa wey ke tatelu naa ka egpamalehet ne nakasale ka sabeka ne etew. 16 Ne emun eg-uubat diye te hukumanan ka sabeka ne talagpamalehet ne nakasale ka sabeka ne etew, 17 pasasindeha niyu sikandan se daruwa diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama, te me talagpanubad, wey te me talewukum. 18 Ne keilangan ne eg-ay-ayaran te me talewukum te eg-ugsi-ugsi ke kene naa ne ubat ka sumbung te talagpamalehet. Ne emun egkanengnengan ne ubat ka pegpamalehet din meyitenged te sabeka ne etew, 19 himuwa niyu diye te kandin ka igkeupii rin perem ne eggimuwen diye te sabeka ne etew. Keilangan ne eg-aween niyu ka mareet ne hinimuwan due te kaniyu, 20 eyew ke egpakanengneng ka duma ne me kabuhalan ni Israil meyitenged te seini, egkaaldek e sikandan, wey warad minsan hentew kaniyu ne eg-abey eggimu te iling due. 21 [xr]Keilangan ne kene kew egkeyimenawan; ke nakapatey ka etew te duma rin, eggimatayan degma sikandin; ke nakabutud sikandin, egbuturan degma sikandin; ke nakabingew sikandin, egbingawan degma sikandin; ke nakahepu sikandin te belad wey ke paa naa te duma rin, eggepuen degma ka belad wey ke paa rin naa.”

15 [xr]And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to again by Muwisis, “Don't(pl) judge that one person has_sinned due to just one witness; it's_necessary indeed that two or three witness that the one person has_sinned. 16 And if one witness lies there in the judging_place that one person has_sinned, 17 stand(pl) those two there in front of the Lord God, of the sacrificers, and of the judges. 18 And it's_necessary that the judges carefully investigate whether the report of the witness (is) not a lie. And if it_becomes_known that his witnesses (is a) lie concerning that one person, 19 do(pl) to him/her what_ he/she _wanted hopefully to_be_done to that one person. It's_necessary that you(pl) remove evil actions from among you(pl), 20 so_that if the other descendants of Israil find_out about this, they will_be_afraid, and no_(one) (else) of you(pl) will_repeat doing like that. 21 [xr]It's_necessary that you(pl) don't show_mercy; if a person has_killed his/her companion, he/she will_ also _be_killed; if he/she has_blinded, he/she will_ also _be_blinded; if he/she has_knocked_out_teeth, he/she will_ also _have_teeth_knocked_out; if he/she has_broken the arm or leg of his/her companion, his/her arm or leg will_ also _be_broken.”

Ka me balaud te gira

The laws of war

201 “Ne emun ke egpakiggira kew e te me kuntere niyu, wey egkakita niyu ka me kudde dan, me karwahi, wey me sundalu ran ne masmasulug pad kaniyu, kene kew kaaldek kandan, su egdumaan kew te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu ne migpalihawang kaniyu puun te Ihiptu. 2 Te kene kew pad egbunsud ka egpakiggira te me kuntere niyu, egsasindeg diye te katangkaan niyu ka talagpanubad, wey egkahiyan din ka keet-etawan, 3 ‘Pammineg kew me kabuhalan ni Israil. Kuntee ne aldew, egpakiggira kew te kuntere niyu, piru kene kew kaaldek kandan. Panimbulut kew wey kene kew paliliyas, 4 su egdumaan kew te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. Eglapihan kew nikandin; sikandin ka egpakig-ehet te me kuntere niyu wey egpepanaluwen kew nikandin.’

201 “And when you(pl) warring your(pl) enemies, and you(pl) see their horses, chariots, and their soldiers that (are) many_more than you(pl), don't(pl) be_afraid of_them, because you(pl) will_be_accompanied by the Lord your(pl) God that brought_ you(pl) _out from Ihiptu. 2 Before you(pl) begin warring your(pl) enemies, the sacrificer will_stand(sg) there at your(pl) front, and the people will_be_told by_him/her, 3 ‘Listen(pl) descendants of Israil. Today, you(pl) will_warring your(pl) enemies, but don't(pl) be_afraid of_them. Be_bold(pl) and don't(pl) be_cowardly, 4 because you(pl) will_be_accompanied by the Lord your(pl) God. You(pl) will_be_favored by_him; he (will be) the (one who) will_attack your(pl) enemies and you(pl) will_be_made_victorious by_him.’

5 “Ne egkahiyan degma te me upisyal ka me sundalu, ‘Ke due kuntee sabeka kaniyu ne sikan pad nekeimpus te baley rin, wey ware din pad seini ihalad diye te Magbebaye ne Manama, peulia niyu pa sikandin su kema ke egkapatey sikandin diye te bunuanan, wey iyan e mule eghalad te baley rin ka lein ne etew. 6 Ne ka seeye se migpamula te paras wey ware pad nakakeen te behas kayi, egkaayun ne eg-uli pad sikandin, su kema ke egkapatey sikandin diye te bunuanan, wey lein e mule ne etew ka egpakakeen te behas kayi. 7 Ne ke hentew seeye se mahaan e egkasala, egkaayun ne eg-uli pad sikandin, su kema ke egkapatey sikandin diye te bunuanan, wey lein e mule ne etew ka egpakapangasawa te eg-asaween din.’

5 “And the soldiers were_spoken_to also by the officials, ‘If there's one of_you(pl) now/today that's just finished his house, and he has not yet dedicated (it) to the Lord God, send(pl)_ him _home because what if he dies there at the fighting_place, and the (one who) dedicates his house on_the_contrary (is) another person. 6 And the (one who) planted grapevines and hasn't yet eat their fruit, it's_possible that he return_home, because what if he dies there at the fighting_place, and a different person on_the_contrary eats its fruit. 7 And whoever soon to_be_married, it's_possible that he return_home, because what if he dies there at the fighting_place, and a different person on_the_contrary (is) the (one who) marries his fiancée.’

8 “Ne egkahi pad man-e ka me upisyal, ‘Ke hentew seeye se naaldek, egkaayun sikandin ne eg-uli su kema ke egkaaldek e degma kangkuwa ka me duma rin.’ 9 Ne emun egpekeimpus e ka me upisyal ne eglalag te me sundalu, eg-alam e sikandan te me kumandir ne egpangulu te me sundalu.

8 “And the officials will_say also, ‘Whoever is_afraid, it's_possible that he return_home because what if his companions also become_afraid later.’ 9 And when the officials have_finished speaking to the soldiers, they will_choose commanders to_lead the soldiers.

10 “Ne emun eglusuran niyu ka sabeka ne siyudad, behayi niyu pa hun-eyi te timpu ne eggural ka me mahinged. 11 Ne emun eggural sikandan, wey eglukatan dan ka gumawan te siyudad, wey egpaseleren kew nikandan, himuwa niyu sikandan langun ne me suluhuanen niyu; pehesa niyu sikandan patrabahuwa para kaniyu. 12 Piru ke kene sikandan eggural su nasi egpakig-ehet kaniyu, palinguti niyu nasi sikandan te me sundalu. 13 Ne emun igbehey e sikandan te Magbebaye ne Manama kaniyu, pangimatayi niyu ka langun ne lukes, 14 piru pandakepa niyu ka langun ne malitan, me bate, wey panguripena niyu. Ne panuyuka niyu ka me ayam, wey pangua niyu ka langun ne karatuan dan. Gale-gale kew te langun ne naahew niyu puun te me kuntere niyu ne imbehey kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. 15 Sika himuwa niyu te langun ne me siyudad ne diye te mariyu, wey kene ne kaluahan te tane ne eg-angkenen niyu.

10 “And if you(pl) invade a (LIT one) city, first give(pl) the local_inhabitants time to_surrender. 11 And if they surrender, and they open the gateway of the city, and you(pl) are_invited_in by_them, make(pl) them your(pl) servants; persuade(pl) them to_work for you(pl). 12 But if they don't surrender because instead they attack you(pl), surround(pl) them instead with the soldiers. 13 And when they are_given by the Lord God to_you(pl), kill(pl) all the males, 14 but capture(pl) all the women, children, and enslave(pl) (them). And lead_away their domestic_animals, and take(pl) all their wealth. Be_happy(pl) about all that_ you(pl) _snatched from your(pl) enemies that were_given to_you(pl) by the Lord who is your(pl) God. 15 Do(pl) that to all cities that (are) distant, and not (in) the width of the land that you(pl) will_receive.

16 “Piru ke egkaahew niyud ka me siyudad diye te tane ne igbehey kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, keilangan ne egpangimatayan niyu ka langun ne etew wey me ayam. 17 Gulaa niyu ka me Hitihanen, me Amurihanen, me Kanaanen, me Pirisihanen, me Hibihanen, wey me Hibusihanen sumale te insuhu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, 18 eyew kene kew nikandan egkapanulu te pegsimba te me manama ran, wey eyew kene kew egpakasale te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu.

16 “But when you(pl) snatch the cities there in the land that I the Lord who is your(pl) God will_give to_you(pl), it's_necessary that you(pl) kill(pl) all the people and the domestic_animals. 17 Exterminate(pl) the Hitihanons, the Amurihanons, the Kanaanons, the Pirisihanons, the Hibihanons, and the Hibusihanons according to what_was_commanded by the Lord your(pl) God, 18 so_that you(pl) aren't taught by_them about worship their gods, and so_that you(pl) don't sin against the Lord your(pl) God.

19 “Ne emun egkaluhey ka peglingut niyu te siyudad, kene niyu pamelera ka me kayu diye eyew egkakeen niyu ka me behas kayi; timul pad, kene ne kuntere niyu ka me kayu ne eleg ne egdereetan niyu. 20 Piru pamelera niyu mule ka me kayu ne kene egkakeen se me behas, wey himuwa niyu seini ne me kasangkapan te peglingut niyu te me kuntere niyu taman te egkaahew niyu ka siyudad.”

19 “And if your(pl) surrounding the city takes_a_long_time, don't(pl) chop_down(pl) the trees there so_that you(pl) can_eat the fruit of them; in addition, the trees aren't your(pl) enemies that (are) correct/worthy to_be_destroyed by_you(pl). 20 But on_the_contrary chop_down(pl) the trees that the fruit can't be_eaten, and make(pl) them furniture/utensils in your(pl) surrounding your(pl) enemies until the city is_snatched by_you(pl).”

Ka peggusey te innimatayan te heles de

The reconciling of a killing that's just secret

211 Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Panunggilingan ke diye te tane ne igbehey kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, due nakita niyu ne etew ne inggimatayan ne nekeyibat diye te tane, wey ware niyu nanengnengi ke hentew ka miggimatey kandin, 2 keilangan ne egsekeren te me igdatu wey me talewukum niyu, ke hendei ne me lungsud ka madmarani te natahuan te etew ne inggimatayan. 3 Ne ka me igdatu te siyudad ne madmarani te natahuan te etew ne inggimatayan, egkuwa te beyan ne nati ne baka ne ware pad anak wey ware pad idaru.[fn] 4 Ne eg-uyanen dan seini diye te mapatag ne tane ne ware de due ken-u nadaru wey napamulei, wey due me weyig ne kene egkeet-etiyan. Ne eggepuen dan ka lieg te nati ne baka. 5 Ne keilangan degma ne eggendiye ka talagpanubad ne me Libita, su in-alam ma sikandan te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu eyew egpamakey wey egpanalangin pinaahi te ngaran te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ne pinaahi te eglalahen dan, egkewusey ka me apulan wey pegpanlusud. 6 Ne ka langun ne igdatu te siyudad ne madmarani te natahuan te etew ne inggimatayan, egpanlu-lu te me belad dan diye te dibabew te nati ne baka ne inggepu se lieg. 7 Ne egkahi sikandan, ‘Kene ne sikanami ka miggimatey te seini ne etew, wey ware key degma nakakita ke hentew ka miggimatey kandin. 8 He Magbebaye ne Manama, pasayluwa nu ka me kabuhalan ni Israil ne impalihawang nu puun te Ihiptu wey kene key re ubag nikeykew pakasala-a te kamatayen te seini se etew ne ware sale.’ Ne warad egpatabaken dan te kamatayen te sika ne etew. 9 Pinaahi te pegtuman niyu te seini ne suhu, kene kew eg-isipen ne nakasale te kamatayen te etew ne ware sale su inggimu niyu ma ke nekey ka matareng diye te Magbebaye ne Manama.”

211 And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to again by Muwisis, “For_example if there in the land that the Lord your(pl) God will_give to_you(pl), there_is a person that you(pl) see that was_killed that's lying on the ground, and you(pl) don't know who killed him, 2 it's_necessary that your(pl) elders and judges measure, which city (is) closest to the placement of the person that was_killed. 3 And the elders of the city that's near the placement of the person that was_killed, will_get a female young cow that hasn't given_birth and has_not yet plowed.[fn] 4 And they will_bring it there to flat land that has never been_plowed or planted, and there_are rivers that don't dry_up. And they will_break_off the neck of the cow calf. 5 And it's_necessary also the Libita sacrificers go_there, because they have_been_chosen by the Lord your(pl) God in_order to_serve and bless in the name of the Lord God. And by_means of what_ they _say, the (one/ones) arguing will_be_resolved and invading(pl). 6 And all the elders of the city that (are) near the placement of the person that was_killed, will_wash their hands/arms there above the cow calf whose neck was_broken_off. 7 And they will_say, ‘It's not us(excl) who killed this person, and we(excl) also don't know who killed him/her. 8 Oh Lord God, forgive(sg) the descendants of Israil that you(sg) brought_out from Ihiptu and don't [embarrassedly/please] call_ us(excl) _sinners for the death of this person with_no sin.’ And they will_ no_longer _have_to_answer for the death of that person. 9 By_means of your(pl) obeying this command, you(pl) won't be_considered as having_sinned for the death of the person with_no sin because you(pl) did what (was) righteous/sensible there to the Lord God.”

Ka pegsahipe te me malitan ne naddakep

The welcoming females that were_captured

10 Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Ke egpakiggira kew te me kuntere niyu, wey igbehey sikandan te Magbebaye ne Manama kaniyu, wey egpandakepen niyu sikandan, 11 ke due nakita niyu ne mateles ne malitan ne duma te impandakep niyu, wey neupian kew kandin, wey ingkeupii niyu te egpangasawa, 12 egkaayun ne egdumeen niyu sikandin diye te baley niyu, wey tabuluhi niyu sikandin, wey panempuhi niyu ka me sulu rin. 13 Ne liwani niyu ka ingkukumbale din te pegkarakep kandin. Ne keilangan ne eg-uugpe ka malitan diye te baley niyu te sabeka ne bulan taheed te eglungku sikandin para te amey wey iney rin. Pegkeimpus due, egkaayun e ne eg-asaween niyu sikandin. 14 Piru te katamanan, ke warad eyam niyu te malitan, keilangan ne egtuhutan niyu sikandin ne eggipanew minsan hendei eggendiye. Kene niyu sikandin ibelegye wey ke eg-uripenen naa, su nabaley-baley niyud ma sikandin.”

10 And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to again by Muwisis, “If you(pl) warring your(pl) enemies, and they are_given to_you(pl) by the Lord God, and they are_captured(pl) by_you(pl), 11 if you(pl) see a beautiful woman along_with (those) captured(pl) by_you(pl), and you(pl) desire her, and you(pl) want to marry (her), 12 it's_possible that you(pl) accompany her there to your(pl) house, and you(pl) shave_ her _head, and you(pl) cut(pl) her nails. 13 And change(pl) what_ she _was_wearing when she was_captured. And it's_necessary that the woman live there at your(pl) house for one month while she mourns for her father and mother. After that, it's_possible that you(pl) marry her. 14 But finally, if you(pl) have_no_more feeling for the woman, it's_necessary that you(pl) permit her to travel going any where. Don't(pl) sell her or enslave (her), because you(pl) have demeaned her.”

Ka egkapanunud te kinakakayan ne anak ne lukes

The inheritance of the eldest male child

15 Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Ke due sabeka ne etew ne daruwa se asawa—inggeyinawaan din ka sabeka, wey ka sabeka ware, wey neelin ne due me anak din ne me lukes te daruwa ne asawa rin. Ke iyan nakaanak te kinakakayan ka asawa rin ne ware din geyinawei, 16 ke egba-baaren din e ka karatuan din diye te me anak din, keilangan ne ka baad ne para te kinakakayan ne anak, kene din igbehey diye te anak te inggeyinawaan din ne asawa rin. Ke kene, diye din seini igbehey te kinakakayan ne anak te dangeb ne asawa rin ne ware din geyinawei. 17 Keilangan ne eg-ileen din isip kinakakayan ne anak din ka anak ne lukes te asawa rin ne ware din geyinawei, wey keilangan ne eglupien din te kararuwa ka baad ne igbehey rin puun te karatuan din, su anak din ma sikandin, wey due katenged din ne egdawat te baad din isip kinakakayan ne anak ne lukes.”

15 And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to again by Muwisis, “For_example if there (is) one person with two spouses—he loves the one, and not the one, and all of his two spouses have his children. For_example if his spouse that he doesn't love borne the eldest male children, 16 if he divides(pl) his wealth to his children, it's_necessary that the portion that's for (the) eldest child, won't be_given by him to the child of his spouse that he loves. But rather, this will_be_given by him to the eldest child of his other spouse that he doesn't love. 17 It's_necessary that he recognizes the male child of his spouse that he doesn't love as his eldest child, and it's_necessary that he will_fold into two the portion that he will_give from his wealth, because it's his child [emphasis], and he has authority to receive his portion as the eldest male child.”

Ka masinupaken ne anak

The disobedient child

18 Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Emun due anak ne makehal se ulu, kene egtuman te amey wey iney minsan pad egparusaan sikandin piru kene iya egpammineg, 19 eg-uyanen sikandin te amey wey iney rin diye te tangkaan te me igdatu ne diye te gumawan te siyudad ne in-ugpaan din, 20 wey egguhuran dan ka me igdatu te egkahi, ‘Makehal se ulu te seini se anak ney, wey masinupaken, eg-usal-usal te seleppi, wey talewubug.’ 21 Ne egkataman, egbebatuwen sikandin te langun ne mahinged te siyudad taman te egpatey sikandin. Te sika ne paahi, egkalinisan niyu ka siyudad niyu te langun ne mareet ne hinimuwan. Ne emun egpakanengneng ka duma ne me kabuhalan ni Israil meyitenged te neyitabu, egkaaldek e sikandan ne eggimu te iling due ne himu.

18 And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to again by Muwisis, “If there_is a child whose head is hard, don't obey father and mother even if he/she is_punished but doesn't indeed listen, 19 he/she will_be_brought by his/her father and mother there to the front of the elders there at the doorway of the city that he/she lives_in, 20 and they will_story the elders saying, ‘This our(excl) child (has) a hard head, and is_disobedient, spender of money, and a drunkard.’ 21 And then, he/she will_be_stoned by all the local_inhabitants of the city until he/she dies. By this means, you(pl) will_clean your(pl) city from all evil actions. And if the other descendants of Israil find_out concerning what_happened, they will_be_afraid to do acts like that.

22 “Ke egparusaan te kamatayen ka sabeka ne etew tenged te sale ne neyimu rin, wey egbitinen sikandin diye te kayu, 23 [xr]keilangan ne kene egkapawaan ka lawa rin diye te imbitinan kandin. Keilangan ne iglebeng sikandin te sikan ded ne aldew, su ka egbitinen, indilus te Manama. Kene niyu linditi ka tane ne igbehey kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu isip karatuan ne inggaat ne egkapanunud niyu.”

22 “If one person is punished by death due to the sin that he/she has_done, and he/she is hung there on/from a tree, 23 [xr]it's_necessary that his/her body is_ not _left_overnight there where_ he/she _is_hanging. It's_necessary that he/she is_buried on that same day, because hanging, is_cursed by God. Don't(pl) dirty the ground that was_given to_you(pl) by the Lord who is your(pl) God as wealth that remains as your(pl) inheritance.”

Ka duma pad ne balaud

Other law(s)

221 [xr]Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Ke egkakita niyu ne nakaawe ka baka wey ke karniru naa te duma niyu, kene niyu seini balahara re, ke kene, tuyuka niyu seini wey ilibed niyu diye te kamuney. 2 Piru ke mariyu ka ugpaan te kamuney wey ke ware kew naa nekeila, tuyuka niyu ka ayam diye te baley niyu. Ne emun eglepew ka kamuney ne egpamitew, ibehey niyu seini kandin. 3 Sika degma himuwa niyu te asnu wey ke manggad naa te duma niyu wey te minsan nekey ne nalaag ne kandin—kene niyu seini balahara re.

221 [xr]And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to again by Muwisis, “If you(pl) see a cow or sheep of your(pl) companions that got_loose, don't(pl) ignore it, but rather, lead(pl) and return(pl) it there to the owner. 2 But if the living_place of the owner (is) distant and you(pl) don't know (him/it), lead(pl) the domestic_animal there to your(pl) house. And if the owner appears looking_for (it), give(pl) it to_him. 3 Do(pl) that also for a donkey or clothing of your(pl) companion or whatever is_lost that's his/hers—don't(pl) just ignore it.

4 “Ne emun egkakita niyu ne nakabuluku de diye te dalan ka asnu wey ke baka naa te duma niyu, kene niyu seini balahara re, ke kene, bulihi niyu ka kamuney ne egpasasindeg kayi.

4 “And if you(pl) see a donkey or a cow just curled_up there on the road/path, don't(pl) just ignore it, but rather, help(pl) the owner to get_ it _standing.

5 “Ka malitan keilangan ne kene egsaluub te kumbale te lukes wey ke egsaluub naa degma ka lukes te kumbale te malitan, su igkalindit te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu ka eggimu te iling due.

5 “It's_necessary that the female doesn't dress in clothing of male(s) nor the male dress in clothing of female(s), because doing like that makes_ the Lord your(pl) God _feel_dirty.

6 “Ke egpakakita kew te salag te bayaku diye te kayu ne diye te ilis te dalan wey ke diye naa te tane, wey due me pispis wey ke me atelug naa ne in-elenan te iney, kene niyu dakepa ka iney. 7 Egkaayun ne egkuen niyu ka me pispis wey ke me atelug naa, piru ipaawe niyu re ka iney. Ke eggimuwen niyu sika, egmeupiya ka peg-ugpe niyu wey egmalayat ka umul niyu.

6 “If you(pl) see the nest of a bird there in a tree there at the edge of the road/path or there on the ground, and there_are chicks or eggs being_sat_on by the mother, don't(pl) capture the mother. 7 It's_possible that you(pl) take the chicks or the eggs, but send_away(pl) the mother. If you(pl) do that, your(pl) living will_be_good and your(pl) live(s) will_be_lengthened.

8 “Ke egbebaley kew, keilangan ne egpalingutan niyu te ig-elet ka diye te atep,[fn] eyew kene kew egpakasale ke due etew ne egkeulug puun te atep niyu wey egpatey.

8 “If you(pl) are_house_building, it's_necessary that you(pl) surround the roof,[fn] with a barrier so_that you(pl) won't sin if there's a person that falls from your(pl) roof and dies.

9 [xr]“Kene niyu pamulei te lein ne beni ka parasan niyu. Ke eggimuwen niyu sika, ka langun ne behas te sika ne pinamula lagkes ka me behas te paras ne impamula niyu, egmalindit e.

9 [xr]“Don't(pl) plant other seeds in your(pl) vineyard(s). If you(pl) do that, all the fruit of that crop including the fruits of the grapevine(s) that_ you(pl) _planted, will_become_unclean.

10 “Kene niyu pegparisa te egdaru ka baka wey asnu.

10 “Don't(pl) pair the cow and donkey to plow.

11 “Kene kew saluub te kumbale puun te bulbul wey te hinabel ne impegsaamul te eggimu.

11 “Don't(pl) wear clothing from hair/wool and woven_cloth that are made mixed_together.

12 [xr]“Himuwi niyu te me palungpung ka hep-at ne pikungan te me sidsid te hinabel ne igkukuyumbu niyu.”

12 [xr]“Make(pl) pompoms on the four corners of the hem of woven_cloth that_ you(pl) _wrap_in.”

Ka me balaud meyitenged te bansa

The laws concerning honor

13 Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Panunggilingan ke mig-asawa ka sabeka ne lukes, wey te pegkeimpus dan te migpewulirey se alunggun, insamsamilian e te lukes ka malitan, 14 wey insalupetan din e te migkahi, ‘Ka seini se impangasawa ku ne malitan, nanengnengan ku ne neyilabetan bes e te lein te pegpewulirey ney.’ 15 Ne ka amey wey iney te malitan, eggendiye te me igdatu ne diye te gumawan te lungsud, wey eg-uyan sikandan te kamalehetan ne ware pad neyilabeti ka anak dan. 16 Ne egkahi ka amey diye te me igdatu, ‘Impaasawa ku ka anak ku te seini ne lukes, piru insamsamilian din e. 17 Impeyilawan din wey insalupetan ne duen kun e nekeyilabet te anak ku. Piru seini red ka egpamalehet ne ware pad neyilabeti ka anak ku.’ Ne egbelaten dan diye te tangkaan te me igdatu ka manggad ne due langesa ne inhibatan te alunggun. 18 Ne keilangan ne egdakepen te me igdatu ka lukes wey egparusaan. 19 Ne egmultaan dan pad iya man-e sikandin te sabeka ne gatus (100) ne buuk ne seleppi ne pelata, wey igbehey seini diye te amey te malitan tenged te pegpeyilew rin te telek ne mengebay ne kabuhalan ni Israil. Ne keilangan ne kene din iya eg-engkeran ka asawa rin te intiru ne umul rin.

13 And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to again by Muwisis, “For_example if a (LIT one) male marries, after the couple have laid_together, he rejects the woman, 14 and he falsely_accuses (her) saying, ‘This woman that I married, I discovered at our(excl) lying_together that she had_been_sexually_used by another.’ 15 And the father and mother of the woman, will_go_there to the elders there at the doorway of the town, and they will_bring proof that their child was_not_yet messed_with_sexually. 16 And the father will_say there to the elders, ‘I married_off my child to this male, but (she's) been_rejected by_him. 17 He shamed (her) and falsely_accused that there_is (someone who) [reportedly] messed_with my child. But this just proves that my child had_not been_messed_with.’ And they will_unroll there in front of the elders the cloth that has blood that was_laid_on by the couple. 18 And it's_necessary that the male be_captured by the elders and punished. 19 And they will_ indeed also _fine him one hundred (100) pieces of silver money, and it will_be_given there to the father of the female due to his being_shamed about the pure/genuine descendant of Israil young_women. And it's_necessary that he indeed doesn't leave his wife for his entire life.

20 “Piru ke malehet ka ingkahi te lukes wey ware igpakapapitew ne kamalehetan ne ware pad neyilabeti ka malitan, 21 keilangan ne eg-uyanen sikandin diye te gumawan te baley te amey rin wey igpabatu sikandin te me etew taman te egpatey sikandin, su impeyilawan din ma ka Israil pinaahi te pegpeyilabet din te ware pad sikandin nakaasawa, wey te miglemung pad sikandin te amey wey iney rin. Te sika ne paahi, egkaawe niyu ka mareet ne hinimuwan due te kaniyu.
