20 “But if what_ the male _said (is) true/correct and no proof can_be_shown that the female wasn't messed_with before, 21 it's_necessary that she be_brought there to the doorway of the house of her father and she will_be_stoned by the people until she dies, because she shamed Israil by_means of her being_messed_with before she married, and when she still lived_with her father and mother. By that means, you(pl) will_remove evil action(s) from (among) you(pl).

22 “Ke egkasapenan ka sabeka ne lukes ne miggilabet te asawa te lein ne lukes, sikandan se daruwa, keilangan ne eggimatayan eyew egkalinisan niyu ka Israil puun te mareet ne hinimuwan.

22 “If a (LIT one) male is_caught messing_with the spouse of a different male, those two, it's_necessary that they're killed so_that you(pl) can_clean Israil from evil action(s).

23 “Ke egkasapenan ka sabeka ne lukes ne miggilabet te mengebay ne mahaan e egkasala wey neyitabu seini diye te siyudad, 24 keilangan ne eg-uyanen niyu sikandan se daruwa diye te gumawan te siyudad, wey bebatuwa niyu sikandan taman te egpatey. Eggimatayan ka malitan su minsan diye sikandin te lungsud, ware sikandin migkuleyi te pegpabulig; eggimatayan degma ka lukes su miggilabet ma sikandin te malitan ne mahaan e egkasala. Keilangan ne eg-aween niyu ka mareet ne hinimuwan due te kaniyu.

23 “If a (LIT one) male is_caught messing_with a young_woman that's soon to_be_married and this happens there in the city, 24 it's_necessary that you(pl) bring those two there to the doorway of the city, and stone(pl) them until (they) die. The female is_killed because even there in the town, she didn't shout to_get_help; the male is also killed because he messed_with a woman who (was) soon to_be_married. It's_necessary that you(pl) remove the evil action(s) from (among) you(pl).

25 “Piru ke diye te lihawangan te siyudad lehenga te lukes ka mengebay ne mahaan e egkasala, ka lukes de ka keilangan ne eggimatayan. 26 Kene niyu menuwa ka mengebay—ware sale din ne eleg sikandin ne eggimatayan, su iyan egkeilingan te seini ne kasu ka etew ne migpanlusud wey miggimatey te duma rin, 27 su diye ma te lihawangan te siyudad lehenga te lukes ka mengebay, wey minsan pad ke migkuleyi sikandin te pegpabulig, ware ma iya nakabulig kandin.

25 “But if the male rapes (LIT grabs/hugs) the young_women soon to_be_married there outside the city, it's_necessary that just the male be_killed. 26 Don't(pl) harm the young_women—she has_no sin that's correct/worthy that she be_killed, because the person that invades and kills his companion is_like this case, 27 because the young_women was_raped (LIT grabbed/hugged) by the male there outside the city, and even if she shouted to_get_help, indeed no_(one) could_help her.

28 [xr]“Ke egkasapenan ka sabeka ne lukes ne egleheng te mengebay ne kene pad egkasalen, 29 keilangan ne egbayad sikandin diye te amey te malitan te lalimma ne pulu (50) ne buuk ne seleppi ne pelata. Ne keilangan degma ne eg-asaween din ka mengebay su napeyilawan din man e ka bansa te mengebay. Ne keilangan ne kene din iya eg-engkeran ka malitan te intiru ne umul rin.

28 [xr]“If a (LIT one) male rapes (LIT grabs/hugs) a young_women that's not yet getting_married, 29 it's_necessary that he paid fifty (50) pieces of silver money there to the father of the female. And it's_necessary also_that he marry the young_women because he has_shamed [emphasis] the honor of the young_women. And it's_necessary that he doesn't leave the female for his entire life.

30 [xr]“Kene ne meupiya ne eg-asaween wey ke eggilabetan naa te sabeka ne lukes ka sabeka te me asawa dengan te amey rin, su egpakapeyilew seini te amey rin.”

30 [xr]“(It's) not good that one of the spouses before of his father be_married or messed_with by a (LIT one) man, because this would_shame his father.”

Ka me etew ne igpasuwey

The people who (are) to_be_set_apart

231 Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Kene niyu paapila te punduk te keet-etawan te Magbebaye ne Manama ka etew ne kinepun.

231 And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to again by Muwisis, “Don't(pl) include the person who is_castrated in the group of the people of the Lord God.

2 “Kene niyu paapila te punduk te keet-etawan te Magbebaye ne Manama ka etew ne naanak te migpeyilabetey ne kene ne alunggun, minsan ka me kabuhalan din taman te igkasapulu (10) ne kabuhalan.

2 “Don't(pl) include in the group of the people of the Lord God the person that's born from not a couple messing_with_each_other, even his descendants for the tenth (10) descendant(s).

3 [xr]“Kene niyu degma paapila te punduk te keet-etawan te Magbebaye ne Manama ka me Amunihanen wey me Muwabihanen taman te igkasapulu (10) ne kabuhalan 4 su ware kew ma nikandan pamehayi te egkakeen wey egkeinum te timpu ne migpangipanew kew puun te Ihiptu, wey nasi dan suuli si Balaam ne anak ni Biyur ne matig-Piyur ne sakup te Misuputamya, eyew te pegdilus kaniyu. 5 [xr]Piru ware linglingaa te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu si Balaam, ke kene, nasi din mule himuwa ne panalangin ka dilus perem kaniyu su inggeyinawaan kew ma te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. 6 Ne kene kew himu te minsan nekey ne egpakameupiya wey ke egpakamatubung naa kandan.

3 [xr]“Don't(pl) include the Amunihanons and the Muwabihanons in the group of the people of the Lord God until the tenth (10) generation 4 because you(pl) weren't distributed food and drink by_them at the time that you(pl) traveled from Ihiptu, and instead Balaam the son of Biyur from_Piyur under_the_jurisdiction of Misuputamya was_paid by_them, in_order for cursing you(pl). 5 [xr]But the Lord who is your(pl) God didn't pay_attention to Balaam, but rather, instead he on_the_contrary made the hoped_for curse into a blessing for you(pl) because you(pl) were_loved [emphasis] by the Lord your(pl) God. 6 And don't(pl) do any thing that will_make_good or will_prosper them.

7 “Upiani niyu ka me matig-Idum su me karumaan niyu ma sikandan, wey ka me Ihiptuhanen su me lapu kew ma dengan diye te tane dan. 8 Egkaayun mule ne egpaapilen niyu te punduk te keet-etawan te Magbebaye ne Manama ka me apu dan.”

7 “Do_good(pl) to the (ones) from_Idum because they (are) your(pl) relatives, and the Ihiptuhanons because you(pl) (were) foreigners before there in their land. 8 It's_possible on_the_contrary that you(pl) include their grandchildren in the group of the people of the Lord God.”

Ka peglinis layun te kampu

The cleaning always of the camp

9 Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Ke egkekampu kew te timpu te gira, pariyu kew te minsan nekey ne egpakamalindit kaniyu. 10 Ke due sabeka kaniyu ne inlihawangan te muntus din te peglipereng din, keilangan ne eglihawang sikandin te kampu wey kene pad sikandin eglibed egseled. 11 Ne te seup ne maapun, keilangan ne egpamanihus sikandin, wey te eglineb e ka aldew ne human pad man-e sikandin egseled te kampu.

9 And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to again by Muwisis, “If you(pl) camp(pl) at the time of war, distance(pl) from what ever that can_dirty you(pl). 10 If there's one of_you(pl) that his sperm exits during his sleep, it's_necessary that he exit the camp and he does not yet return to_enter. 11 And on the next afternoon, it's_necessary that he takes_a_bath, and when the sun sets (then) he again will_enter the camp.

12 “Keilangan ne egteil kew te eg-indesan niyu diye te lihawangan te kampu. 13 Ne emun eg-indes kew diye te lihawangan, keilangan ne egkaliyan niyu ka eg-indesan niyu pinaahi te kayu wey ke panganiban naa. Ne emun egpekeimpus kew ka eg-indes, bunbuni niyud man-e te tane. 14 Su egleug-leug ma ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu diye te kampu niyu eyew te pegbantey kaniyu wey te pegtalu te me kuntere niyu. Purisu keilangan ne layun malinis ka kampu niyu eyew ware egkiteen din ne malindit ne iyan egpuunan ne eg-engkeran kew nikandin.”

12 “It's_necessary that you(pl) arrange your(pl) defecating_place there outside the camp. 13 And if you(pl) defecate there outside, it's_necessary that you(pl) dig your(pl) defecating_place by_means of wood or a weapon. And if you(pl) have_finished defecating, cover(pl) (it) again with soil. 14 Because the Lord your(pl) God walks_around there in your(pl) camp in_order for guarding you(pl) and for defeating your(pl) enemies. Therefore it's_necessary that your(pl) camp (is) always clean so_that there's_nothing dirty that he will_see that (would be) the reason that you(pl) would_be_deserted by_him.”

Ka pegsagman te uripen ne egpallahuy

The giving_attention of slave(s) that run/flee

15 Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Kene niyu peulia diye te ahalen din ka uripen ne migpallahuy wey mig-aput kaniyu, 16 ke kene, peugpaa niyu sikandin diye te minsan hendei ne me lungsud ne igkeupii rin. Ne kene niyu sikandin ay-ayuwa.

15 And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to again by Muwisis, “Don't(pl) send_ the slave that runs/flees _back_home to his/her master and seeks_refuge with_you(pl), 16 but rather, let(pl)_ him/her _live there in where ever town that he/she desires. And don't(pl) drive_ him/her _to_ridicule.

17 [xr]“Keilangan ne ware me kabuhalan ni Israil, lukes ma wey se malitan ne egpamelegye te lawa rin diye te timplu isip pegsimba te me manama. 18 Kene niyu gamita ka seleppi ne imbayad te malitan wey ke lukes ne migpamelegye te lawa, eyew igbayad niyu te insaad niyu diye te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu su igkalindit din sika ne himu.

17 [xr]“It's_necessary that no descendants of Israil, male or female sells(pl) his/her body there at the temple as worshiping gods. 18 Don't(pl) use money that was_paid to a female or male that sold(pl) (his/her) body, in_order to pay(pl) what_ you(pl) _promised there to the Lord your(pl) God because this action (is) dirty to him.

19 [xr]“Kene niyu patubui ke egpasambey kew te seleppi wey ke egkakeen naa diye te duma niyu ne me kabuhalan ni Israil. 20 Egkaayun ne egpatubuan niyu ka egpasambayan niyu te me lapu, piru kene niyu re ka duma niyu ne me kabuhalan ni Israil. Himuwa niyu sika eyew egpalanginan te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu ka langun ne eggimuwen niyu diye te tane ne eg-angkenen niyu.”

19 [xr]“Don't(pl) charge_interest if you(pl) lend money or food to your(pl) companion that's descendants of Israil. 20 It's_possible that you(pl) lend_with_interest what_ you(pl) _loan to foreigners, but just not to your(pl) companion descendants of Israil. Do(pl) that so_that all that_ you(pl) _do will_be_blessed by the Lord your(pl) God there in the land that you(pl) will_receive.”

Ka me panaad diye te Manama

Promises there to God

21 Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Ke egpanaad kew diye te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, keilangan ne egtumanen niyu iya seini, su egsukutan kew iya te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, wey egpakasale kew ke kene niyu seini egtumanen. 22 Piru ke kene kew egpanaad, kene kew red egpakasale. 23 Piru ka minsan nekey ne igsaad niyu diye te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, keilangan ne egtumanen niyu iya.

21 And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to again by Muwisis, “If you(pl) promise to the Lord your(pl) God, it's_necessary that you(pl) obey it indeed, because you(pl) will_be_followed_up indeed by the Lord who is your(pl) God, and you(pl) will_be_sinning if you(pl) don't obey it. 22 But if you(pl) don't promise, you(pl) also just won't sin. 23 But what ever you(pl) promised to the Lord who is your(pl) God, it's_necessary that you(pl) obey (it) indeed.

24 “Ke eggendiye kew te parasan te duma niyu, egkaayun ne egkeen kew te behas kayi taman te igkeupii niyu, piru kene kew uyan diye te baley niyu, 25 wey ke eggendiye kew te triguwan te duma niyu, egkaayun ne egpangetu kew, piru kene niyu seini galaba.”

24 “If you(pl) go_there to the vineyard of your(pl) companion, it's_possible that you(pl) eat the fruit here until your(pl) desire (is filled), but don't(pl) take (them) there to your(pl) house, 25 and if you(pl) go_there to the wheat_field of your(pl) companion, it's_possible that you(pl) pluck_grain, but don't(pl) reap (it).”

Ka me balaud meyitenged te pegpeengkerey te asawa

The laws concerning spouses leaving_each_other

241 [xr]Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Panunggilingan ke mig-asawa ka sabeka ne lukes, wey nataman, naawe e ka eyam din te asawa rin su due nakita rin ne ware din ikeupii te asawa rin. Eggimu sikandin te kasulatan te pegpasuwayey, wey igbehey rin seini te asawa rin, wey egpaaween din e ka asawa rin te baley rin. 2 Ne emun ke egpakaasawe e man-e ka malitan te lein e man-e ne lukes, 3 nataman, warad e man-e sikandin ikeupii te ikarangeb ne asawa rin, wey ke migpatey naa ka ikarangeb ne asawa rin, 4 kenad egkaayun ne egliberan pad sikandin te hun-a ne asawa rin su nalinditan e sikandin; igkalindit te Magbebaye ne Manama ka iling due ne himu. Purisu kene niyu himuwa sika diye te tane ne igbehey kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, isip egkapanunud niyu.

241 [xr]And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to again by Muwisis, “For_example if one male marries, and then, his desire for his spouse goes_out because there's_(something) that_ he _sees that he doesn't like about his spouse. He will_make a document of leaving_each_other, and he will_give it to his spouse, and he will_send_ his spouse _out from his house. 2 And if the female marries again to another different male, 3 and then, she's not again liked by her second spouse, or her second spouse dies, 4 it's_no_longer_possible that she still return to her first spouse because she's been dirtied; action(s) like that makes the Lord God feels_dirty. Therefore don't(pl) do that there in the land that the Lord your(pl) God will_give you(pl), as your(pl) inheritance.

5 “Ke iyam pad nakaasawa ka sabeka ne lukes, keilangan ne taman te sabeka ne leg-un, kene sikandin egpaapilen te pegkasundalu wey ke egpatrabahuwen naa diye te lungsud—keilangan ne egbehayan sikandin te kaligwangan te peggale-gale duma te asawa rin.

5 “If a male is still newly married, it's_necessary that for one year, he's not included in serving_as_a_soldier or gotten_to_work there in the town—it's_necessary that he's given freedom for being_happy along_with his spouse.

6 “Kene niyu kua ka galingan te nakasambey kaniyu eyew gerentiya rin su iling te in-ahawan niyud sikandin te egkapamitawan din te keuyahan te pamilya rin.

6 “Don't(pl) take the mill of (someone who) lent (something) from you(pl) in_order_as his guarantee because (it's) like you(pl) snatched from_him his way_of_supporting the living of his family.

Ka balaud meyitenged te egtangag te duma

The law concerning kidnapping others

7 [xr]“Ke due egkasapenan ne egtangag te duma rin ne kabuhalan ni Israil eyew eg-uripenen wey ke igbelegye naa, keilangan ne eggimatayan sikandin. Keilangan ne eg-aween niyu ka mareet ne hinimuwan due te kaniyu.

7 [xr]“If there_is (someone) caught kidnapping his fellow descendant of Israil in_order to_enslave (him/her) or to sell, it's_necessary that he/she be_killed. It's_necessary that evil actions be_removed there from_you(pl).

Ka me balaud meyitenged te ibung

The laws concerning skin_disease

8 [xr]“Ne meyitenged te ibung, keilangan ne eg-ikulen niyu eg-ay-ayari ka igpanulu kaniyu te me talagpanubad ne me kabuhalan ni Libi. Tumana niyu iya ka insuhu ku kandan. 9 [xr]Sumsumana niyu ka inggimu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu ki Miryam te pegpangipanew niyu puun te Ihiptu.

8 [xr]“And concerning skin_disease, it's_necessary that you(pl) carefully follow/imitate what_was_taught to_you(pl) by the sacrificers that (are) descendants of Libi. Obey(pl) indeed what_ I _commanded them. 9 [xr]Remember(pl) (what) the Lord your(pl) God did to Miryam (when) you(pl) (were) traveling from Ihiptu.

10 “Ke egpasambey kew te minsan nekey diye te duma niyu ne me kabuhalan ni Israil, kene kew lasud diye te baley rin ka egkuwa te minsan nekey ne kandin isip gerentiya; 11 tetahad kew re diye te lihawangan, wey sikandin de pakua niyu te iggerentiya rin. 12 Ke amana egkaayu-ayu ka etew wey iyan din de ubag igpakagerentiya ka hinabel rin, kene niyu seini papawei diye te kaniyu, 13 ke kene, iuli niyu seini kandin te kene pad ne marusilem eyew due egkahamit din te peglipereng din eyew kene sikandin egkaagsilan, wey egpasalamatan kew pad nikandin. Ne eg-isipen seini te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu ne matareng ne himu.

10 “If you(pl) lend (LIT cause_debt) of whatever to your(pl) companion descendants of Israil, don't(pl) enter into his/her house to_take what ever that's his/her as a guarantee; 11 just wait(pl) there outside, and get(pl)_ him/her _to_get his/her guarantee. 12 If the person is very poor and what he/she uses_as_guarantee (is) just [embarrassedly] his/her woven_cloth, don't(pl) keep_ it _until_dawn there at your(pl) (place), 13 but rather, return(pl) it to_him/her before it's morning so_that he/she has (something) to_use for his/her sleeping so_that he/she won't feel_cold, and you(pl) will_be_thanked by_him/her. And the Lord your(pl) God will_consider this as (a) righteous/sensible act.

14 [xr]“Kene niyu le-leiha ka trabahanti ne egkaayu-ayu, kabuhalan ma ni Israil wey se lapu ne mig-ugpe diye te me lungsud niyu. 15 Bayari niyu sikandin te aldew-aldew ne pegtrabahu rin te kene pad eglineb ka aldew, su iyan din man de ubag insalihan ka suul rin tenged su egkaayu-ayu ma sikandin. Ke kene niyu sika eggimuwen, kema ke egpabulig sikandin te Magbebaye ne Manama, wey eg-isipen kew ne nakasale.

14 [xr]“Don't(pl) take_advantage_of (financially) poor workers, descendant of Israil or foreigner that lives there in your(pl) towns. 15 Pay(pl) him/her for his/her daily working before the sun sets, because that's just his/her income that_ he/she _is_trusting_on [embarrassedly] because he/she (is) poor. If you(pl) don't do that, what if he/she requests_help from the Lord God, and you(pl) are_considered sinner(s).

16 [xr]“Kene niyu himatayi ka amey wey iney tenged te sale te anak dan wey ke eggimatayan naa ka anak tenged te sale te amey wey iney rin, ke kene, eggimatayan ka tagse sabeka tenged te kandin mismu ne sale.

16 [xr]“Don't(pl) kill the father and mother due to the sin of their child or kill the child due to the sin of his/her father and mother, but rather, each one is_killed due to his/her own sin.

17 [xr]“Ibehey niyu ka eleg ne peggukum diye te me lapu, me ilu, wey kene niyu kua ka kumbale te balu isip gerentiya te utang din. 18 Sumsumana niyu ne me uripen kew degma dengan diye te Ihiptu, wey impalihawang kew te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu puun diye. Purisu insuhu ku sikaniyu ne sika ka eggimuwen niyu.

17 [xr]“Give(pl) the correct judging there to foreigners, orphans, and don't(pl) take the clothing of a widow as guarantee of her debt. 18 Remember that you(pl) (were) slaves also before there in Ihiptu, and you(pl) were_brought_out from there by the Lord your(pl) God. Therefore I'm commanding you(pl) that that's what_ you(pl) _will_do.

19 [xr]“Ke eggaani kew diye te kamet niyu wey nalingawan niyu ka sabeka ne bagkes, kene niyud sika liberi. Ibehey niyud sika te me lapu, te me ilu, wey me balu. Ne egpanalanginan te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu ka langun ne eggimuwen niyu. 20 Ke egpamupu kew te me ulibu niyu, kene niyud seini pakilalawi; ibehey niyud seini te me ilu, me lapu, wey me balu. 21 Ke egpamupu kew te me behas te paras niyu, kene niyud seini pakilalawi; ibehey niyud seini te me ilu, me lapu, wey me balu. 22 Sumsumana niyu ne me uripen kew degma dengan diye te Ihiptu. Purisu insuhu ku sikaniyu ne sika ka eggimuwen niyu.”

19 [xr]“If you(pl) are_harvesting there in your(pl) field and you(pl) forget one bundle, don't return for that. Give (that) to foreigners, orphans, and widows. And all that_ you(pl) _do will_be_blessed by the Lord who is your(pl) God. 20 If you(pl) pick your(pl) olives, don't(pl) glean them; give(pl) them to orphans, foreigners, and widows. 21 If you(pl) pick(pl) the fruits of your(pl) vineyards, don't(pl) glean them; give(pl) them to orphans, foreigners, and widows. 22 Remember that you(pl) (were) also slaves before there in Ihiptu. Therefore I'm commanding you(pl) that that's what_ you(pl) _will_do.”

Ka parusa te nakasale pinaahi te lampes

The punishment of sinner(s) by_means of beating

251 Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Panunggilingan ke due daruwa ne me kabuhalan ni Israil ne egpekeg-ehet, wey eggendiye sikandan te hukumanan, ka me talewukum ka eggukum kandan—egparusaan ka nakasale, wey igpeila ka ware nakasale. 2 Ke iyan de igparusa te nakasale ka peglampes, egpalangkeben sikandin te me talewukum, wey egpanlampesan sikandin diye te tangkaan dan—eglampesan sikandin te kamasulug ne eleg te sale ne neyimu rin. 3 Piru keilangan ne kene egsubla te hep-at ne pulu (40) ka peglampes kandin, su egkeyilawan e sikandin ke egsublee te hep-at ne pulu (40) ka peglampes kandin.

251 And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to again by Muwisis, “For_example if there's two descendants of Israil that disagree_with_each_other, and they go_there to the judging_place, the judges (will be) the (ones) judging them—the sinner will_be_punished, and the (one who) didn't sin will_be_acknowledged. 2 If the (one who) sinned is_punished just with beating, he/she will_be_made_to_lie_face_down by the judges, and he/she will_be_beaten(pl) there in front of_them—he/she will_be_beaten many_times that's correct for the sin that he/she did. 3 But it's_necessary that his/her beating doesn't exceed forty (40), because he/she would_be_shamed if his/her beating exceeded forty (40).

4 [xr]“Kene niyu pungeta ka be-be te baka ke igdiriek sikandin te trigu.

4 [xr]“Don't(pl) muzzle the mouth of a cow if it's treading wheat.

Ka katenged te suled te migpatey

The authority of a sibling of (one who) died

5 [xr]“Ke egpalemungey ka daruwa ne tahasuled ne lukes, ke egpatey ka sabeka kandan ne ware anak ne lukes, keilangan ne kene eg-asawa ka asawa te migpatey te kene ne sakup te pamilya te asawa rin. Keilangan ne iyan din ded eg-asaween ka suled te asawa rin ne migpatey. Katenged sika te suled te migpatey. 6 Ne ka kinakakayan ne anak dan ne lukes, eg-isipen ne kinakakayan ne anak te suled din ne migpatey, eyew kene egkaawe puun te Israil ka ngaran te suled din. 7 [xr]Piru ke kene egbalu-balu ka suled te migpatey, egkaayun ka balu ne egpangananey diye te me igdatu ne diye te gumawan te lungsud te egkahi, ‘Kena a egpamaluwen te suled te migpatey ne asawa ku eyew due me kabuhalan te suled din kayi te Israil. Kene din egtumanen ka katenged din keddi isip balu te suled din.’ 8 Ne igpeumew sikandin te me igdatu te lungsud, wey eglalahan sikandin. Ne emun mapahetpet iya sikandin ne kene egpangasawa te balu te suled din, 9 egparani kandin ka balu taheed te diye sikandan te tangkaan te me igdatu, wey egluungen ka sandal rin, wey egkulepaan ka ulaula rin. Ne egkahi ka balu, ‘Seini ka eggimuwen diye te etew ne egbalibad ne egbehey te me kabuhalan para te suled din ne migpatey.’ 10 Ne ka pamilya te sika ne etew, eggehennalan e diye te Israil te, ‘Ka pamilya te etew ne inluungan te sandal.’ ”

5 [xr]“If two male brothers stay_together, if one of them dies without (any) male child, it's_necessary that (the) spouse of (the one who) died won't marry someone (who is) not under_the_jurisdiction of his/her spouse's family. It's_necessary that she/he marries the sibling of his/her deceased husband. That (is) right of the sibling of the (one who) died. 6 And their eldest male child, will_be_considered the eldest child of his sibling that died, so_that the name of his sibling won't be removed from Israil. 7 [xr]But if the sibling of the (one who) died doesn't marry_the_widow, it's_possible that the widow request_help from the elders there at the doorway of the town saying, ‘I wasn't married_as_widow by the sibling of my deceased spouse so that there's descendants to his sibling here in Israil. He won't_fulfill(sg) his right/responsibility to me as widow of his/her sibling.’ 8 And he will_be_sent_for by the elders of the town, and he will_be_spoken_to. And if he's energetic indeed that he won't marry the widow of his sibling, 9 the widow will_approach him while they (are) there in front of the elders, and his sandal will_be_taken_off, and his face will_be_spat_on. And the widow will_say, ‘This (is) what_will_happen to the person that goes_against giving descendants for his sibling that died.’ 10 And the family of that person, will_be_nicknamed there in Israil as, ‘The family of the person whose sandal was_taken_off.’ ”

Ke egpekeg-ehet ka daruwa ne etew

If two people fight_with_each_other

11 Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Panunggilingan ke due daruwa ne etew ne nekeg-ehet, wey migparani ka asawa te sabeka eyew egbulig te asawa rin pinaahi te pegkeyemet te butu te kuntere te asawa rin, 12 keilangan ne egtamperen niyu ka belad te malitan. Kene kew keyid-u kandin.”

11 And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to again by Muwisis, “For_example if there's two people that fight_with_each_other, and the spouse of one approaches in_order to_help her spouse by_means of squeezing the testicles of the enemy of her spouse, 12 it's_necessary that the hand/arm of the female be_cut_off. Do not sympathy with her.”

Kene kew panlimbung

Don't(pl) cheat

13-14 [xr]Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Kene kew gamit te kene ne eleg ne timbangan wey sekeranan. 15 Iyan niyu re gamita ka eleg ne timbangan wey sekeranan eyew egmalayat ka umul niyu diye te tane ne igbehey kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu; 16 egkalindit ka Magbebaye te etew ne egpanlimbung.”

13-14 [xr]And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to again by Muwisis, “Don't(pl) use not correct scales and measures. 15 Just use(pl) the correct scales and measures so_that your(pl) live(s) will_be_lengthened there in the land that will_be_given to_you(pl) by the Lord your(pl) God; 16 the Lord feels_dirty at people who cheat(pl).”

Ka suhu te pegpangimatey te me Amalikanen

The command for killing(pl) Amalikanons

17 [xr]Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Sumsumana niyu ka inggimu kaniyu te me Amalikanen te peglihawang niyu puun te Ihiptu. 18 Impanlusuran kew nikandan te timpu ne nenabbeley kew amana, wey impangimatayan dan ka me duma niyu ne nammewuriyan; ware kaaldek dan te Magbebaye. 19 Purisu ke egbehayan kew e te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu te kalinaw puun te langun ne kuntere niyu ne nakalingut kaniyu, diye te tane ne igbehey rin kaniyu, gulaa niyu ka me Amalikanen eyew egkaawe e sikandan kayi te ampew te tane. Kene niyud iya seini kalingawi.”

17 [xr]And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to again by Muwisis, “Remember what_ the Amalikanons _did to_you(pl) at your(pl) exiting from Ihiptu. 18 You(pl) were_invaded(pl) by_them when you(pl) were_ very _tired, and they killed(pl) your(pl) companions that were_behind; they have_no fear of the Lord. 19 Therefore when you(pl) are_given peace from all your(pl) enemies that surround you(pl) by the Lord who is your(pl) God, there in the land that_ he _will_give to_you(pl), exterminate(pl) the Amalikanons so_that they will_be_removed here on top of the earth. Don't(pl) indeed forget this.”

Ka me halad puun te an-anayan ne baad te me uma

The offerings from the first portion of harvests

261 Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Ke egkaangken niyud ka tane ne igbehey kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu isip egkapanunud niyu wey egmekeugpe kew e diye, 2 [xr]iteil niyu ka an-anayan ne baad puun te uma te langun ne pinamula niyu. Itahu niyu te baskit wey uyana niyu diye te inged ne eg-alamen te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu eyew egsimbaan niyu kandin. 3 Parani kew te talagpanubad ne migpamakey te sika te timpu, wey kahii niyu sikandin, ‘Pinaahi te seini ne halad, in-ila ku ne ka Magbebaye ne Manama ta ka mig-uyan keddi kayi te seini ne Inged ne Insaad din te me kaap-apuan ta.’

261 And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to again by Muwisis, “When you(pl) have_received the land that the Lord who is your(pl) God will_give to_you(pl) as your(pl) inheritance and you(pl) are_living(pl) there, 2 [xr]organize the first portion from the harvest of all your(pl) crops. Put(pl) (it) in basket(s) and bring(pl) (it) there to the place chosen by the Lord your(pl) God in_order for you(pl) to_worship him. 3 Approach(pl) the sacrificer that's serving at that time, and tell(pl) him, ‘By_means of this offering, I acknowledge that the Lord our(incl) God (was) the (one who) brought me here to this Place that he Promised to our(incl) ancestors.’

4 “Ne egkuen te talagpanubad ka baskit ne in-uyan niyu, wey igsabuk din seini diye te egkatangkaan te altar te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. 5 Ne seini ka eglalahen niyu diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu: ‘Ka kaapuan ney ne si Hakub ne matig-Aram, ware nateil ne ugpaan dengan; miggendiye sikandin te Ihiptu wey diye mig-ugpe duma te me pamilya rin. Deisek de ubag sikandan dengan, piru nataman, migmasulug e ka kabuhalan dan wey neyimu e ne dakel ne nasud. 6 Piru indeeg-deeg key patamtamani te me Ihiptuhanen; impaantus key nikandan pinaahi te pegpatrabahu te mabbehat ne himu isip me uripen. 7 Ne migpangananey key te Magbebaye ne Manama te me kaap-apuan ney, wey narineg key nikandin. Nakita rin ka me peg-antus ney te mabbehat ne himu, wey ka me pegdeeg-deeg kanami. 8 Purisu impalihawang key te Magbebaye ne Manama puun te Ihiptu pinaahi te dakel ne geem din, wey te makaalat-halat, wey me kein-inuwan ne himu. 9 Ne in-uyan key nikandin kayi te seini ne inged, wey imbehey rin kanami ka seini se meupiya ne tane wey dakel se eg-uma.[fn] 10 Purisu in-uyan ku seini se an-anayan ne baad te an-anayan ne uma ne imbehey nu keddi, he Magbebaye ne Manama.’

4 “And the sacrificer will_take the basket that you(pl) brought, and he will_place_ it _down there in front of the altar of the Lord your(pl) God. 5 And this (is) what_ you(pl) _will_say in front of the Lord your(pl) God: ‘Our(excl) ancestors Hakub from_Aram, had_no organized living_place before; he went_there to Ihiptu and lived there along_with his family. They were just few [embarrassedly] before, but then, their descendants became_many and became a large nation. 6 But they were_greatly insulted by the Ihiptuhanons; we(excl) were_made_to_suffer by_them in being_put_to_work with heavy(pl) work as slaves. 7 And we(excl) requested_help from the Lord God of our(excl) ancestors, and we(excl) were_heard by_him. He saw our(excl) suffering in heavy(pl) work, and the insulting of_us(excl). 8 Therefore we(excl) were_brought_out by the Lord God from Ihiptu by_means of his large power, and by terrifying (things), and wondrous acts. 9 And we(excl) were_brought by_him here to this place, and he gave us(excl) this good land and good harvest(s).[fn] 10 Therefore I brought this first portion of the first harvest that you(sg) gave me, oh Lord God.’

“Ne isabuk niyu ka baskit diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, wey simbaa niyu sikandin.11 Ne gale-gale kew tenged te keupiya te Magbebaye ne Manama kaniyu, te me pamilya niyu, te me Libita, wey te me lapu ne mig-ugpe diye te me lungsud niyu.

“And place(pl)_ the basket _down there in front of the Lord your(pl) God, and worship(pl) him.11 And be_happy(pl) due to the goodness of the Lord your(pl) God to you(pl), to your(pl) family, to the Libitas, and to the foreigners (who) live there in your(pl) towns.

12 [xr]“Tagse igkatelu ne leg-un, ibehey niyu ka igkasapulu niyu puun te langun ne eg-uma te me pinamula niyu para te me Libita, me lapu, me ilu, wey te me balu, eyew due ubag degma egkengakeen dan. 13 Ne ampu kew diye te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu te egkahi, ‘He Magbebaye ne Manama ney, imbehey kud te me Libita, me lapu, me ilu, wey me balu ka matulus ne baad sumale te insuhu nu keddi; ware ku supaka wey ke inlingawan ku naa ka minsan nekey ne balaud nu. 14 Wara a migkeen te igkasapulu taheed te miglungku a wey ke migsamsam e naa kayi taheed te in-isip a ne malindit, wey ware ku seini ihalad diye te minatey. Magbebaye ne Manama, migtuman a keykew; inggimu ku ka langun ne insuhu nu keddi. 15 Purisu pantawa a ubag nikeykew puun te langit ne ugpaan nu, wey panalangini nu ka keet-etawan nu ne me kabuhalan ni Israil, wey ka imbehey nu kanami ne meupiya ne tane wey dakel se eg-uma, sumale te insaad nu te me kaap-apuan ney.’

12 [xr]“Each third year, give(pl) your(pl) tenth from all the harvests of your(pl) crops for the Libitas, foreigners, orphans, and widows, so_that there_will_be [embarrassedly] also something_ for them _to_eat(pl). 13 And pray(pl) to the Lord your(pl) God saying, ‘Oh Lord our(excl) God, I gave the holy portion to the Libitas, foreigners, orphans, and widows according to what_ you(sg) _commanded me; I won't disobey or forget what ever that's your(sg) law. 14 I didn't eat from the tenth while I was_mourning or touched it while I was_considered dirty, and I didn't offer this to the dead. Lord God, I've obeyed you(sg); I've done all that_ you(sg) _commanded me. 15 Therefore please look_down(sg) at me from the sky/heaven that's your(sg) living-place, and bless(sg) your(sg) people the descendants of Israil, and the good land and large harvest that you(sg) have_given to_us(excl), according to what_ you(sg) _promised to our(excl) ancestors.’

16 “Ne kuntee, insuhu kew te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu ne egtumanen niyu te mapahetpet ka langun ne balaud din wey me suhu. 17 Impeila niyu kuntee ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, wey migsaad kew ne eg-ikulen niyu ka me balaud, wey ka langun ne me suhu din. 18 [xr]Ne impataha degma kuntee te Magbebaye ne Manama ne me keet-etawan kew nikandin sumale te insaad din kaniyu. Purisu keilangan ne egtumanen niyu ka langun ne balaud din. 19 Ne eggimuwen kew nikandin ne labew te langun ne nasud, wey egkarayan kew wey egkabantug. Ne egkeyimu kew ne matulus ne keet-etawan te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu sumale te insaad din.”

16 “And now/today, you(pl) are_commanded by the Lord your(pl) God that you(pl) energetically obey all his laws and commands. 17 You(pl) have_acknowledged the Lord who is your(pl) God now/today, and you(pl) promised that you(pl) would follow/imitate the laws, and all his commands. 18 [xr]And the Lord God has_made_known also now/today that you(pl) (are) his people according to what_ he _promised to_you(pl). Therefore it's_necessary that you(pl) obey all his laws. 19 And you(pl) will_be_made above all nations by_him, and you(pl) will_be_praised and respected. And you(pl) will_become the holy people of the Lord your(pl) God according to what_ he _promised.”

Ka me pegpaney-paney te kene pad egseled te Kanaan

271 Ne ingkahiyan ni Muwisis wey te me igdatu ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Tumana niyu ka langun ne balaud ne ingkahi ku kaniyu kuntee. 2 [xr]Mahaan kew e eglapas te Hurdan peendiye te tane ne igbehey kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. Ke egpakalapas kew e, meg-untud-untud kew naa te derakel ne batu, wey puliti niyu seini te apug. 3 Ne isulat niyu naa kayi ka langun ne balaud ke egpakaseled kew e diye te meupiya ne tane wey dakel se eg-uma;[fn] tane ne igbehey kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu sumale te insaad din te me kaap-apuan niyu. 4 Ke egpakalapas kew e te Hurdan, ipasasindeg niyu sika ne me batu diye te Bubungan ne Ibal, wey puliti niyu seini te apug sumale te insuhu ku kaniyu kuntee. 5 [xr]Ne pasasindeg kew naa te altar ne batu ne tutunganan te igpanubad niyu diye te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. Piru kene niyu sapsapi ka me batu ne eggamiten niyu, 6 te pegpasasindeg te altar. Ne diye kew naa tutung te igmanubad niyu para te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu; 7 diye kew degma panubad para te keupianan, wey keena niyu seini diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu wey gale-gale kew. 8 Ne paay-ayari niyu te egsulat diye te seeye ne me batu ka langun ne balaud te Manama eyew egkaklaru.”

271 And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to by Muwisis and the elders, “Obey(pl) all the laws that I've told you(pl) now/today. 2 [xr]You(pl) will_soon cross the Hurdan going_towards the land that I the Lord your(pl) God will_give you(pl). When you've(pl) crossed, place(pl)_ large stones _on_top_of_each_other, and wipe_on(pl) lime. 3 And write(pl) here all the laws when you(pl) enter there in the good land and (with) big harvests;[fn] land that will_be_given to_you(pl) by the Lord who is your(pl) God according to what_ he _promised to your(pl) ancestors. 4 When you(pl) cross the Hurdan, stand(pl) those stones there on Mount Ibal, and wipe_on(pl) lime according to what_ I _commanded you(pl) now/today. 5 [xr]And erect(pl) a stone altar that's a burning_place for your(pl) sacrifices there to the Lord your(pl) God. But don't(pl) trim the stones that_ you(pl) _use, 6 for erecting the altar. And burn(pl) your(pl) sacrifices there for the Lord your(pl) God; 7 sacrifice(pl) there also for peace/prosperity, and eat(pl) this there in front of the Lord your(pl) God and be_happy(pl). 8 And carefully(pl) write all the laws of God there on those stones so_that it's_clear.”

9 Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis wey te me talagpanubad ne me Libita ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Pammineg kew me kabuhalan ni Israil: kuntee ne aldew, me keet-etawan kew e te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. 10 Purisu pammineg kew te Manama wey tumana niyu ka langun ne me suhu wey me tulumanen din ne ingkahi ku kaniyu kuntee ne aldew.”

9 And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to again by Muwisis and the Libita sacrificers, “Listen(pl) descendants of Israil: today, you(pl) (are) people of the Lord your(pl) God. 10 Therefore listen(pl) to God and obey(pl) all commands(n) and customs that I've told you(pl) today.”

11 Te seeye ded ne aldew, ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, 12 [xr]“Ke egpakalapas kew e te Hurdan, seini ne me tribu ka egsasindeg diye te Bubungan ne Girisim eyew egpanalangin te me kabuhalan ni Israil: ka tribu enni Libi, Simyun, Huda, Isakar, Husi, wey ni Binhamin. 13 Ne seini degma ne me tribu ka egsasindeg diye te Bubungan ne Ibal eyew egpammineg ke egmenuwen te Manama te eglegpad ka me kabuhalan ni Israil: ka tribu enni Rubin, Gad, Asir, Sabulun, Dan, wey ni Naptali.

281 [xr]Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Ke eg-ikulen wey egtumanen niyu iya te mapahetpet ka langun ne suhu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu ne ingkahi ku kaniyu kuntee ne aldew, eggimuwen kew nikandin ne labew te langun ne nasud, 2 wey egpanalanginan kew nikandin.

3 “Egpanalanginan din ka me lungsud wey ka me kamet niyu.

Ka lein e man-e ne kasabutan

The agreement that's different again

291 Seini ka me tahu te kasabutan ne impeyimu te Magbebaye ne Manama ki Muwisis duma te me kabuhalan ni Israil diye te inged te Muwab; timul seini te kasabutan ne inggimu te Manama duma te me kabuhalan ni Israil diye te Bubungan ne Sinay.

291 These (are) the contains of the agreement that the Lord God had_made with Muwisis along_with the descendants of Israil there in the place of Muwab; this (was) in_addition to the agreement made by God along_with the descendants of Israil there at Mount Sinay.

2 Ne impalibulung ni Muwisis ka langun ne me kabuhalan ni Israil wey ingkahiyan din sikandan, “Sikaniyu mismu ka nakakita te inggimu te Magbebaye ne Manama diye te Hari te Ihiptu, te langun ne upisyal rin, wey te intiru ne nasud din. 3 Nakita niyu ka makaalat-halat ne me karereetan, me palinneu wey me kein-inuwan ne inggimu te Manama. 4 Piru taman kuntee, ware din ipasabut kaniyu ka igpasabut te langun ne nakita niyu wey narineg niyu. 5 Ne te hep-at ne pulu (40) ne leg-un ne peggipanew niyu diye te disirtu, indumaan kew te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ne ware naggisi ka me kumbale niyu, wey ware nalleke ka me sandal niyu. 6 Ne ware paan diye ne egkakeen niyu wey ware binu ne egkeinum niyu, piru imbehayan kew te Magbebaye ne Manama te ingkeilangan niyu, eyew egkanengnengan niyu ne Magbebaye ne Manama niyu iya sikandin. 7 [xra][xrb]Te pegginguma ta te seini ne inged, migpakig-ehet kanta si Sihun ne Hari te Hisbun wey si Ug ne Hari te Basan, piru natalu ta sikandan. 8 [xr]Ne in-ahew ta ka tane dan wey imbehey tad diye te me kabuhalan enni Rubin, Gad, wey te katenge te tribu ni Manasis, isip egkapanunud dan. 9 Purisu tumana niyu te mapahetpet ka langun ne lalag te seini ne kasabutan eyew eglampus kew te langun ne eggimuwen niyu.

2 And Muwisis had_ all the descendants of Israil _gathered and they were_spoken_to by_him, “You(pl) yourselves saw what_was_done by the Lord God there to the king of Ihiptu, to all his officials, and to his entire nation. 3 You(pl) saw the terrible destructions, signs and wonders done by God. 4 But until now/today, he didn't explain to_you(pl) the explanation of all that you(pl) saw and you(pl) heard. 5 And for forty (40) years that you(pl) traveled there in the desert, you(pl) were_accompanied by the Lord God. And your(pl) clothes didn't tear(pl), and your(pl) sandals let_go(pl). 6 And there was_no bread there that you(pl) could_eat and no wine that you(pl) could_drink, but you(pl) were_given what_ you(pl) _needed by the Lord God, so_that you(pl) would_know that he indeed (is) the Lord your(pl) God. 7 [xra][xrb]On our(incl) arrival at this place, Sihun the king of Hisbun fought us(incl) and Ug the king of Basan, but they were_defeated by_us(incl). 8 [xr]And we(incl) snatched their land and we(incl) gave (them) to the descendants of Rubin, Gad, and half of the tribe of Manasis, as (something) they can_inherit. 9 Therefore energetically obey(pl) all the words of this agreement so_that you(pl) prosper in all that_ you(pl) _do.

10 “Ne migmanasindeg kew langun kuntee kayi te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu; lagkes ka me pangulu te me kabuhalan niyu, ka me igdatu niyu, ka me upisyal niyu, ka langun ne lukes, 11 ka me asawa wey ka me anak niyu, ka me lapu ne mig-ugpe duma kaniyu, ka talagpangayu wey ka talagpanakeru kaniyu. 12 Seini kew langun kuntee migmanasindeg eyew te pegdawat te kasabutan ne impahunlibetan te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. 13 Egkeupian sikandin ne egpamalehetan kaniyu kuntee ne keet-etawan kew iya nikandin, wey Manama niyu sikandin sumale te insaad din te me kaap-apuan niyu ne ensi Abraham, Isaak, wey si Hakub. 14 Ne ka seini ne kasabutan, kene ne para re kaniyu te migmanasindeg kuntee kayi te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama, 15 ke kene, para degma te seeye se egsinundul ne kabuhalan niyu.

10 “And everyone stand(pl) here now/today in front of the Lord your(pl) God; including the leaders of your(pl) descendants, your(pl) elders, your(pl) officials, all males, 11 your(pl) spouses and children, the foreigners that live along_with you(pl), the woodcutters and your(pl) water_carriers. 12 You(pl) all are_standing here now/today in_order for receiving the agreement that the Lord your(pl) God made_an_oath (about). 13 He wants that (it's) proved/witnessed now/today to_you(pl) that you(pl) indeed (are) his people, and he (is) your(pl) God according to what_was_promised by_him to your(pl) ancestors that (were) Abraham, Isaak, and Hakub. 14 And this agreement, (is) not just for you(pl) standing now/today here in front of the Lord God, 15 but rather, also for those next generation(s) of_yours(pl).

16 “Nakanengneng kew te egkeula-ula diye te Ihiptu, wey te peggendini ta, nakanengneng kew ke nekey ka egkeilingan te peggipanew ta diye te me inged te duma ne nasud; 17 nakita niyu ka me diyus-diyus dan ne kayu, batu, pelata, wey bulawan. 18 [xr]Taham-taham kew ne ware sabeka kaniyu ne eg-engked te pegpamakey te Magbebaye ne Manama, wey iyan e egpamakayen ka me manama te duma ne nasud; kema ke due sabeka kaniyu ne egsimba te me diyus-diyus te duma ne me nasud! Ka me etew ne eggimu due, egpekeiling te pinamula ne egbebehas te mapeit wey eggilu. 19 Ka minsan hentew ne nakarineg te seini ne me paney-paney te dilus, keilangan ne kene egsuman-suman ne kene sikandin egkamenu minsan egpabulus-bulus sikandin ne eggimu te minsan nekey ne igkeupii rin, su ka malehet, sikandin ka egpekeuyan kaniyu langun diye te karereetan. 20 Ne kene iya sikandin egpasayluwen te Magbebaye ne Manama; egkanlabkanlab de iya ka langet din iling te hapuy. Ne egkeyitabu iya te sika ne etew ka langun ne dilus ne nasulat te seini ne baseen. Ne eg-aween e te Magbebaye ne Manama ka ngaran te sika ne etew kayi te ampew te tane. 21 Ne igpalunsud-lunsud e sikandin te Magbebaye ne Manama puun te langun ne tribu te Israil, wey egpaantusen sikandin pinaahi te langun ne dilus ne nasulat te seini ne baseen te Balaud.

16 “You(pl) know what_happened there in Ihiptu, and on our(incl) coming_here, you(pl) know what our(incl) traveling was_like there in the places of other nations; 17 you(pl) saw their false_gods that (were) wood, stone, silver, and gold. 18 [xr]Go_carefully(pl) that no one of_you(pl) leaves_behind serving the Lord God, and that the gods of other nations are_worshiped; what if there's one of_you(pl) who will_worship the false gods of the other nations! The people who will_do that, are_like a plant that bears fruit that's bitter and poisonous. 19 Who ever hears these warnings about curse(s), it's_necessary that (he/she) doesn't think that he/she won't be_affected even_if he/she continues to_do what ever he/she likes, because the truth (is), he/she (is) the (one who) will_send you(pl) all to destruction. 20 And he/she won't be_forgiven by the Lord God; his anger will_blaze indeed like fire. And indeed all the curses written in this document will_happen to that person. And the name of that person will_be_removed from the top of the earth by the Lord God. 21 And he/she will_be_caused_to_abandon_home from all the tribes of Israil by the Lord God, and he/she will_be_made_to_suffer by_means of all the curses that are_written in this Document of the Law.

22 “Ne ka me kabuhalan niyu wey ka me lapu ne egpuun pad te maddiyu ne inged, egpakakita te me karereetan wey me dalu ne igpasalerep te Magbebaye ne Manama diye te tane niyu. 23 [xr]Ne egpekeiling e te mammara ne inged ne kene egkeugpaan ka tane niyu ne nabunbunan te asupri wey asin; kenad egkapamulaan wey warad egtubu ne minsan nekey ne sagbet. Iyan e egkeilingan ka neyitabu te Suduma, Gumura, Adma, wey Sibuwim ne indereetan te Magbebaye ne Manama tenged te mangune-kune ne langet din. 24 Ne egpekeinse ka keet-etawan te langun ne nasud, ‘Mania te inggimu seini te Magbebaye ne Manama te tane dan? Mania te nalanglangetan sikandin?’ 25 Ne egtabak ka keet-etawan, ‘Tenged te insupak dan ka kasabutan ne inggimu te Magbebaye ne Manama duma kandan, ka Manama te me kabuybuyahan dan. Inggimu seini te Manama ne kasabutan te timpu ne impalihawang din sikandan puun te Ihiptu. 26 Ne migsimba wey migpamakey e sikandan te lein ne me manama ne ware dan neileyi wey kene igpasimba kandan te Magbebaye ne Manama. 27 Purisu nabelu ka Magbebaye ne Manama te nasud dan, wey impasalerep din sikandan te langun ne dilus ne nasulat te baseen te balaud din. 28 Ne tenged te mangune-kune ne langet te Magbebaye ne Manama, impandelrel rin sikandan puun te nasud dan, wey impeendiye din te lein ne me nasud ne neneugpaan dan pad iya kuntee.’

22 “And your(pl) descendants and the foreigners from distant place(s), will_see the destructions and sicknesses that will_be_the_disasters_caused_by the Lord God there in your(pl) land. 23 [xr]And your(pl) land will_be_like the dry place that can't be_lived_in that's covered with sulfur and salt; it can't be_planted and what ever weeds won't sprout. It's like what_happened to Suduma, Gumura, Adma, and Sibuwim that were_destroyed by the Lord God due to his terrible anger. 24 And the people of all nations will_ask, ‘Why did the Lord God do this to their land? Why is_ he _very_angry?’ 25 And the people will_answer, ‘Due to they disobeyed the agreement made by the Lord God along_with them, the God of their elders. This agreement was_made by God at the time that he brought_ them _out from Ihiptu. 26 And they worshiped and served other gods that they didn't know and they weren't made_to_worship them by the Lord God. 27 Therefore the Lord God was_angry at their nation, and he sent_disaster to_them of all the curses written in the document of his Law. 28 And due to the terrible anger of the Lord God, he drove_ them _away from their nation, and he sent (them) to other nations where indeed they still live now/today.’

29 “Due minsan nekey ne nekeeles de, wey iyan de nakanengneng ka Magbebaye ne Manama ta. Piru impanengneng din kanta ka seini ne Balaud din, wey keilangan ne egtumanen ta seini wey te me kabuhalan ta, te ware egtamanan.”

29 “There_is what ever that's just hidden, and only the Lord our(incl) God knows. But he made_known to_us(incl) to this his Law, and it's_necessary that we(incl) and our(incl) descendants obey it, without ending.”

Ke eglibed te Manama ka me kabuhalan ni Israil

If the descendants of Israil return to God

301 Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Emun egkeyitabu kaniyu ka panalangin wey ka dilus ne ingkahi ku kaniyu, wey egkasuman-suman niyu seini diye te me nasud ne eg-empetan kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu; 2 ke eglibed kew wey ka me kabuhalan niyu diye te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, wey egtumanen niyu te mapahetpet ka langun ne insuhu ku kaniyu kuntee, 3 egkeyimenawan kaniyu ka Magbebaye ne Manama, wey egpanguyanen kew e man-e nikandin puun te me nasud ne in-empetan din kaniyu, wey egmatubungen kew e man-e nikandin. 4 Minsan pad ke immandelrel kew te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu diye te maddiyu amana ne inged te kalibutan, eglibulungen kew red iya man-e nikandin, 5 wey igmalibed kew diye te inged te me kaap-apuan niyu, eyew egkaangken niyu red man-e seini. Ne egmatubungen wey egpamasuluhen kew pad man-e nikandin labew te kaap-apuan niyu. 6 Ne egbalbalawan te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu ka me pusung niyu wey ka me pusung te me kabuhalan niyu eyew eggeyinawaan niyud sikandin te mapahetpet, wey egpakapabulus-bulus kew ne eg-ugpe te sika ne inged. 7 Ne iyan din e egpasalerepen te seini ne me dilus ka me kuntere niyu ne migdeeg-deeg kaniyu. 8 Ne eg-ikulen wey egtumanen niyud man-e te mapahetpet ka langun ne suhu te Magbebaye ne Manama ne ingkahi ku kaniyu kuntee. 9 Ne egpalampusen kew te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu te langun ne eggimuwen niyu, wey egbehayan kew nikandin te masulug ne anak, masulug ne ayam wey dakel ne eg-uma; igkahale din ka pegpanalangin kaniyu, iling te kahale din te pegpanalangin din te me kaap-apuan niyu. 10 Piru keilangan ne egpamminehen niyu ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, wey egtumanen ka me suhu wey ka me tulumanen din ne nasulat te seini ne baseen te Balaud; libed kew te mapahetpet diye te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu.”

301 And the descendants of Israil were_spoken_to again by Muwisis, “If the blessing and the curse that I told you(pl) happens to_you(pl), and you(pl) consider/remember this there in the nations when you(pl) will_be_spread_over by the Lord who is your(pl) God; 2 if you(pl) and your(pl) descendants return to the Lord who is your(pl) God, and you(pl) energetically obey all that I've commanded you(pl) now/today, 3 the Lord God will_feel_sorry for you(pl), and you(pl) will_be_brought again by_him from the nations that he spread_ you(pl) _over, and you(pl) will_be_prospered again by_him. 4 Even if you(pl) are driven_away(pl) by the Lord your(pl) God there to very far places in the world, you(pl) indeed will_be_gathered_together again by him, 5 and you(pl) will_be_returned there to the place of your(pl) ancestors, in_order_that you(pl) just accept it again. And you(pl) will_be_prospered(pl) and made_many again by_him more than your(pl) ancestors. 6 And the Lord who is your(pl) God will_change your(pl) hearts and the hearts of your(pl) descendants so_that you(pl) will_love him energetically, and you(pl) can continue to live_in that place. 7 And he will_send_disaster from those curses (onto) your(pl) enemies that oppressed you(pl). 8 And you(pl) will_follow and will_obey again energetically all the commands of the Lord God that I've told you(pl) now/today. 9 And you(pl) will_be_made_to_prosper by the Lord who is your(pl) God in all that_ you(pl) _do, and you(pl) will_be_given many children by_him, many domestic_animals and large harvests; blessing you(pl) will_make_ him _happy, like his happiness at his blessing your(pl) ancestors. 10 But it's_necessary that you(pl) listen to the Lord who is your(pl) God, and obey the commands and regulations that are_written in this document of the Law; return(pl) energetically to the Lord your(pl) God.”

Ka pegkamalemu te Balaud te Manama

The easiness of the Law of God

11 Ne migpabulus-bulus si Muwisis ka migkahi, “Kene ne malised ne egtumanen ka Balaud ne ingkahi ku kaniyu kuntee. 12 [xr]Ware seini diye te langit ne egpakakahi kew te, ‘Hentew-a ka egpekeendiye te langit ne eg-angey kayi wey igpangguhud kanta eyew egtumanen ta?’ 13 Ne ware degma seini diye te talipag te dahat ne egpakakahi kew te, ‘Hentew-a ka egpakalapas te dahat ne eg-angey kayi wey igpangguhud kanta eyew egtumanen ta?’ 14 Ka seini ne me lalag, duen ded te me be-be wey pusung niyu, purisu egkatuman niyu seini.”

11 And Muwisis continued speaking, “The Law that I told you(pl) now/today is not difficult to obey. 12 [xr]It's not there in the sky/heaven that you(pl) could_say, ‘Who can_go_there to the sky/heaven to get it and tell us(incl) so_that we(incl) (can) obey (it)?’ 13 And it's also not there on the far_bank of the sea that you(pl) could_say, ‘Who can_cross the sea to get it and tell us(incl) so_that we(incl) (can) obey (it)?’ 14 These words, are_ already just _there in your(pl) mouths and heart(s), therefore they can_be_obeyed by_you(pl).”

Ka peg-alam te umul

The choosing of life

15 Ne migpabulus-bulus si Muwisis ka migkahi, “Kuntee ne aldew, alam kew te seini: umul wey ke kamatayen, katubung wey ke karereetan? 16 Egbanasalan ku sikaniyu kuntee ne aldew ne geyinawei niyu ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, wey tumana niyu ka me suhu wey ka me tulumanen din. Ke eggimuwen niyu sika, egpanalanginan kew nikandin diye te tane ne eggendiyaan wey eg-angkenen niyu; egmatubung kew wey egkeyimu ne dakel ne nasud. 17 Piru ke egsupaken niyu ka Magbebaye ne Manama wey kene kew egpammineg kandin, wey iyan niyud egsimbeen wey egpamakayen ka lein ne me manama, 18 igpanengneng ku kaniyu kuntee ne aldew ne egkahule kew iya; egmalepet de ka umul niyu diye te tane ne eggendiyaan wey eg-angkenen niyu, ne diye te talipag te Hurdan. 19 Kuntee ne aldew, egdawiten ku isip me talagpamalehet ka langit wey tane ke nekey ka eg-alamen niyu: umul wey ke kamatayen, katubung wey ke karereetan. Purisu alama niyu ka umul eyew egkeuyag kew wey ka me kabuhalan niyu. 20 [xra][xrb][xrc]Geyinawei niyu ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu; tumana niyu sikandin wey palunggaat kew kandin, su eyew egpekeugpe kew wey egmalayat ka umul niyu diye te Inged ne Insaad din ne igbehey diye te me kaap-apuan niyu ne ensi Abraham, Isaak, wey si Hakub.”

15 And Muwisis continued saying, “This day, choose(pl) this: life or death, prosperity or destruction? 16 I encourage you(pl) this day that you(pl) love the Lord your(pl) God, and you(pl) obey the commands and his regulations. If you(pl) do that, you(pl) will_be_blessed by_him there in the land that you(pl) are_going_to and will_receive; you(pl) will_prosper and become a large nation. 17 But if you(pl) disobey the Lord God and you(pl) don't listen to_him, and you(pl) worship and serve other gods, 18 I will_inform you(pl) this day that you(pl) will_be_exterminated indeed; your(pl) live(s) will_become_short there in the land that you(pl) are_going_to and will_receive, there on the far_bank of the Hurdan. 19 This day, I will_mention as witnesses the sky/heaven and land whichever you(pl) choose: life or death, prosperity or destruction. Therefore choose(pl) life so_that you(pl) and your(pl) descendants can_live. 20 [xra][xrb][xrc]Love(pl) the Lord your(pl) God; obey(pl) him and remain(pl) in him, so_that you(pl) can_live and your(pl) live(s) can_be_lengthened there in the Place that he Promised to_give there to your(pl) ancestors Abraham, Isaak, and Hakub.”

Ka peg-alam ki Huswi isip liwan ki Muwisis

The choosing of Huswi as a replacement for Muwisis

311 Ne migpabulus-bulus si Muwisis ka migkahi te me kabuhalan ni Israil, 2 [xr]“120 e ka idad ku kuntee; kena ad e egpekeeleg ne egpangulu kaniyu. Ne ingkahiyan a te Magbebaye ne Manama ne kena a egkaayun ne eglapas te Hurdan. 3 Ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu mismu ka eggun-a kaniyu te eglapas te Hurdan. Egpangimatayan din ka me keet-etawan diye ke egpalinggumaan kew e, eyew egkaangken niyu ka tane dan. Ne si Huswi ka egpangulu kaniyu sumale te ingkahi te Magbebaye ne Manama. 4 [xr]Egguleen te Magbebaye ne Manama ka seeye ne keet-etawan iling te inggimu rin engki Sihun wey Ug ne me Hari te me Amurihanen, wey te tane dan. 5 Igpatalu sikandan te Manama kaniyu, wey keilangan ne eggimuwen niyu diye te kandan ka langun ne igsuhu ku kaniyu. 6 Pakannekal kew wey bulut-bulut kew; kene kew kaaldek kandan su egdumaan kew te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, wey kene kew nikandin egbalaharen wey ke eg-engkeran naa.”

311 And Muwisis continued speaking to the descendants of Israil, 2 [xr]“My age now (is) 120; I am_ no_longer _be_able to lead you(pl). And I was_spoken_to by the Lord God that it's_ not _possible that I cross the Hurdan. 3 The Lord your(pl) God himself (will be) the (one who) goes_ahead of_you(pl) in crossing the Hurdan. He will_kill(pl) the people there when you(pl) arrive, so_that you(pl) can_receive their land. And Huswi (will be) the (one) to_lead you(pl) according to what_was_said by the Lord God. 4 [xr]The Lord God will_exterminate those people like he did to Sihun and Ug the kings of the Amurihanons, and their land. 5 God will_cause_ them _to_lose to_you(pl), and it's_necessary that you(pl) do to them all that I have_commanded you(pl). 6 Be_strong(pl) and be_fierce(pl); don't(pl) be_afraid of_them because you(pl) will_be_accompanied by the Lord your(pl) God, and you(pl) won't be_ignored by_him or left_behind.”

7 Ne impeumew e ni Muwisis si Huswi, wey ingkahiyan din diye te tangkaan te me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Pakannekal ka wey bulut-bulut ka, su sikeykew ka egpangulu te keet-etawan peendiye te Inged ne Insaad te Magbebaye ne Manama ne igbehey te me kaap-apuan niyu, wey bulihi nu sikandan ne egkaangken dan seeye ne tane isip egkapanunud dan. 8 [xr]Egdumaan ka te Magbebaye ne Manama; kene ka nikandin egbalaharen wey ke eg-engkeran naa. Purisu kene ka kaaldek.”

7 And Huswi was_sent_for by Muwisis, and (he) was_told by_him there in front of the descendants of Israil, “Be_strong(pl) and be_fierce(pl), because you(sg) (are) the (one who) will_lead the people going_towards the Place that was_Promised by the Lord God to_give to your(pl) ancestors, and help(sg) them that they will_receive the land as their inheritance. 8 [xr]You(sg) will_be_accompanied by the Lord God; you(sg) won't be ignored by_him or left_behind. Therefore don't(sg) be_afraid.”

Ka pegbasa te Balaud tagse pitu ne leg-un

The reading of the Law each seven years

9 Insulat ni Muwisis ka seini ne me Balaud te Manama, wey imbehey rin e diye te me talagpanubad ne me kabuhalan ni Libi, ne iyan impiyalan ne eg-uyan te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye ne Manama, wey diye degma te me igdatu te me kabuhalan ni Israil. 10 [xra][xrb]Ne impanpanayan ni Muwisis ka me talagpanubad wey me Libita te egkahi, “Te katamanan te tagse pitu ne leg-un ne iyan ka leg-un ne Kenad e Egsukuten ka me Utang, 11 basaa niyu ka seini ne me Balaud te timpu te Sahakeen te me Leeb diye te tangkaan te me kabuhalan ni Israil te timpu ne eglibulung sikandan diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, diye te inged ne eg-alamen din. 12 Palibulunga niyu ka keet-etawan—ka me lukes, me malitan, me bate, wey ka me lapu ne nangugpe te me lungsud niyu, eyew egpakarineg sikandan langun te Balaud, wey egkateu ne egtahud te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, wey mapahetpet ne egtuman te me Balaud din. 13 Te sika ne paahi, ka me kabuhalan niyu ne ware pad nakarineg te Balaud te Magbebaye ne Manama, egpakarineg e kayi. Ne egkateu e sikandan ne egtahud te Magbebaye ne Manama taheed te egmangugpe sikandan diye te tane ne mahaan niyud eg-angkena, ne diye te talipag te Hurdan.”

9 These Laws of God were_written by Muwisis, and he gave (it/them) there to the sacrificers that descendants of Libi, that (were) entrusted to_carry the Container of the Agreement of the Lord God, and there also to the elders of the descendants of Israil. 10 [xra][xrb]And Muwisis warned the sacrificers and the Libitas saying, “At the end of each seven years that's the year of Not Foreclosing Debts, 11 read(pl) these Laws at the time of Feast in Shelters there in front of the descendants of Israil at the time that they gather_together there in front of the Lord who is your(pl) God, there at the place that he choses. 12 Have(pl)_ the people _gathered—the males, females, children, and foreigners that live(pl) in your(pl) towns, so_that they all can_hear the Law, and will_know to respect/honor the Lord your(pl) God, and energetically obey his Laws. 13 By that means, your(pl) descendants who haven't yet heard the Law of the Lord God, can_hear it. And they will_know to respect/honor the Lord God while they live there in the land that you(pl) will_receive soon, that's there on the opposite_bank of the Hurdan.”

Ka katamanan ne suhu ki Muwisis

The final command by Muwisis

14 Ne ingkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis, “Mahaan kad egpatey. Purisu ipeumew nu si Huswi, wey parumeey kew diye te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan su egpanuluen ku sikandin te eggimuwen din.”

14 And Muwisis was_spoken_to by the Lord God, “You(sg) will_die soon. Therefore send_for Huswi, and go_together to the Tent that's a Meeting_place because he will_be_taught by_me (about) what_ he _should_do.”

Purisu migparumeey e si Muwisis wey si Huswi diye te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan.15 Ne migpapitew kandan ka Magbebaye ne Manama ne migpabaluy ne gapun ne egpekeiling te sungkaleg ne migsasindeg diye te gumawan te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan.

Therefore Muwisis and Huswi went_together there to the Tent that's a Meeting_place.15 And the Lord God showed them in_the_form_of cloud that's like a pillar that stood there in the doorway of the Tent that's a Meeting_place.

16 Ne ingkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis, “Ke egpatey kad e, egsimbe e seini ne me etew te me manama ne insimba te keet-etawan diye te tane ne eggendiyaan dan; eg-inniyuhan ad nikandan, wey egsupaken dan e ka kasabutan ne inggimu ku duma kandan. 17 Ke egkeyitabu sika, egkanlabkanlab ka langet ku kandan. Ne eg-engkeran ku sikandan, wey kene kud eg-ileen ne keet-etawan ku. Ne egpakasalerep e sikandan te mangune-kune ne karereetan wey me peg-antus. Ne egpakakahi e sikandan te, ‘Kema ke iyan egpuunan ne neyitabu seini kanta su in-engkeran kid Manama?’ 18 Ne kene ku iya sikandan egpangabangan su in-engkeran e ma nikandan pinaahi te pegsimba ran te lein ne me manama. 19 Purisu isulat nu seini ne ulahingen, wey ipanulu nu te me kabuhalan ni Israil, eyew egkasuman-suman a nikandan, wey ware aliddanan dan eyew egsupak keddi. 20 Eg-uyanen ku sikandan diye te meupiya ne tane wey dakel se eg-uma,[fn] sumale te insaad ku te me kaap-apuan dan. Ne emun ke egmatubung e sikandan diye, wey egkakeen dan e ka minsan nekey ne igkeibeg dan te egkeen, wey egkengabulung sikandan, wey egmanlambeg, egsupaken dan e ka kasabutan ku. Egsamsamilian ad nikandan, wey eg-engkeran; iyan dan e egsimbeen ka lein ne me manama. 21 Ne emun egpakasalerep e sikandan te mangune-kune ne karereetan wey me peg-antus, ka seini naa ne ulahingen ka egpasuman-suman kandan su kene ma seini egkalingawan te me kabuhalan dan. Nakanengneng a te suman-suman dan kuntee, minsan ware ku pad sikandan uyana diye te Inged ne Insaad ku ne igbehey kandan.”

16 And Muwisis was_spoken_to by the Lord God, “When you(sg) die, these people will_worship gods that are_worshiped by the people there in the land that they are_going_to; I will_turn_away_from them, and they will_disobey the agreement that I made along_with them. 17 If that happens, my anger at them will_blaze. And I will_leave_ them _behind, and I won't recognize/acknowledge (them) as my people. And they will_experience_disaster of terrible destruction and suffering. And they will_say, ‘Maybe the reason that this happened to_us(incl) (is) because we(incl) left_behind God?’ 18 And I won't indeed rescue them because I was_left_behind by_them by_means of their worshiping other gods. 19 Therefore write(sg) this song, and teach(sg) (it) to the descendants of Israil, so_that I will_be_remembered by_them, and they have_no excuses in_order_to disobey(pl) me. 20 I will_bring them there to good land and (with) large harvest,[fn] according to what_ I _promised to their ancestors. And if they prosper there, and they can_eat what ever they desire to_eat, and they are_full(pl), and become_fat(pl), they will_disobey my agreement. I will_be_disowned by_them, and left_behind; they will_worship other gods. 21 And when they experience_disaster of terrible destruction and sufferings, this song will_remind them because this won't be_forgotten by their descendants. I know their thinking now/today, even_though I haven't yet brought them to the Place that I Promised to_give to_them.”

22 Purisu te seeye de ne aldew, insulat e ni Muwisis ka ulahingen, wey impanulu din e seini te me kabuhalan ni Israil.

22 Therefore of that very day, the song was_written_down by Muwisis, and he taught it to the descendants of Israil.

23 [xr]Ne ingkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Huswi ne anak ni Nun, “Pakannekal ka wey bulut-bulut ka, su sikeykew ka eg-uyan te me kabuhalan ni Israil diye te Inged ne Insaad ku kandan, wey egdumaan ku sikeykew.”

23 [xr]And Huswi the child of Nun was_spoken_to by the Lord God, “Be_strong(sg) and fierce, because you(sg) (are) the (one who) will_bring the descendants of Israil there to the Place that I Promised them, and I will_accompany you(sg).”

24 Te neimpusan e ni Muwisis te egsulat ka langun ne Balaud, 25 impanpanayan din e ka me Libita ne iyan talag-uyan te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye ne Manama, ne migkahi sikandin, 26 “Uyana niyu seini se baseen te Balaud, wey itahu niyu diye te kakiliran te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. Ne keilangan ne diye de iya seini isip kamalehetan ne nakanengneng kew te igpeyimu te Magbebaye ne Manama. 27 Nakanengneng a te pegkamasinupaken wey pegkamakehal te ulu niyu, su inhanggat niyu ma ka langet te Magbebaye ne Manama minsan manekal e pad kuntee duma kaniyu. Ne weynaam pa iya ke egpatey ad!” 28 Ne ingkahiyan din e man-e ka me Libita, “Palibulunga niyu kayi te tangkaan ku ka langun ne pangulu te me kabuhalan niyu wey ka me upisyal su egguhuran ku sikandan te seini ne me suhu. Ne egdawiten ku isip me talagpamalehet meyitenged kayi ka langit wey tane. 29 Nakanengneng a ne emun egpatey ad, eggimu kew iya te mareet wey eg-engkeran niyud ka langun ne insuhu ku kaniyu. Ne egkalangetan e kaniyu ka Magbebaye ne Manama wey egpasalerepen kew nikandin te karereetan su inhanggat niyu ma ka langet din pinaahi te peggimu niyu te igkene kaniyu.”

24 When Muwisis had_finished writing all the Law, 25 he warned the Libitas who (were) the carriers of the Container of the Agreement of the Lord God, and he said, 26 “Bring(pl) this document of Law, and put(pl) (it) there at the side of the Container of the Agreement of the Lord your(pl) God. And it's_necessary that this just (stays) there as a witness that you(pl) know what_ the Lord God _has_asked_to_be_done. 27 I know the unfaithfulness and hardness of your(pl) head(s), because you(pl) challenged the anger of the Lord God even_though I (am) still strong/alive now along_with you(pl). And how_much_more indeed if I die!” 28 And he spoke again to the Libitas, “Have_gathered(pl) here in front of me all the leaders of your(pl) descendants and the officials because I will_story them (about) these commands. And I will_call_on heaven/sky and earth as witnesses concerning this. 29 I know that when I die, you(pl) will_ indeed _do evil and you(pl) will_leave_behind all that_ I _have_commanded you(pl). And the Lord God will_get_angry at_you(pl) and you(pl) will_experience_disaster from_him that's terrible destruction because you(pl) provoked his anger by means of doing what is forbiden for you(pl).”

The final farewell/instructions by Muwisis

45 Te nekeimpus e si Muwisis ka egpangguhud te me panulu te Manama diye te keet-etawan, 46 ingkahiyan din e sikandan, “Tantanuri niyu naa layun ka langun ne ingguhud ku kaniyu kuntee ne aldew. Ne ipanulu niyu degma seini te me anak niyu eyew egtumanen dan te mapahetpet ka langun ne lalag te seini ne balaud. 47 Ka me lalag te seini ne balaud, kene ne lerew re due; seini ka egpakabehey kaniyu te malayat ne umul ke egtumanen niyu seini diye te tane ne eg-angkenen niyu, ne diye te talipag te Hurdan.”

45 When Muwisis finished of storying the teachings of God there to the people, 46 they were_told by_him, “Always take_care(pl) (about) all that_ I _have_storied you(pl) today. And also teach(pl) this to your(pl) children so_that they will_ energetically _obey all the words of this law. 47 The words of this law, are_not just ordinary; this (is what) can_give you(pl) long life if you(pl) obey this there in the land that you(pl) will_receive, that's there on the opposite_bank of the Hurdan.”

48 [xr]Te sikan ded ne aldew, ingkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis, 49 “Takereg ka diye te Bubungan ne Abarim te inged te Muwab ne egkatalipag te Hiriku, wey pamantawa nu ka inged te Kanaan ne igbehey ku te me kabuhalan ni Israil eyew egkaangken dan. 50 Ne diye ka egpatey te seeye ne bubungan iling te suled nu ne si Aarun ne migpatey diye te Bubungan ne Hur, wey insabal, 51 su ware kew ma migparuma-ruma keddiey se daruwa wey ware niyu tahura ka pegkamatulus ku diye te tangkaan te me kabuhalan ni Israil, te diye kew pad te weyig te Miriba ne diye te disirtu, diye te Sin ne marani te Kadis. 52 Purisu tibbal ke re egpakapamantew te tane ne igbehey ku te me kabuhalan ni Israil, piru kene ka egpekeendiye.”

48 [xr]On that very day, Muwisis was_spoken_to by the Lord God, 49 “Ascend(sg) there on Mount Abarim in the place of Muwab that's on the opposite_bank from Hiriku, and look_over(sg) at the place of Kanaan that I will_give to the descendants of Israil so_that they can_receive (it). 50 And you(sg) will_die there on that mountain like your(sg) sibling Aarun that died there on Mount Hur, and wrapped_and_stored, 51 because you(pl) two didn't carefully_obey me and you(pl) didn't respect/honor my holiness there in front of the descendants of Israil, when you(pl) (were) still there at the water of Miriba there in the desert, there at Sin near to Kadis. 52 Therefore the land that I will_give to the descendants of Israil (will be) visible as you(sg) look_out, but you(sg) won't be_able_to_go_there.”

Ka pegpapitew te Manama ki Muwisis te tane

The showing of the land to Muwisis by God

341 Ne puun te kanapnapuan te Muwab, migtakereg e si Muwisis diye te Bubungan ne Nibu, wey migpabulus-bulus diye te puntul te Bubungan ne Pisga ne egkatalipag te Hiriku. Ne impapitew kandin te Magbebaye ne Manama ka intiru ne tane: puun te Gilyad taman te Dan; 2 ka me inged ne egkaangken te tribu enni Naptali, Ipraim, Manasis, wey ni Huda taman diye te Dahat ne Miditiranyu, dapit te iglineb; 3 ka inged te Nigib, ka napu te Hiriku ne siyudad te me palmira, taman te Suar. 4 [xra][xrb][xrc]Ne ingkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis, “Seini ka Inged ne Insaad ku ki Abraham, Isaak, wey ki Hakub ne igbehey ku diye te me kabuhalan dan. Impapitew ku seini keykew piru kene ka egpekeendiye.”

341 And from the plains of Muwab, Muwisis ascended there on Mount Nibu, and continued to the peak of Mount Pisga that's on_the_opposite_bank from Hiriku. And the Lord God showed him the entire land: from Gilyad until Dan; 2 the places that would_be_received by the tribes of Naptali, Ipraim, Manasis, and of Huda until there at the Miditiranyu Sea, there on the west; 3 the place of Nigib, the plain of Hiriku the city of palms, until Suar. 4 [xra][xrb][xrc]And Muwisis was_spoken_to by the Lord God, “This (is) the Place that_ I _Promised to Abraham, Isaak, and Hakub that_ I _would_give to their descendants. I have_showed you(sg) this but you(sg) won't be_able_to_go_there.”

Ka pegpatey ni Muwisis

The death of Muwisis

5 Ne migpatey e diye te inged te Muwab si Muwisis ne suluhuanen te Magbebaye ne Manama, sumale iya te ingkahi te Manama. 6 Ne inlebeng e sikandin te Manama diye te bangalug te Muwab ne talipag te Bit-Piyur. Piru taman kuntee, ware minsan hentew ne nakanengneng te eleg ne nalengeran te inlebengan ki Muwisis. 7 120 e ka idad ni Muwisis te pegpatey rin. Piru te sika ne idad din, makeseg pad sikandin wey egpakameleg-meleg pad. 8 Ne miglungku kandin ka langun ne me kabuhalan ni Israil diye te kanapnapuan te Muwab, taman te sabeka ne bulan.

5 And Muwisis the servant of the Lord God died there in the place of Muwab, according indeed to what_ God _had_said. 6 And he was_buried there in the valley of Muwab opposite Bit-Piyur. But until now/today, no (one) knows the correct place where_ Muwisis _was_buried. 7 The age of Muwisis at his death (was) 120. But at that age, he (was) still strong and still able_to_see_clearly. 8 And all the descendants of Israil mourned him there in the plains of Muwab, for (LIT until) one month.

9 Ne si Huswi ne anak ni Nun, napenu te panisingan te katagseb, su intel-eban ma sikandin ni Muwisis te belad din te peg-alam kandin. Purisu migpammineg ki Huswi ka langun ne me kabuhalan ni Israil, wey intuman dan ka me suhu te Magbebaye ne Manama ne ingkahi dengan ni Muwisis.

9 And Huswi the child of Nun, was_full of the spirit of wisdom, because he had_been_laid hands on by Muwisis at his choosing him. Therefore all the descendants of Israil listened to Huswi, and they obeyed all the commands of the Lord God that Muwisis told before.

10 [xr]Ne minsan ken-u, ware de due prupita te Israil ne iling ki Muwisis te amana egpekegtangke te Magbebaye ne Manama. 11 Warad egpekeiling kandin te impeyimu te Magbebaye ne Manama te me palinneu wey me kein-inuwan diye te Ihiptu eyew te pegkuntere te Hari diye, te langun ne upisyal rin, wey te intiru ne nasud din. 12 Warad egpekeiling kandin te nekeyimu te nalein-lein ne derakel wey me kein-inuwan ne himu ne napamalehetan mismu te me kabuhalan ni Israil.

10 [xr]And when ever, there (was) indeed no prophet in Israil like Muwisis who greatly stood_face_to_face with the Lord God. 11 There_was_no (one) like him that was_gotten_to_do signs and wonders by the Lord God there in Ihiptu in_order for opposing the king there, all his officials, and his entire nation. 12 There's_no (one) like him who was_able_to_do various great and amazing acts that were_witnessed by the descendants of Israil themselves.
